jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Defense
jobs.description_html:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You'll Do

We're looking for an AI Researcher to build the agents that turn our offensive knowledge into defensive action.

You'll build agents that reason from a proven attack path to the specific control changes that break it - EDR policy, firewall and segmentation rules, conditional access, detection content, cloud IAM, GPO - apply or stage those changes in the customer's environment, and then prove the fix by re-running the attack.

That last part is why this is tractable. Most defensive AI has no ground truth and gets graded on whether its advice sounds reasonable. Ours gets graded on whether the attack still works. You will have a real outcome signal on a short loop, and hundreds of thousands of prior tests to learn from. It is also why this is hard. These agents run inside customer tenants and modify production security controls. A bad change is an outage or a new hole in someone's defense. The reasoning problem and the safety problem are the same problem here, and you will own both.

The goal is closed-loop defense: find, fix, verify, running autonomously at enterprise scale. If you want to work on agents where the feedback is real and the stakes are real, this is the job for you.

Responsibilities

  • Build the reasoning systems that map proven attack paths and exploitation telemetry to specific, applicable control changes, ranked by effectiveness against operational blast radius.

  • Turn our pentest data into training and evaluation data. Extract the signal of why an attack succeeded in one environment and failed in another.

  • Design and run counterfactual experiments in representative test environments: would this change have broken this attack chain, what does it cost operationally, and does it generalize beyond the tenant it was learned in.

  • Design the reasoning layer over heterogeneous control planes so an agent can work across vendor APIs with different policy models without a hardcoded playbook per product.

  • Design the safety architecture for autonomous change — dry-run and simulation, blast-radius classification, approval gates for high-impact actions, staged rollout, rollback, and an audit trail a customer's change board will accept.

  • Work with our attack engineers and detection engineers to define target agent behavior and diagnose failure modes: ineffective remediations, over-broad changes, business-breaking policy edits, and recommendations that look right and don't hold on re-test.

  • Own problems end to end in a 0→1 environment where requirements are ambiguous, systems move fast, and reliability matters, because the output lands in someone's production security posture.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • Strong ML engineering experience building, evaluating, and deploying production AI systems, with hands-on work in deep learning, transformer models, and PyTorch.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: post-training large language models (supervised fine-tuning, distillation, preference optimization, RL), or designing agentic systems with tool use, planning, and long-horizon execution that hold up outside a demo.

  • A track record of building evaluation systems for open-ended tasks where there is no clean label and success is judged by outcome.

  • Experience reasoning over structured, heterogeneous, messy real-world data — configurations, graphs, logs, policy documents — rather than clean benchmark datasets.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping and maintaining production-quality code in Python, not just scripts and proofs of concept.

  • Experience with data pipelines, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.

  • Ability to work across model behavior, APIs, and infrastructure, and to collaborate closely with attack engineers, detection engineers, product, and infrastructure.

  • Ability to independently research unfamiliar systems and rapidly become the team's expert.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including clear technical documentation.

  • Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus 4+ years of professional engineering experience.

You do not need to have been a pentester or a SOC analyst. You do need to be seriously interested in how attackers and defenders actually operate, and willing to learn it in depth. The reasoning we are building cannot be designed by someone who does not understand the domain.

Preferred

  • Background in detection engineering, purple teaming, security engineering, offensive security, or incident response.

  • Hands-on familiarity with security control planes and their APIs and policy models: EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender), firewalls and segmentation (Palo Alto, Fortinet), identity and conditional access (Entra ID, Okta), SIEM and detection content (Splunk, Sentinel), cloud IAM, WAF, MDM, and GPO.

  • Experience with causal or counterfactual inference, or with graph reasoning, planning, and search over large state spaces. Familiarity with Neo4j and attack-path analysis.

  • Experience building automation that takes write actions in production systems, along with the safety and change-management machinery around it.

  • Experience with adversarial robustness or prompt injection, particularly where an agent consumes untrusted input from the environment it operates in.

  • Experience integrating ML into production, multi-tenant SaaS, or running ML systems in customer-controlled or air-gapped environments.

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

 

What You'll Do

The Principal Engineer for Database Platform is the technical anchor of NodeZero's data infrastructure. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports — your influence is through technical leadership, architecture ownership, and raising the engineering bar across the team. You own the most consequential database architecture decisions, define the standards that govern how NodeZero stores, queries, and migrates data at scale, and ensure the data layer can support NodeZero's growth — more customers, larger environments, more pentest data — without requiring proportional operational effort. This is a deeply hands-on role: you will write code, author design documents, and set the technical direction that every engineer on the Database Platform team builds toward.

NodeZero's data layer is not simple. We store millions of discovered assets, graph-structured attack paths, time-series vulnerability data, and audit-critical pentest results — across a multi-tenant architecture where correctness and data isolation are non-negotiable. You will be the person who makes the hardest data architecture calls and ensures the team has the technical foundations to build reliably on.

  • Technical Strategy: Define and drive the technical roadmap for the Database Platform in partnership with the Senior Engineering Manager and the broader Pentest Platform organization.

  • Architecture Leadership: Own the most complex database architecture decisions — schema design, partitioning strategies, migration patterns, and scalability approaches. Produce design documents that become the shared technical model for the team.

  • PostgreSQL Excellence: Be NodeZero's definitive expert on PostgreSQL at scale — query optimization, indexing, partitioning, replication, and connection pooling. Set the standards the team follows and catch the problems others miss.

  • Graph & Multi-model Data: Architect and guide the evolution of NodeZero's graph-based asset model — the data structure that represents how discovered hosts, services, credentials, and vulnerabilities relate to each other across pentests.

  • Schema Governance: Own schema design review processes. Ensure every migration is safe, reversible, and zero-downtime. Build the tooling and culture that treats schema changes with the same rigor as production code changes.

  • Mentorship & Bar Raising: Mentor P5 and P4 engineers through code review, design review, and pairing. Be the person on the team that raises everyone else's ceiling.

  • Cross-functional Influence: Partner with Data Ingestion, Asset Inventory, API Platform, and Security Research to define data contracts, query performance standards, and architectural guardrails that span the full data pipeline.

 

What You'll Bring

Technical Depth

  • Deep, production-proven PostgreSQL expertise: query planner internals, advanced indexing (partial, expression, GiST/GIN), partitioning strategies, logical replication, vacuuming at scale, and connection pool tuning.

  • Experience architecting multi-tenant databases at scale: row-level security, tenant isolation, schema-per-tenant vs. shared-schema tradeoffs.

  • Experience with schema migration at scale in production systems: zero-downtime migrations, backwards-compatible schema evolution, and migration tooling (Flyway, golang-migrate, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with graph data models and graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) or graph-like query patterns in relational systems (recursive CTEs, ltree, adjacency list).

  • Proficient in Go or Python — able to write production application code, not just SQL.

Architecture & Design

  • Demonstrated track record of defining database architecture at scale — from design doc to production — across multiple companies or teams.

  • Strong opinions on data architecture tradeoffs: normalization vs. denormalization, consistency vs. availability, OLTP vs. OLAP workload separation, and schema-first vs. schema-last design.

  • Able to reason about long-horizon schema design: what does this schema look like in two years, at 10× the current data volume, with three new feature teams writing to it?

  • Able to communicate complex database decisions clearly in writing — for design docs, ADRs, and cross-team reviews — so engineers without deep DB expertise can understand and apply the reasoning.

Leadership Without Authority

  • Proven ability to drive database standards across multiple teams without direct reporting authority — including teams that are not the Database Platform team.

  • Experience establishing database engineering culture: schema review norms, migration safety standards, and query performance review processes.

  • Track record of growing engineers through code review, pair programming, and architectural mentorship — especially engineers who are strong in application code but earlier in their database expertise.

 

Nice to Haves

  • Background in cybersecurity data: vulnerability databases, network scan schemas, or attack surface management data models.

  • Experience with time-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) in addition to relational.

  • Familiarity with data platform compliance requirements: SOC 2 Type II, FedRAMP data handling, or GDPR/CCPA.

  • Experience with analytical query patterns or BI/reporting workloads on operational data.

  • Contributions to open-source database tooling or PostgreSQL ecosystem projects.

That means real distributed systems problems, not glue code. They execute inside customer environments under tight isolation, credential, and egress constraints. And when an agent proposes a change in production, the platform has to be able to simulate it, stage it, gate it on approval, roll it back, and prove after the fact exactly what happened and on whose authority.

It also means the interfaces that sit on top of all of that. Autonomous systems are only trusted to the extent that people can see what they did and intervene before they do it, and that burden lands on the front end. These surfaces are part of the product, not a thin layer over the API, and you'll own them end to end alongside the backend they talk to.

This is a platform role. You'll own the runtime, the tool layer, the orchestration, the connector framework, and the observability and UI that make agent behavior debuggable. We're looking for engineers with strong backend depth who are comfortable building the front end when the workflow demands it — not because it's beneath them, but because they understand the value of end-to-end delivery. You'll work closely with our AI researchers, but you are not being hired to tune prompts — you are being hired to build the substrate that makes their work shippable and safe.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own the agent execution runtime: durable, resumable, long-running workflows with checkpointing, idempotent steps, cancellation, and timeouts at both the step and run level.

  • Design and implement the tool layer that agents act through — a registry with versioning, schema validation, per-tenant enablement, and authorization enforced server-side rather than by the model.

  • Build the connector framework for third-party security control planes (EDR, firewall, identity, SIEM, cloud IAM).

  • Implement the safe-change pipeline: dry-run and simulation, blast-radius classification, approval gates for high-impact actions, staged rollout, rollback, and an immutable per-tenant audit trail.

  • Build the operator-facing front end in React and TypeScript, turning dense system state into interfaces a user can reason about and act on with confidence.

  • Build the client-side data and streaming layer that keeps those interfaces accurate against long-running, incrementally updating state, over WebSockets rather than polling.

  • Extend NodeZero's tenant isolation model to agents that take write actions, covering execution boundaries, egress control, quotas, and cross-tenant leakage in caches, indexes, and logs.

  • Develop core product features in ETL and GraphQL to support data processing and retrieval for agent context, run history, and remediation state.

  • Build the ETL pipelines that turn pentest and remediation outcomes into the datasets our researchers train and evaluate against.

  • Instrument everything. Distributed tracing across an agent run, cost and token accounting per tenant, and the tooling to answer "why did the agent do that" without guessing.

  • Partner with AI researchers, attack engineers, and product to take capabilities from prototype to production, and feed platform constraints back into research direction early rather than late.

Required Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field.

  • 7+ yrs professional software engineering experience using modern object-oriented or functional languages (Python, Go, Scala, C++, TypeScript, etc).

  • Proven experience delivering backend APIs, especially GraphQL, and consuming them from a modern web stack.

  • Production experience with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS layout, with the judgment to build a usable interface for a complex workflow without a designer holding your hand.

  • Experience building applications on cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, using container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Expert proficiency in SQL.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating distributed systems in production: asynchronous workflows, queues, retries, idempotency, and partial failure.

  • A track record of shipping and operating production services, including on-call ownership.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building agentic or LLM-backed systems in production

  • Experience with a durable execution (such as Temporal) or workflow engine or having built equivalent checkpointing yourself.

  • Experience building multi-tenant platforms with hard isolation requirements, workload identity, and short-lived credential brokering.

  • Experience integrating a long tail of third-party APIs behind a normalized abstraction.

  • Familiarity with security control planes and their APIs — EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender), firewalls, SIEM, cloud IAM.

  • Experience with database architectures including relational (PostgreSQL) and graph (Neo4j), and experience building GraphQL backends.

What You'll Do

Our AI researchers define how NodeZero's agents should reason. You build the pipelines, serve infrastructure, and release machinery that turns that research into something running against thousands of customer tenants every day.

This is the seam where most AI products fail. A model that performs well in a notebook is not a capability. It becomes one when there is a reproducible training pipeline, an evaluation suite that runs in CI, a versioned release path with canaries and rollback, monitoring that catches regressions before customers do, and a cost and latency profile the business can afford. That is your work.

You'll work directly with our AI researchers and closely with backend and infrastructure engineers. You are not being hired to do research, and you are not being hired to do generic platform work. You own the path from model to production.

  • Own the release path for model-layer artifacts: version prompts, model selections, and tool definitions as deployable config; run shadow and canary deployments by tenant; make rollback fast and boring.

  • Build monitoring for the model layer — behavioral drift, regression detection, output quality signals, latency, and per-tenant token and cost accounting with budget enforcement.

  • Build the data and context pipelines that feed inference, including retrieval and embedding infrastructure over attack path, configuration, and remediation data, with tenant isolation enforced end to end.

  • Optimize cost and latency across the inference path, and make the tradeoffs visible so product decisions are made with real numbers.

  • Develop core product features in ETL and GraphQL where model outputs, run history, and evaluation results need to reach the product and internal tooling.

  • Partner with researchers to move prototypes into production, and feed production constraints and failure data back into research direction.

What You’ll Do:

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of NodeZero’s Agentic Data Platform, including Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS), machine learning infrastructure, and the data services that power our next generation of cybersecurity capabilities.

Every autonomous pentest NodeZero runs generates valuable insights into how real environments can be compromised, from hosts and identities to credentials, vulnerabilities, and attack paths. This role is responsible for turning that data into a scalable, reliable, and intelligent platform that enables product teams, machine learning engineers, and agentic systems to build differentiated security capabilities.

You will own the vision and roadmap for NodeZero’s core data services, including managed relational, graph, and vector databases, the unified asset and attack graph, data APIs, and the infrastructure supporting traditional machine learning development and deployment. This includes training-ready datasets, feature stores, model training pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and governance.

You will also own the financial and operational strategy behind the platform, ensuring infrastructure investments deliver measurable value through improved performance, scalability, cost efficiency, and business outcomes. You will partner closely with Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership to make investment decisions, manage platform economics, and prioritize capabilities that accelerate innovation across NodeZero.

This role requires strong technical depth in data infrastructure, database architecture, machine learning platforms, and cloud services, combined with excellent product judgment and commercial awareness. You will balance architectural trade-offs, reliability, governance, and long-term scalability with the needs of engineering teams and the broader business.

As a senior leader within Product, you will operate with high autonomy, influence executive direction, and serve as the product owner for foundational capabilities that enable innovation across NodeZero. You will define clear success metrics and ensure delivery against platform adoption, performance, reliability, cost efficiency, and business growth goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Platform Product Strategy: Define and execute the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for NodeZero’s data services and machine learning platform. Determine which capabilities should be centralized, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and align platform investments with business priorities, customer outcomes, and long-term product differentiation.

  • Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) Ownership: Lead the evolution of managed relational, graph, and vector data services, including self-service provisioning, scaling, migrations, upgrades, and lifecycle management. Ensure data infrastructure delivers the reliability, performance, security, and flexibility required by internal teams and enterprise customers.

  • Asset and Attack Graph Infrastructure: Own the product strategy for NodeZero’s unified asset and attack graph, including complex data relationships, multi-hop query performance, data freshness, consistency, and scalable access to offensive security intelligence.

  • Data Architecture, APIs, and Integrations: Partner closely with Engineering to define scalable data models, query APIs, change-data-capture pipelines, event streams, schema governance, and platform abstractions that enable product, ML, and agent teams to build efficiently on shared infrastructure.

  • Machine Learning Platform Strategy: Own the infrastructure supporting traditional machine learning workflows, including training pipelines, feature stores, experiment tracking, model registries, batch and real-time inference, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation standards. Enable teams to develop, deploy, and operate production ML models reliably.

Horizon3 is in search of a highly motivated and technically skilled Staff Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of NodeZero Rapid Response. This role requires a strong blend of product leadership, cybersecurity expertise, threat intelligence experience, technical depth, and customer empathy to help organizations quickly understand whether emerging vulnerabilities create real, exploitable risk in their environments.

The Staff Product Manager for Rapid Response will own the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and operating model for NodeZero Rapid Response. This leader will partner closely with the Attack Team, Engineering, Data, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Support to define how Horizon3 monitors emerging threats, determines which vulnerabilities matter, maps those threats to customer environments, validates real-world exploitability, and helps customers take action before attackers do.

Responsibilities

Rapid Response Product Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for NodeZero Rapid Response, helping customers understand and respond to emerging vulnerabilities based on real exploitability and customer-specific risk.

  • Establish the end-to-end operating model for Rapid Response, from initial threat signal through research, prioritization, customer relevance analysis, exploit/test development, notification, remediation, retesting, and verification.

  • Set clear ownership, decision rights, service-level expectations, and operating rhythms across the teams required to deliver Rapid Response at speed.

  • Drive standardization and scalability across Rapid Response research, customer communications, integrations, and operational workflows.

Exploit Intelligence & Coverage Strategy

  • Establish and grow exploit-intelligence relationships with security vendors, researchers, and other relevant intelligence providers to identify emerging Rapid Response opportunities as early as possible.

  • Define the threat intelligence strategy for Rapid Response across vendor advisories, CVEs, CISA KEV, public research, exploit repositories, attacker activity, and other sources of vulnerability and exploit intelligence.

  • Develop a prioritization framework for determining which vulnerabilities warrant immediate Rapid Response coverage based on exploitability, attacker utility, prevalence, customer footprint, potential impact, and evidence of exploitation in the wild.

  • Partner directly with vulnerability researchers and attack engineers to assess exploit prerequisites, affected products and versions, attack techniques, mitigations, and the evidence and production-safety controls needed to validate exploitability in customer environments.

Customer Relevance, Exploitability & Automation

  • Build capabilities that identify which customers, environments, and assets are potentially affected by an emerging threat using asset intelligence, technology fingerprinting, exposure context, historical NodeZero data, and other relevant signals.

  • Drive the product, onboarding, and Customer Success motion required to get 100% of customers to run EAD and keep discovery current so Rapid Response notifications can be relevant and actionable.

  • Drive automation that accelerates exploit and test development, including reusable research and exploit-development workflows, AI-assisted analysis, automated data collection, quality gates, and production-safety checks.

  • Define and monitor operational metrics such as time from disclosure to threat assessment, time to customer relevance determination, time to test availability, alert precision, validation coverage, remediation rates, and retest rates.

Customer Adoption, Growth & Go-to-Market

  • Track Rapid Response test rates by event, customer, segment, and technology to ensure the offering is delivering measurable customer value and to identify adoption gaps that require product or go-to-market action.

  • Own Rapid Response attach-rate analysis and define customer-level triggers for renewals, new ARR, and expansion when an event is relevant to a customer's technology stack, industry, or exposure profile.

  • Partner with Alliances, Channel, and Marketing to turn Rapid Response intelligence and event content into partner plays, enablement, packaging, and campaigns that accelerate attach rates and qualified demand.

  • Define the measurement funnel from threat event to awareness, customer notification, test execution, remediation, pipeline influence, retention, and expansion, and use those insights to improve the product and go-to-market motion.

Cross-Functional Execution, UX & Reporting

  • Own the quality of the Rapid Response user experience and reporting, ensuring customers can quickly understand whether they are affected, see proof, take action, communicate results internally, and confidently demonstrate the value of the product.

  • Define how Rapid Response fits into customer security operations through notifications, APIs, ticketing, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and other security and IT workflows.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Support to drive launches, enablement, customer education, adoption, event response, and feedback loops for Rapid Response.

  • Engage directly with CISOs, vulnerability management teams, SOC teams, incident responders, security researchers, prospects, and partners to understand emerging-threat response workflows and unmet needs.

Travel Required

  • Hybrid role is located in San Francisco, New York, or Washington DC. Role may require up to 20% travel to be successful.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience building deeply technical B2B SaaS products, with significant cybersecurity experience and depth in one or more domains such as vulnerability management, exposure management, offensive security, incident response, SOC operations, attack surface management, endpoint security, or threat detection and response.

  • Threat intelligence experience is required. You have hands-on experience working in or closely with cyber threat intelligence, vulnerability intelligence, threat research, emerging-threat response, or a closely related discipline.

  • Strong technical understanding of the vulnerability and exploitation lifecycle—including CVEs, CISA KEV, vendor advisories, proof-of-concept exploits, exploitation in the wild, affected products and versions, exploit prerequisites, mitigations, and remediation—with enough depth to work directly with vulnerability researchers and attack engineers on safe exploitability validation.

  • Experience translating threat intelligence into actionable customer outcomes rather than simply presenting feeds, scores, or lists of vulnerabilities.

  • Experience building products that combine multiple sources of telemetry, intelligence, and customer context to make high-confidence decisions.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to make decisions quickly when information is incomplete, the threat landscape is changing rapidly, and emerging vulnerabilities require response outside normal business hours.

  • Proven ability to work closely with engineers, designers, researchers, and security practitioners to translate complex technical capabilities into scalable product experiences.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience using customer feedback, threat data, product analytics, and operational metrics to prioritize investments and communicate clearly with customers, executives, and go-to-market teams.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox" security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Front-End team and help shape the future of the user experience across the Horizon3 NodeZero platform.

This is not a traditional feature team role. The Core Front-End team operates as a central front-end architecture and enablement group responsible for driving the long-term scalability, consistency, performance, and usability of the NodeZero platform. You will work across multiple product areas and partner closely with Product, Design, Front-End, Back-End, Platform, and Security Engineering teams to define and implement modern user experiences at scale.

As a Staff Engineer, you will lead complex technical initiatives that span multiple teams and systems. You will help define architectural direction, establish engineering standards, improve developer workflows, and guide the evolution of our front-end platform and design system. You will also play a key role in mentoring engineers, influencing technical strategy, and accelerating engineering effectiveness across the organization.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving ambiguous problems, influencing technical direction beyond their immediate team, and building systems that enable other engineers to move faster.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Drive front-end architecture decisions across the platform

  • Design scalable, maintainable, and reusable UI systems and application patterns

  • Lead large cross-functional initiatives involving multiple engineering teams

  • Identify and reduce technical debt across shared front-end infrastructure

  • Define and evolve front-end best practices, standards, and engineering guidelines

  • Improve application reliability, observability, accessibility, and performance

  • Partner with Design to improve consistency and usability across the product

  • Help shape the long-term technical vision for the front-end platform

Platform & Developer Experience

  • Improve shared tooling, component systems, and developer workflows

  • Drive improvements in CI/CD pipelines, testing strategy, local development experience, and review environments

  • Build reusable frameworks and abstractions that accelerate feature development across teams

  • Collaborate on front-end performance optimization and platform-wide UX improvements

  • Help standardize approaches across teams while balancing flexibility and autonomy

  • Collaborate with Product Designers on aligning the UI component library (including patterns and templates) to the latest version of the Design System, while ensuring that the components can be re-used for Claude Code Prototyping by Designers

Engineering Execution

  • Contribute hands-on production code in React and TypeScript

  • Review code and provide high-quality technical feedback

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers throughout the development lifecycle

  • Participate in technical planning, roadmap discussions, and architecture reviews

  • Help unblock teams and provide technical guidance for complex implementation challenges

Mentorship & Influence

  • Mentor engineers across multiple teams

  • Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership and collaboration

  • Influence engineering culture, review quality, and development practices

  • Act as a trusted technical partner for both engineering and product leadership

  • Help grow future technical leaders and architects within the organization

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience building modern web applications used in production at scale

  • Deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and React

  • Strong understanding of modern front-end architecture and application design

  • Experience leading large technical initiatives across multiple teams

  • Experience designing reusable component systems and scalable UI patterns

  • Strong knowledge of application state management, asynchronous data flows, and API integration patterns

  • Experience improving front-end performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across both front-end and full-stack systems

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction

  • Ability to thrive in fast-moving, highly collaborative environments with evolving priorities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building platforms, frameworks, or shared engineering infrastructure

  • Experience with GraphQL and modern API-driven architectures

  • Experience working in a monorepo environment

  • Experience with modern build systems and tooling

  • Familiarity with cloud-native environments and AWS

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog

  • Experience working closely with Product Design and Design Systems

  • Startup experience, particularly in high-growth environments

  • Cybersecurity or offensive security domain experience

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development workflows and engineering tooling

Our Front-End Stack

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • GraphQL

  • GitLab

  • AWS

  • Modern CI/CD pipelines

  • Design systems and shared component libraries

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering teams can move faster because of the systems and foundations you build

  • Front-end experiences become more scalable, consistent, and maintainable

  • Architectural decisions improve long-term product velocity

  • Shared standards and tooling reduce friction across teams

  • Engineers across the organization seek your guidance for complex technical challenges

  • You help shape the future direction of the platform, not just individual features

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful.

 

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State's transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $199,750 - $260,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

 

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

 

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer III
jobs.description_html:
Your Dream. Our Team.

About Rise8

Rise8 builds custom, secure software for government organizations, measuring success by impact: lives saved, time returned, and missions advanced. 

We think big, start small, and scale fast with elite teams across product, design, and engineering to drive continuous delivery for critical missions.

We believe customer experience starts with employee experience, so we take care of our employees. Rise8 is where you’ll do the best work of your career—supported by a culture you won’t find anywhere else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, but what sets us apart is our commitment to autonomy, growth, and a culture rooted in kindness, candor, and continuous learning. 

Certified as a Great Place to Work®, with 100% of employees saying they love working here, Rise8 is where bold ideas become real capabilities. Where mission meets meaning. And where fewer bad things happen because of bad software.

About You

  • You’re mission-driven and measure success by impact (lives saved, time returned, missions advanced), not activity.
  • You think big, start small, and scale fast. You treat time as the biggest vulnerability and security as something that enables speed.
  • You lead with kindness and candor: you give honest feedback, take it well, and raise the bar for everyone around you.
  • You’re an owner. You thrive with autonomy, act decisively, and stay steady when things are uncertain.
  • You're building with AI and see it as a force multiplier not a shortcut.

As a Platform Engineer III at Rise8, you will: 

  • Create and implement automated configuration and deployment processes to enhance the performance, accessibility, and ease of management of the platform and its related services.
  • Establish and manage administrator and service accounts, while also maintaining accurate system documentation and effectively resolving technical issues.
  • Utilize scripting tools to craft self-service capabilities within the Platform as a Service (PaaS), fostering a seamless developer experience for development teams.
  • Collaborate closely with developers to diagnose and troubleshoot problems, ensuring smooth operations.
  • Take on the operational responsibility for the services under your team's ownership.
  • Thrive in an environment that nurtures your personal development and growth.
  • Ability to work "on-call" to support customer needs
  • Continuously enhance the product, delivering software that resonates positively with users and meets their needs effectively.
  • Champion AI-augmented ways of working across your engagement(s), leveraging AI tooling to accelerate delivery, reduce cycle time, and drive better outcomes at scale.

Qualifications 

  • A background of 3-6 years in cloud/platform operations or related roles across diverse environments.
  • Proficiency in administering cloud environments (AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • Expertise in container orchestration, specifically Kubernetes.
  • Proficient use of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools, with a focus on Terraform.
  • Subject Matter Expertise in Linux Operating Systems administration.
  • Skilled in developing automation solutions using scripting languages to streamline recurring tasks.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts and practical experience involving technologies like Load Balancers, DNS, SSL, Firewalls, NAT, and NTP.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot operating systems and applications effectively.
  • Experience handling large-scale production systems and adeptness in resolving production-related challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills, and a keen interest in collaborative work environments.
  • Enthusiasm for skill growth, a penchant for tackling intriguing tasks, and addressing complex issues.
  • A degree (BA/BS) in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance for US Government work.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Proficiency in troubleshooting challenges using the Linux/Unix command line interface.
  • Possession of recognized Professional Certifications such as RHCE, Linux+, MCSA, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Developer, Security+, CISSP, and CCNA.
  • Background in DevOps automation practices.
  • Direct experience in client interaction.

Travel

Position may require up to 25% travel in support of contract performance, customer site visits, and program activities.

Salary 

The annual salary range for this role as it is posted is $143,824 - $179,780 regardless of final candidate location within the United States. The final job level and annual salary will be determined based on the education, qualification, knowledge, skills, ability, and experience of the final candidate(s), and calibrated against relevant market data and internal team equity. 

Benefits 

  • Flexible schedule in a 100% distributed workforce 
  • Premium Insurance: We cover up to 100% of the employee premium and up to 80% of the combined dependent premium on our base health plan, depending on pay band. We also cover 100% of the premium for employee and dependent Dental and Vision as well as employee premiums for Life and Disability coverage.
  • Retirement: 401k match at 10% gross pay.
  • Paid time off (PTO): 4 weeks combined accrued vacation and sick leave, 11 Federal holidays, your birthday, jury duty, and bereavement.
  • Education & Training: Accrued budget of up to $3,500 per year for classes, travel, events, and materials.
  • Home Office and Merch: We offer $750 per year for home office technology and equipment as well as $100 per year for Rise8 merch from our Swag Store.
  • Wellness Budget: To encourage and support a well-rounded healthy lifestyle, we cover 100% reimbursement on a variety of wellness activities and products, up to $500 per calendar year. Or Rise8 is part of the the Life Time Corporate Partner program. In lieu of your $500 annual wellness benefit, you can instead get a $75 monthly credit towards a Life Time membership ($900 annual benefit).
  • Equipment: We offer a MacBook Pro

All of Rise8’s work in this area is with Federal Government customers that require our employees involved with their projects be U.S. citizens. As such, this role requires U.S. citizenship. If hired, you would also be required to go through a background investigation.


Rise8 is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider you for this role regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Data & AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
jobs.description_html:
Role Description

Defense Unicorns is seeking an Applied AI Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on designing, building, and integrating agentic AI capabilities that allow AI models to interact with tools, access enterprise data, execute multi-step workflows, and support mission applications. The engineer will work across LLM integration, agent orchestration, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the interfaces between AI applications and existing software platforms.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with demonstrated experience building agentic AI applications. They should be comfortable entering an evolving architecture, learning unfamiliar systems quickly, working directly with commercial technology partners, and solving difficult problems involving integration, reliability, performance, and security.

This is not a traditional AI research or model development role. The focus is on building reliable, repeatable agentic capabilities that move beyond experimentation into working software in secure and classified environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain agentic AI applications that integrate LLMs, tools, APIs, and enterprise data to support mission workflows.
  • Develop AI agents capable of executing multi-step tasks, interacting with external services, and coordinating actions across existing systems.
  • Implement agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow state management, error handling, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Build and integrate RAG pipelines, semantic search, embeddings, and vector-based retrieval to provide relevant context for AI applications.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using Python and modern software engineering practices.
  • Integrate agentic AI capabilities into existing applications, software delivery workflows, and enterprise platforms.
  • Establish testing, evaluation, monitoring, and reliability practices for AI agents and LLM-powered applications.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to ensure agents can access reliable, relevant, and appropriately governed enterprise data.
  • Work with platform engineers to deploy and operate AI applications within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments and integrate them into CI/CD workflows.
  • Troubleshoot end-to-end issues involving agent behavior, tool execution, APIs, data access, application services, and infrastructure.
  • Work directly with government engineers and commercial technology partners to resolve integration challenges and remove blockers to mission delivery.
  • Develop documentation, reusable components, and operational standards that make successful AI implementation patterns repeatable.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where technologies, security requirements, and mission priorities continue to evolve.

Local to the National Capital Region and able to support onsite work at a government facility in Springfield, VA as mission needs increase.

Clearance & Travel

  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility required
  • Ability to support approximately 2–3 days per week onsite in Springfield, VA, with additional onsite presence as mission needs increase.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Approximately 3–5 years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated technical capability.
  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI applications, including AI agents, LLM tool calling, multi-step workflows, or agent orchestration.
  • Strong proficiency with Python and backend software development.
  • Experience integrating LLMs into applications using APIs, SDKs, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience building and integrating REST APIs and connecting applications with external services or data sources.
  • Understanding of agent workflows, tool execution, state management, and error handling.
  • Experience with Git, testing, debugging, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience working in cloud-native or containerized environments and collaborating with platform engineering teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot application and integration issues across APIs, data services, infrastructure, and AI components.
  • Ability to work independently, rapidly learn new technologies, and translate ambiguous mission needs into working software.
  • GEOINT experience is preferred, not required.

Relevant agentic AI experience may be demonstrated through professional work, internships, research, open-source contributions, or independent projects.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience developing multi-agent systems, autonomous workflows, or AI-enabled software development tools.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), function calling, or other tool integration patterns.
  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.

Mission Focus

Make trusted data available where AI needs it, while establishing the repeatable, secure data patterns required to move from experimentation to operational capability.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States. 

Remote - USA
$148,750—$201,250 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)

  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers

  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description_html:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

We are seeking a talented and experienced Platform Engineer to join our team. Possessing strong proficiency with Kubernetes, the ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our platform, demonstrating a strong understanding of system architecture, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide junior engineers.

As a Platform Engineer within our organization, you will join a team of dedicated unicorns who are focused on advancing freedom and independence globally. Our teams work on various different technical baselines depending on specific engagements. We focus our Products on the Platform layer, but to deliver for our Heroes, we also work IaC automation, security, and implementation.

Responsibilities

You will help us automate and build a runtime Production Environment and serve as a link between the Applications, either custom development, COTS, or OSS, and that environment, advocating best practices and facilitating communication between the application teams and platform teams.

In this position, you will be expected to:

  • Validate Solutions/Implementations: Ensure that solutions and implementations align with the outlined tasks and business requirements. Conduct thorough validations to maintain the integrity and efficiency of the platform.

jobs.description_html:
Senior Platform Engineer

AI Engineering | Forward Deployed Engineering

Role Description

Defense Unicorns is seeking a senior AI Agentic Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on designing, integrating, and operationalizing AI agents and agentic workflows within a secure enterprise environment. The engineer will work across large language models, agent frameworks, enterprise data, APIs, developer tooling, and platform services to turn AI capabilities into reliable, mission-relevant workflows.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who understands both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems and can rapidly translate emerging technologies into working solutions. They should be comfortable experimenting with new models and agent frameworks, integrating agents with enterprise systems and tools, evaluating performance and reliability, and working alongside platform engineers and commercial technology partners.

This is not a research-only role. The focus is on moving from AI concepts and prototypes to secure, useful, repeatable agentic capabilities that can operate in production environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and integrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows using modern LLM and agentic technologies.
  • Develop agent capabilities that interact with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources, developer tools, and mission systems.
  • Integrate models, agents, tools, and enterprise data into secure workflows that can be deployed in controlled and classified environments.
  • Work with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, and related technologies.
  • Develop mechanisms for agents to securely discover, access, reason over, and act upon approved enterprise data and services.
  • Prototype and rapidly evaluate emerging models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities to determine where they can create measurable mission or engineering value.
  • Develop evaluation and testing frameworks for agent accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Implement guardrails and policy controls governing agent behavior, tool access, data access, and human approval points.
  • Integrate agentic capabilities with CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows to support repeatable development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Collaborate with platform engineers to operationalize AI workloads within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
  • Work with commercial AI and technology partners to integrate their capabilities into the broader engineering ecosystem.
  • Troubleshoot issues across models, agent frameworks, APIs, data sources, networking, identity, and infrastructure.
  • Develop reusable patterns for agent deployment, configuration, observability, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
  • Document architectures, integration patterns, agent specifications, evaluation results, and operational procedures.
  • Identify recurring AI engineering challenges that can be standardized, automated, or productized into reusable capabilities.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving agentic AI technologies and assess their applicability to secure government environments.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret clearance.
  • Hands-on experience building applications or systems using large language models and generative AI.
  • Experience designing and implementing AI agents or agentic workflows.
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or another modern programming language.
  • Experience integrating AI systems with APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and external tools.
  • Experience with one or more agent frameworks or orchestration approaches.
  • Working knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience developing software in a Git-based, automated CI/CD environment.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype, test, troubleshoot, and iterate in ambiguous environments.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, APIs, debugging, and system design.
  • Ability to work effectively alongside platform engineers, government personnel, and multiple technology vendors.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool-based agent architectures.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems and agent orchestration.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA, or comparable foundation model ecosystems.
  • Experience with NVIDIA NIM, NeMo, or similar AI inference/model-serving technologies.
  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift AI or Kubernetes-based AI platforms.
  • Experience with agent evaluation and observability frameworks.
  • Experience implementing AI guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop workflows, or AI safety controls.
  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.
  • Experience deploying AI systems in Secret or TS/SCI environments.
  • Experience with disconnected or air-gapped AI environments.
  • Experience integrating AI into developer/DevSecOps workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Xacta, or similar enterprise engineering and compliance tools.
  • Experience working with GPUs, model serving, inference optimization, or AI infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with UDS, Zarf, Pepr, Iron Bank, or similar secure software delivery technologies.
  • Experience taking AI prototypes into repeatable, production-ready capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate new AI technologies quickly and make pragmatic build/buy/integrate decisions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Agentic capabilities move from prototype to mission use quickly, with working agents integrated into real government workflows rather than remaining isolated demos.
  • Agents reliably connect to approved enterprise data, tools, and services, with appropriate identity, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • AI capabilities are measurable and trustworthy, with repeatable evaluation methods for accuracy, reliability, task completion, security, and operational performance.
  • Reusable agent patterns emerge, reducing the engineering required to build and deploy the next agent or AI-enabled workflow.
  • AI integrates cleanly with the broader platform architecture, working effectively across the data, DevSecOps, Kubernetes/OpenShift, model, and application layers rather than creating another technology silo.
  • The engineer becomes a trusted AI technical advisor to the Mission Hero, proactively identifying where agentic technology can create mission value—and equally important, where AI is not the right solution.

Senior Platform Engineer

AI Engineering | Forward Deployed Engineering

Role Description

Defense Unicorns is seeking a senior AI Agentic Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on designing, integrating, and operationalizing AI agents and agentic workflows within a secure enterprise environment. The engineer will work across large language models, agent frameworks, enterprise data, APIs, developer tooling, and platform services to turn AI capabilities into reliable, mission-relevant workflows.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who understands both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems and can rapidly translate emerging technologies into working solutions. They should be comfortable experimenting with new models and agent frameworks, integrating agents with enterprise systems and tools, evaluating performance and reliability, and working alongside platform engineers and commercial technology partners.

This is not a research-only role. The focus is on moving from AI concepts and prototypes to secure, useful, repeatable agentic capabilities that can operate in production environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and integrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows using modern LLM and agentic technologies.
  • Develop agent capabilities that interact with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources, developer tools, and mission systems.
  • Integrate models, agents, tools, and enterprise data into secure workflows that can be deployed in controlled and classified environments.
  • Work with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, and related technologies.
  • Develop mechanisms for agents to securely discover, access, reason over, and act upon approved enterprise data and services.
  • Prototype and rapidly evaluate emerging models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities to determine where they can create measurable mission or engineering value.
  • Develop evaluation and testing frameworks for agent accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Implement guardrails and policy controls governing agent behavior, tool access, data access, and human approval points.
  • Integrate agentic capabilities with CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows to support repeatable development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Collaborate with platform engineers to operationalize AI workloads within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
  • Work with commercial AI and technology partners to integrate their capabilities into the broader engineering ecosystem.
  • Troubleshoot issues across models, agent frameworks, APIs, data sources, networking, identity, and infrastructure.
  • Develop reusable patterns for agent deployment, configuration, observability, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
  • Document architectures, integration patterns, agent specifications, evaluation results, and operational procedures.
  • Identify recurring AI engineering challenges that can be standardized, automated, or productized into reusable capabilities.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving agentic AI technologies and assess their applicability to secure government environments.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret clearance.
  • Hands-on experience building applications or systems using large language models and generative AI.
  • Experience designing and implementing AI agents or agentic workflows.
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or another modern programming language.
  • Experience integrating AI systems with APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and external tools.
  • Experience with one or more agent frameworks or orchestration approaches.
  • Working knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience developing software in a Git-based, automated CI/CD environment.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype, test, troubleshoot, and iterate in ambiguous environments.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, APIs, debugging, and system design.
  • Ability to work effectively alongside platform engineers, government personnel, and multiple technology vendors.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool-based agent architectures.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems and agent orchestration.
  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA, or comparable foundation model ecosystems.
  • Experience with NVIDIA NIM, NeMo, or similar AI inference/model-serving technologies.
  • Experience with Red Hat OpenShift AI or Kubernetes-based AI platforms.
  • Experience with agent evaluation and observability frameworks.
  • Experience implementing AI guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop workflows, or AI safety controls.
  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.
  • Experience deploying AI systems in Secret or TS/SCI environments.
  • Experience with disconnected or air-gapped AI environments.
  • Experience integrating AI into developer/DevSecOps workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Xacta, or similar enterprise engineering and compliance tools.
  • Experience working with GPUs, model serving, inference optimization, or AI infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with UDS, Zarf, Pepr, Iron Bank, or similar secure software delivery technologies.
  • Experience taking AI prototypes into repeatable, production-ready capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate new AI technologies quickly and make pragmatic build/buy/integrate decisions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Agentic capabilities move from prototype to mission use quickly, with working agents integrated into real government workflows rather than remaining isolated demos.
  • Agents reliably connect to approved enterprise data, tools, and services, with appropriate identity, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • AI capabilities are measurable and trustworthy, with repeatable evaluation methods for accuracy, reliability, task completion, security, and operational performance.

  • AI integrates cleanly with the broader platform architecture, working effectively across the data, DevSecOps, Kubernetes/OpenShift, model, and application layers rather than creating another technology silo.
  • The engineer becomes a trusted AI technical advisor to the Mission Hero, proactively identifying where agentic technology can create mission value—and equally important, where AI is not the right solution.

jobs.description_html:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We’re not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

 

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team at LeoLabs. You will be an integral contributor to our cross-functional Insights team. This is a highly collaborative team of approximately 8 engineers and a key part of the broader, 40-person software engineering organization. The Insights team is responsible for customer-facing analytics and integrations with customer systems. This includes user interfaces, integrations between APIs, deploying code to the cloud and to on-site environments, and LeoLabs’ data lake. The team leverages services built and maintained by other teams, including radar development and operations and catalog maintenance.

You will be responsible for building and delivering business services, APIs and customer facing applications and integrations to support our mission.  Your work will facilitate delivery of mission-critical data, empowering customers to make real-time operational decisions that protect and manage objects in low-earth orbit. This role requires solid hands-on experience in both API and service development and the development of rich, interactive user interfaces, with the ability to deliver features across both layers.

Qualifications:

  • B.S., M.S in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Proven experience (3+ years) as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced software development environment.
  • Extensive experience designing, building, testing, deploying and maintaining cloud-based software services and APIs, including those supporting customer-facing applications.
  • Solid experience designing, building and testing rich, interactive user interfaces using TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, CSS and a modern front-end framework, including integration with back-end APIs and services.
  • Significant expertise in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Go, C++.
  • Strong knowledge of software development and testing methodologies, best practices, and industry standards.
  • Experience with cloud environments like AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Experience with databases like Postgres/MySQL.
  • Experience building message-driven applications with tools such as Kafka, RabbitMq and SQS.
  • Solid understanding of Agile workflows and principles.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with various stakeholders.
  • Ability to work on-call outside of normal business hours during critical escalations.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Personnel Security Clearance

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity with deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes, including container orchestration, scaling, and monitoring in cloud environments.
  • Background in Math/Physics, AI/ML, or Orbital mechanics. 
  • Active US security clearance.

 

Within 1 month, you’ll:

  • Complete our onboarding program designed to get you up to speed on our business, vision, and team.
  • Successfully set up local dev environment, tools, and access.
  • Attend sprint ceremonies and shadow code reviews to begin ramping up on Insights codebase and processes.
  • Complete first small, low-risk changes or documentation updates under guidance.

Within 3 months, you’ll:

  • Understand core architecture and dependencies for Insights products.
  • Begin tackling small-to-medium scoped features with coaching and mentoring support from peers.
  • Work comfortably within the team’s agile processes and contribute to task planning and estimation.

Within 6 months, you’ll:

  • Demonstrate solid grasp of team’s architecture, dependencies, and operational practices.
  • Actively contribute to software deliverables with some coaching and mentoring, consistently shipping well-tested, reliable code.
  • Own and drive deliverables to completion, including design and implementation of scoped work.

Within 12 months, you’ll:

  • Demonstrate full proficiency in the team’s tech stack and operational practices.
  • Deliver complex features end-to-end with minimal oversight.
  • Act as a trusted peer through code reviews and helping shape technical discussions and decisions
  • Proactively identify continuous improvement opportunities across the codebase

 

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to San Francisco CA Bay Area with a base salary range of $$118,000–$$139,000 plus bonus and equity. Actual base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s work location, experience, skills, and other applicable factors.

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100 USD monthly wellness benefit to support your health and well-being
  • $300 USD home office setup stipend, available for use within your first six months
  • $75 USD monthly home internet allowance, paid directly through your regular paycheck
  • Individual Development Fund to support training, learning, and professional development
  • Employee Recognition Program to celebrate contributions and achievements across the team
  • Employee Referral Program so you can help us connect with great talent
  • And much more!

 

 

ITAR Requirements 

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC’s website.
