We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.

Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.

Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

As a Senior Engineer, your impact extends beyond individual features. You will shape product and engineering roadmaps by partnering directly with customers, product managers, and across Cloudflare teams. You will write architectural specs that guide engineers inside and outside the team, build systems that reduce complexity for others, and lead complex incident responses. You will be a prime reviewer for large systems, define core product KPIs, and mentor engineers across the organization to elevate our collective engineering practice.

  • Design and build resilient, low-latency systems and core architectures that make web resources Payable for autonomous agents using emerging protocols (x402, WBA, ACP, UCP).
  • Write technical specs (RFCs) and architecture designs that encompass deliverables for developers both within the team and across other Cloudflare engineering groups.
  • Meet directly with customers and Product Management to clarify requirements, define actionable KPIs, and translate business needs into scalable architectural solutions.
  • Architect services to reduce code complexity for the team, ensure seamless recovery from internal and external failures, and improve overall system health observability.
  • Lead complex incident responses, retrospectives, and root-cause analyses while driving initiatives that proactively prevent customer escalations and reduce system alerts.
  • Debug and resolve high-complexity issues spanning multiple teams, services, and protocols, using these opportunities to teach others how to handle similar challenges.
  • Actively mentor engineers, improve engineering and interviewing processes, conduct high-impact spec and code reviews, and share knowledge through technical talks and writings.

  • Broad experience with HTTP, API design, payment protocols/rails, web security, and cryptographic authorization mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated experience defining product KPIs and translating complex customer and product requirements into clear architectural roadmaps.
  • Proven track record of debugging complex distributed system failures that span multiple teams and systems, with a focus on systemic remediation.
  • Strong history of technical mentorship, leading incident retrospectives, and driving process improvements inside and outside your immediate team.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate deep architectural trade-offs, and establish design patterns in an emerging technical domain.
  • Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with experience drafting RFCs and specifications consumed by multiple engineering organizations.

  • Experience architecting high-precision event metering pipelines, usage-based billing engines, outcome verification systems, or revenue attribution tools.

  • Active contributions to open-source payment systems, agent protocols, web standards, or distributed systems projects.

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.

We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.

Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

  • Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and ship solutions in a fast-moving, emerging technical domain.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Bonus Points

  • Fluency in Rust (with a big plus for experience in async Rust) or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, KV).

About the Role

We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.

Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.

This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line

This is a rare "0-to-1" seat: you'll help define the interaction model for a suite of product categories we are largely inventing, with room to shape not just how it looks but what it fundamentally is.

Who you are

Note: A portfolio is not required for this role, but is a bonus. Please include a link to work that shows how you think. The interview process will dive in deeper.

  • A product inventor who works in the medium of design, presenting complex problems to Enterprise customers. You've taken genuinely ambiguous, ill-defined problem spaces and defined what the product should be. You can point to work where the concept was yours.
  • You've had to make a complex, high-dimensional system legible to the people who live in it, whether in security, fraud, observability, developer tools, analytics, network operations, finance, or somewhere equally demanding. You don't need a security background, but you need the mind and craft to go deep in one fast.
  • You use AI fluently in your own craft, and you have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.
  • You bring independent design conviction. You've originated solutions in spaces with little prior art, and you can clearly articulate why a design is right, or why you're pushing back.
  • Exceptional at the full craft — defining the problem, defining the experience requirements, information architecture, and especially data visualization — with enough polish to make it real and compelling.
  • Someone who wants to obsess over a domain. You want to go deep, and are excited about pushing boundaries in a complex space.
  • Comfortable with a blank page. As the first design lead, you'll set your own process and build alongside your peers and engineers.

  • Exposure to security, trust & safety, fraud / ad fraud (IVT), or ML-driven products.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations: Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About the Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer, Ambient AI
jobs.description_html:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

We’re building a next-generation ambient AI platform for healthcare, helping clinicians focus on patient care by automatically capturing, understanding, and structuring clinical conversations in real time.

Our product supports clinicians across the full care workflow, from capturing patient conversations and reviewing AI-generated documentation to coordinating follow-up actions and completing work across mobile and web.

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Product Engineer to build these experiences from end to end. You’ll work across our mobile and web applications, backend services, APIs, and AI-powered workflows, partnering closely with product, design, clinical, and AI teams.

This role is for an engineer who cares deeply about the people using the product. You think beyond whether a feature technically works to whether it is intuitive, responsive, trustworthy, and valuable in a real clinical environment. You’re comfortable moving through the stack to solve the whole problem, whether that means refining an interaction, designing an API, improving a data model, integrating an AI capability, or strengthening the system behind the experience.

Our mobile application is primarily built in Flutter, alongside web applications, browser-based surfaces, and backend services. Flutter experience is helpful but not required. We value strong product engineering judgment, full-stack versatility, and a track record of shipping high-quality user experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own high-impact product experiences from early exploration through launch, measurement, and iteration.

  • Develop new workflows for AI-native healthcare software, including:

    • Real-time transcription and ambient documentation

    • AI-assisted review, editing, and clinical workflows

    • Multimodal inputs and intelligent recommendations

    • Agentic actions that help clinicians complete work

    • Collaborative and cross-device workflows

    • Offline and low-connectivity experiences

  • Work across mobile, web, backend services, and APIs to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences.

  • Partner closely with clinicians, product managers, and designers to understand real-world problems and translate them into simple, thoughtful products.

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to bring model capabilities into production in ways that are responsive, understandable, and trustworthy.

  • Design data models, APIs, and service boundaries that support fast product iteration and reliable user experiences.

  • Build polished interfaces across our Flutter mobile application and web-based surfaces.

  • Own the quality of what you ship, including usability, performance, accessibility, analytics, testing, observability, and release readiness.

  • Improve shared systems and product foundations when they unlock faster or better development, including:

    • Reusable application components and interaction patterns

    • State management and data-fetching primitives

    • Networking, caching, and synchronization

    • Background processing and resilient workflows

    • APIs, services, and asynchronous jobs

    • Logging, monitoring, and product diagnostics

  • Prototype quickly, learn from real usage, and refine experiences using qualitative and quantitative feedback.

  • Help shape product and technical strategy as the Ambient AI product line grows.

  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, product thinking, and craft across the team.

What You Have

  • Professional software development experience, with significant ownership of user-facing products or features.

  • Strong experience building applications across multiple parts of the stack, such as mobile or web clients, backend services, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

  • A track record of taking ambiguous product ideas through technical design, implementation, launch, and iteration.

  • Strong product judgment and attention to interaction quality, usability, performance, and craft.

  • Experience building polished frontend experiences using a modern mobile or web framework.

  • Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, and data models in production.

  • Comfort moving through the stack to solve the most important product or user problem.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Experience collaborating closely with product, design, backend, data, or AI teams.

  • An understanding that reliability, latency, and data integrity are fundamental parts of the user experience.

  • An ownership mindset and bias for action. You identify important problems, create clarity, and drive work through completion.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building AI-native, conversational, agentic, or real-time product experiences.

  • Experience with Flutter and Dart or another cross-platform mobile framework.

  • Experience building modern web applications with JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Experience integrating large language models, transcription systems, or other machine-learning services into production products.

  • Experience with audio or video capture, streaming, transcription, or long-running media workflows.

  • Experience with offline-first applications, background sync, resilient local persistence, or conflict handling.

  • Experience designing event-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, or real-time data pipelines.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation, and measuring feature adoption or usability.

  • Experience with performance optimization, observability, CI/CD, and release automation.

  • Native iOS or Android experience when platform-specific capabilities are needed.

  • Exposure to healthcare, HIPAA, SOC 2, privacy, security, or other regulated environments.

  • Experience with Chrome extensions or workflows that span mobile, browser, and web applications.

Why Join

  • Build a product that directly gives clinicians more time to focus on their patients.

  • Own meaningful problems across the complete product stack, from user interaction to backend execution.

  • Create new product experiences at the intersection of AI, healthcare, mobile, and the web.

  • Work across the full product lifecycle, from understanding user needs to shipping and improving the experience.

  • Solve distinctive engineering challenges involving real-time audio, multimodal AI, offline behavior, agentic workflows, and sensitive clinical data.

  • Have meaningful influence over product direction, technical architecture, and engineering culture.

  • Join at a stage where individual engineers can shape both what we build and how we build it.

  • Grow into broader product, technical, or engineering leadership as the team and platform expand.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.


Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in scaling these orgs through standardized, efficient, effective, and metrics-driven recruiting processes. This role will focus on cultivating strong partnerships across several leaders to find, attract, and retain world-class talent. You will help drive alignment and talent strategy, working with leaders and stakeholders across the business, to ensure we continue building the foundational teams that allow Commure to succeed. The people at Commure will ultimately determine our success and this role will directly impact our ability to deliver on our mission.

This is a hybrid role and requires 3-days in our Mountain View, Los Angeles or San Francisco office.

What You'll Do

  • Identify creative ways to activate and engage passive Talent

  • Utilize data to set benchmarks and metrics to create targeted recruiting strategies, while partnering with Leadership to build top talent teams

  • Apply expertise to meet hiring targets and develop unique full-cycle hiring strategies

  • Work with hiring teams to design interview plans that capture the right signals to hire top talent

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to own design direction for a healthcare domain spanning multiple interacting workflows and product surfaces. You’ll turn ambiguous clinical and operational problems into a clear design agenda, shape product direction with business partners, and lead design from discovery through launch. Your work will connect individual features into holistic, coherent experiences for the people who deliver care and run medical practices.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. You’ll set a clear creative direction for your domain, turning user insights and product strategy into compelling concepts, coherent interaction models, and a vision that helps teams see what’s possible. Through clear communication and mentorship, you’ll help experienced designers and cross-functional partners strengthen their design judgment.

Our design team operates like a studio: we critique work, share approaches, and develop our craft together. We use realistic prototypes and AI-assisted workflows to explore ideas and test assumptions, and clear writing to sharpen our thinking, explain design decisions, and articulate their value to users and the business. We partner closely with product, engineering, and operations to turn that understanding into better healthcare workflows.

Location and travel: This is a full-time role based at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office and occasional travel to client sites for field research and direct user engagement.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the design agenda for a domain. Bring structure to ambiguous problems, connect workflows across product surfaces, and identify the most important opportunities to improve user and business outcomes. Define success with your cross-functional partners and use evidence to assess progress.

  • Shape product direction and roadmaps. Synthesize user research, customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints into a clear point of view. Partner with Product and Engineering to connect a longer-term experience vision to practical, sequenced investments.

  • Set and carry creative direction. Develop a strong point of view on how the product should work, look, and feel. Bring that direction to life through concepts, prototypes, and narratives, then guide the work through critique and implementation, raising the quality bar across teams while giving collaborators room to contribute.

  • Build deep understanding of users and their work. Lead research, including on-site observation and workflow testing, to understand clinical and practice operations. Map interactions across people, processes, and systems; uncover unmet needs and the root causes behind fragmented experiences.

  • Stay hands-on from concept through launch. Create clear interaction models, refined interfaces, and realistic prototypes. Validate ideas with users, address accessibility and edge cases, and work closely with engineers through implementation. Use feedback after launch to improve the experience.

  • Create durable patterns and shared approaches. Identify recurring problems across workflows and contribute reusable patterns, components, and abstractions to the design system. Help teams adopt approaches that improve coherence without ignoring meaningful differences in user needs.

  • Align people around clear decisions. Use design briefs, workflow maps, prototypes, and compelling narratives to explain opportunities and tradeoffs. Resolve competing priorities, coordinate dependencies across teams, and keep partners aligned through execution.

What You Have

  • A track record of domain-level ownership. You’ve led complex, end-to-end product design with impact across multiple workflows and teams. You can show how you helped define the problem, shaped direction, and stayed accountable through delivery and iteration.

  • Creative vision grounded in product judgment. You can move beyond incremental improvements to imagine better ways of working. Your portfolio shows how you established a direction, inspired others to build on it, and carried the strongest ideas into a shipped experience, including the tradeoffs you made and the outcomes of your work.

  • Exceptional interaction and visual craft. You simplify complex workflows without losing essential detail. Your work demonstrates strong information architecture, clear interaction models, thoughtful visual hierarchy, and attention to accessibility, edge cases, and error prevention.

  • Strong research, framing, and systems thinking. You turn incomplete information and conflicting requests into actionable insights and design opportunities. You build deep domain expertise and reason about how users, business operations, and technical systems interact.

  • Influence beyond your own execution. You’ve aligned cross-functional partners, mentored experienced designers, and improved the quality or effectiveness of work across teams. You can build trust, challenge assumptions constructively, and help others make sound decisions.

  • Clear writing and compelling storytelling. You can frame a problem in a design brief, articulate a domain-level vision, and explain decisions to design, technical, business, and customer audiences.

  • Applied experience with AI-assisted design and prototyping. You use tools such as Figma and AI-assisted development environments to explore concepts and build realistic prototypes, including code-based prototypes when appropriate. You can show how these workflows improved learning, quality, or speed, while protecting sensitive information and critically reviewing outputs. This expectation is about making ideas testable, not owning production engineering.

  • Ownership and sound judgment under ambiguity. You proactively identify work that matters, prioritize competing workstreams, communicate commitments, and balance speed with quality. You bring genuine curiosity about healthcare and the judgment to work in a high-trust environment.

What we offer

  • Meaningful ownership of complex healthcare problems, with influence over product direction and the opportunity to see your work through to real-world use.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter - GTM
jobs.description_html:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on

Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.

By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.

About the Role

Corelight is hiring a Senior Recruiter, GTM to help build the teams that drive our growth and customer success.

This role will primarily support hiring across Sales, Customer Success, and other go-to-market functions in the US and globally. You'll partner closely with senior GTM leaders to understand their business, translate hiring needs into effective talent strategies, and independently lead searches from intake through close.

We're looking for an experienced in-house recruiter who brings strong judgment, knows how to find and assess exceptional GTM talent, and has experience operating in a fast-paced SaaS startup or growth-stage environment.

This is a highly autonomous role. You'll be expected to bring a point of view, use market intelligence to influence search strategy, and take ownership of hiring outcomes rather than simply managing a recruiting process. While GTM will be your primary focus, we value recruiters who are versatile and willing to flex across the business, including G&A or technical hiring, as priorities evolve.

What You'll Do

  • Independently own full-cycle recruiting across Sales, Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and other GTM functions from intake through offer and close.
  • Partner with hiring leaders to understand business needs, define success in the role, and translate those expectations into targeted candidate profiles and search strategies.
  • Build talent maps and proactive pipelines across US and global markets, using market intelligence to inform and adjust your approach.
  • Independently assess candidates and provide hiring leaders with clear, evidence-based recommendations on strengths, risks, and overall fit.
  • Serve as a trusted talent advisor, bringing market insights, constructively challenging assumptions, and influencing hiring decisions.
  • Design and lead structured interview processes that support consistent, evidence-based candidate evaluation.
  • Manage search priorities, pipeline health, stakeholder communication, and risks proactively, maintaining clear visibility into progress and next steps.
  • Own candidate engagement, offer strategy, negotiations, and closing while delivering a strong candidate experience.
  • Recognize when a search isn't working, diagnose the issue, and adapt quickly to maintain momentum.
  • Flex into G&A, technical, or other recruiting priorities as business needs evolve, and contribute to building scalable practices across the TA team.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong focus on Sales, Customer Success, and other GTM functions.
  • 3+ years of in-house recruiting experience within a SaaS startup or growth-stage technology company.
  • Demonstrated success in competitive talent markets through proactive sourcing, talent mapping, and building passive candidate pipelines.
  • Experience partnering with senior Sales, Customer Success, and GTM leaders as a trusted talent advisor.
  • Strong business acumen and recruiting judgment, with the ability to independently assess talent and provide evidence-based hiring recommendations.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into candidate profiles, sourcing strategies, and structured selection processes.
  • Proven ability to independently manage complex searches while maintaining urgency, operational accuracy, and a strong candidate experience.
  • Versatility to support hiring outside GTM, including G&A or technical roles, is a strong plus.
  • Experience recruiting across global markets is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Notice of Pay Transparency:
The compensation for this position may vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. Depending on the nature and seniority of the role, a percentage of compensation may come in the form of a commission-based or discretionary bonus. Equity and additional benefits will also be awarded.

Compensation Range
$142,000—$193,000 USD

Why Join Us? 

Fueled by investments from top-tier venture capital organizations such as Crowdstrike, Accel and Insight, Corelight is one of the fastest growing network detection and response platforms in the industry.  Our passionate team thrives in a collaborative, inclusive, and geographically distributed culture. We embrace diverse perspectives, neurodiversity, curiosity and low ego results - fostering an environment where every innovator can solve the toughest challenges in cybersecurity and contribute their best work.

We are looking forward to meeting you. Check us out at www.corelight.com

jobs.description_html:
Why Join Doppel

Doppel is built to outsmart one of the great threats AI presents: mass-manufactured social engineering. Countless scams, deepfakes, and other social engineering attacks are surging across every digital channel: websites, social media, ads, encrypted messaging apps, mobile, and more. Our mission is simple but bold: make the internet a safer place by outsmarting the world’s fastest-evolving digital threats.

Backed by a16z and Bessemer and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands (OpenAI, United Airlines, Coinbase, etc.), Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to elevate every aspect of UI/UX across our core product platform. You’ll work closely with our lead designer to create a cohesive, performant, and modern user experience that instills confidence and trust in enterprise customers. Your work will directly influence seven-figure deals and how customers and internal teams interact with our product.

What You'll be Doing

Doppel's Frontend Platform team is building toward something that hasn't really been done: a frontend platform so complete that product teams no longer need to do frontend development. Designers and product engineers describe what they want; the platform — a rigorously constrained design system, agent-driven code generation, and paved-road infrastructure with permissions, telemetry, turns it into production code. We've already proven the foundation works: our modern stack (React 19, Relay, a custom UI kit with agent-enforced golden paths) is explicitly designed so AI agents generate reviewable, production-safe frontend code. Your job is to close the remaining gap between design and production. This is a small team with an ambitious, still-forming charter at a company rapidly expanding its product portfolio — you'll shape what it becomes, and every product Doppel ships will run on what you build.

  • Build and maintain the frontend infrastructure every product runs on: the application shell, data layer, routing, auth, and build/deploy pipeline — so product teams ship features, not frontend plumbing.

  • Evolve the design system from a component library into a contract: constrained, composable primitives with tokens, docs, and guardrails tight enough that generated code is correct by construction.

  • Build the design-to-production pipeline: the tooling, agent workflows, and review guardrails that let designers and product teams go from a design to a shipped, production-quality surface without hand-writing frontend code.

  • Make the platform safe by default: permissioning and packaging gates, observability, accessibility, and internationalization baked into the primitives rather than re-implemented per feature.

  • Own production health of the shared client: monitors, SLOs, and ownership routing so failures page the right team automatically and the platform stays trustworthy enough to build on blindly.

  • Package the platform for scale: a versioned component library and scaffolding that lets new apps and product surfaces spin up on the paved road from day one.

  • Partner closely with design and product teams as your customers — their velocity is your success metric.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in React and TypeScript, building and operating production web applications.

  • Experience owning platform-level frontend work: design systems, component libraries, build tooling, data-layer patterns (Relay or similar GraphQL clients), or frontend infrastructure other engineers build on.

  • Genuine excitement about AI-assisted development — you see agents as a way to raise the abstraction level of frontend work, and you want to build the rails that make that safe.

  • A platform mindset: you measure success by what other teams (and designers) can ship without you, not by features you shipped yourself.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity — the team's charter is being defined in real time as the company grows, and you'll shape it rather than inherit it.

  • Familiarity with production monitoring and performance work (RUM, SLOs, error budgets) is a strong plus.

  • Experience collaborating deeply with designers — design tokens, Figma workflows, Storybook-driven development — is a strong plus.

  • Strong communication skills: your customers are product teams, designers, and backend platform engineers.

  • Product-minded, highly autonomous, and comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll define how our users, customers and internal teams, experience Doppel’s core platform. Your work will directly shape the look, feel, and velocity of the company’s most visible product surface.

What We Offer

🚀 A mission-driven culture with low ego, high ownership, deep customer obsession, and exceptional talent density

🍽️ Free lunch and dinner in the office

🌴 Flexible PTO

✈️ Quarterly team offsites

Join Doppel

Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective.

We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. Agency experience serving cybersecurity or high-growth tech plus in-house startup experience is the ideal combination.

Sound interesting? Let’s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Infrastructure / MongoDB
jobs.description_html:
About Endor Labs

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Own MongoDB and BigQuery Day 0 and Day 2 Operations: Take data infrastructure from first principles through steady state — initial cluster/dataset design and provisioning, then the ongoing work of monitoring, performance tuning, access management, and incident response once it's live.
  • Drive MongoDB Scaling Strategy: Design and execute sharding strategies for our largest collections — shard key selection, zone-based placement, chunk rebalancing — so the platform scales well past its current size without a painful re-architecture.
  • Instrument the Stack with Telemetry: Add metrics, logging, and tracing across different parts of our infrastructure — including MongoDB and BigQuery — so the team has the visibility to catch problems before they become incidents.
  • Build Cloud Infrastructure at Scale: Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure on Azure and Google Cloud that processes billions of security events daily.
  • Work Across Kubernetes & the CNCF Ecosystem: Operate resilient, self-healing infrastructure using Kubernetes and ArgoCD, and help architect multi-tenant clusters that keep customer workloads isolated.
  • Advance Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain Terraform/OpenTofu modules that let the team provision infrastructure safely and consistently through GitOps workflows.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Security, Backend, and Product Engineering so the platform's data layer keeps up with the rest of the product.
  • Iterate and Innovate: Ship infrastructure improvements weekly, balancing speed with reliability as the platform grows.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Hands-On MongoDB Experience, Day 0 and Day 2: 4+ years operating MongoDB (MongoDB Atlas included) in production — sharding, replica set design, index strategy, backup and restore — across the full lifecycle, from standing up a cluster to keeping it healthy at scale.
  • A Track Record of Scaling MongoDB: You've redesigned a shard key, rebalanced chunks, or re-architected zone placement on a cluster that outgrew its original design, and you know the tradeoffs each option carries.
  • Battle-Tested SRE Experience: 5+ years of Site Reliability Engineering or Platform Engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating production infrastructure. You've been on call and resolved critical incidents.
  • Kubernetes Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and the CNCF ecosystem in production, including debugging multi-cluster networking issues.
  • Cloud Native Engineer: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS — in that order of preference).
  • Infrastructure as Code Practitioner: Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, OpenTofu, or Terragrunt, including reusable modules and state management at scale.
  • Observability Advocate: Hands-on experience with Prometheus and Grafana, including designing SLIs/SLOs and dashboards that help teams operate distributed systems.
  • Clear Communicator: Able to explain complex technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to document decisions so others can build on them.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • MongoDB Atlas Depth: Experience with Atlas-specific capabilities such as Atlas Search, Provisioned Throughput, and the Atlas Admin API, or a track record of building custom tooling to close gaps in a platform's native monitoring.
  • Monorepo Experience: Familiarity with managing infrastructure for large monorepos, including build optimization and caching strategies. Bonus points if you've worked with Bazel, Nx, or similar tooling.
  • GitOps Practitioner: Hands-on experience implementing GitOps workflows with ArgoCD or Flux.
  • Security Mindset: Experience building secure infrastructure and understanding compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR) without sacrificing developer velocity.
  • Performance Optimization: Track record of optimizing infrastructure costs and performance.
  • GitHub Actions & Bazel: Experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines, and familiarity with Bazel for monorepo builds.

Why Endor Labs

We're building at the intersection of developer productivity and security, one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our developer-loved platform delivers measurable ROI, strong market momentum, and a customer base that deeply values our mission.

At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with customer success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way, because when our customers win, we all win.

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't meet every single requirement listed above, we strongly encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives, transferable skills, and a passion for learning.

jobs.description_html:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

jobs.description_html:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Senior Technical Product Manager, API Traffic and Enforcement

APIs are how software talks to software, and the volume and variety of that traffic is growing rapidly. AI agents now discover and call APIs directly, and MCP servers are a new kind of endpoint with the same questions attached: what exists, what it's supposed to do, and who is allowed to call it. Enterprises are challenged to respond to those questions. This role owns Fastly's answer.

As a Senior Technical Product Manager on Fastly's Core Infrastructure Product Management team, you will own how Fastly defines what traffic is allowed and how traffic is held to that definition. That means our customers' API surface end to end – discovery and inventory of the APIs they actually run, the schemas that describe intended behavior, and the API gateway itself – and the enforcement primitives underneath it, including ACLs, allowlists, rate limiting, and the request-path controls that turn a declared model into something the platform actually enforces. Much of security is about detecting the bad. Your charter is the other half: defining what good looks like and enforcing it.

Customer APIs are the first and largest surface for the positive model, and the primitives you own are the ones other products adopt as that model extends across the platform. This role reports to the Director of Core Infrastructure Product Management and has real latitude to set direction.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the positive model end to end: drive the strategy and roadmap for defining what traffic is allowed. You will take customers from not knowing what APIs they run, to describing intended behavior precisely, to enforcing it in the request path.
  • Make API discovery tell customers something they didn't know: own discovery and inventory across the API surfaces customers actually operate. Discovery is where most customers start, and how good it is determines whether they trust anything built on top of it.
  • Turn schemas into enforceable contracts: own schema definition, generation, and validation. When customers can't hand you an accurate spec for their own APIs, the product has to produce one worth enforcing against, then keep it accurate as their APIs change.
  • Own enforcement in the request path: ACLs, allowlists, rate limiting, and the controls that turn a declared model into something the platform enforces, along with the gateway that applies them. Build these as primitives other products can adopt, not features scoped to one surface.
  • Make agents first-class: agents calling APIs are a new kind of client, and MCP servers are a new kind of endpoint. Define how Fastly identifies them, authorizes them, and holds them to allowed behavior.
  • Take and defend clear positions: bring evidence-based points of view on how traffic should be described and constrained, and drive them to decisions across engineering, product, and partner teams. You will bring structure to ambiguous problems and move decisions forward earlier.

What We're Looking For: 

  • Experience: 5+ years in product management or technical product leadership, ideally on API, security, or platform infrastructure products.
  • API and request-path fluency: you understand how API traffic is described, validated, and constrained — schemas and specs, gateway behavior, and the difference between allowlist models and detection-based ones. You can reason about where each fits and what it costs to run.
  • Platform thinking: a track record of building capabilities that serve more than one product or team. Shared primitives, enforcement points, or controls others build on, rather than features scoped to a single surface.
  • Execution focus: a demonstrated bias for shipping. You are hands-on and comfortable owning outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving conditions rather than waiting for perfect clarity.
  • Conviction and influence: the ability to form clear, evidence-based positions and defend them across engineering and product partners, including pushing back constructively. You build alignment without relying on authority.
  • Communication and presentation: a clear communicator who can move between deep technical discussion with engineers and crisp framing for customers and executives, with genuine curiosity about the "why" behind a customer's problem. You can stand up in front of a room, make a case, and hold it under questioning.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: 

  • Hands-on work with API gateways and OpenAPI-driven validation: schema generation from live traffic, drift detection as APIs change, and the gap between the spec a team publishes and what their API actually does.
  • The agentic traffic stack — workload and agent identity (SPIFFE/WIMSE, mTLS), OAuth 2.1 for delegated agent authorization, and agent protocols like MCP and its authorization spec.
  • Request-path enforcement at scale: WASM filters, eBPF, or policy engines like OPA and Rego.
  • Startup or 0-to-1 experience building API, security, or infrastructure products in a fast-moving environment.

Staff Product Manager, Compliance

For a growing share of Fastly's customers, compliance is the gate in front of every other decision: where data lives, who can see it, and what they can prove afterward. This role is responsible for defining and driving what Fastly's platform gives customers to get through that gate. 

As a Staff Product Manager on Fastly's Core Infrastructure Product Management team, you will own compliance as a shared capability of the platform: the controls in the control plane, the residency and sovereignty behavior customers configure, and the evidence and attestation surfaces they use directly to satisfy their own auditors and regulators. You will define these across Fastly’s platform, rather than solving the same problem separately for multiple products. 

You will determine what Fastly's products must do so customers can meet their obligations, then carry those decisions through engineering, security, legal, and go-to-market. You will translate regulation into requirements and take clear positions on what to build and what not to. This role has broad latitude and real ownership, reporting to the Director of Core Infrastructure Product Management.


What You'll Do:

  • Own compliance as a platform capability: define the strategy and roadmap for what Fastly must provide so customers can satisfy compliance and regulatory requirements. You will set the multi-year view, prioritize the investments that open regulated segments and unblock opportunities, and synthesize customer needs, regulatory shifts, field input, and market signals into a defensible set of priorities.
  • Define residency and sovereignty requirements: own what customers need to control about where their data lives and where it moves, and turn that into requirements the platform is built to. Set the standard consistently rather than per product.
  • Build the evidence customers can pull themselves: define the attestation and evidence surfaces customers use directly to show their auditors and regulators what happened to their data, when, and why. Make proof a product capability rather than a support request.
  • Specify governance and control in the control plane: define what customers need to control, inspect, and demonstrate about how their configuration is set and changed – the capabilities that let them satisfy their own internal and external oversight, consistently across products.
  • Get ahead of what's coming: track the regulatory shifts that change what your customers must comply with, including sovereignty regimes, privacy law, and emerging AI governance, and turn them into product requirements before they stall a deal or block adoption.
  • Align partners and drive decisions: bring engineering, security, legal, and go-to-market to a shared view of what customers require, frame the tradeoffs, and drive decisions to closure. You will bring structure to problems that arrive without it, and connect complex requirements to clear customer outcomes.

What We're Looking For: 

  • Experience: 8+ years in product management or technical product leadership, ideally on infrastructure, platform, or security products, including ambiguous challenges that crossed organizational boundaries.
  • Regulatory fluency: a working understanding of the regulations that shape enterprise software – data residency and sovereignty, privacy regimes such as GDPR and CCPA, and emerging AI governance – and the ability to turn what a customer must comply with into concrete product requirements.
  • Precision: the ability to take a compliance requirement — a law, a contractual term, an auditor's ask — and pin down exactly what it obligates, then define the narrowest product capability that fully satisfies it. You know the difference between what a rule requires and what people assume it requires, and you don't over- or under-build against it.
  • Technical fluency: enough command of control planes, configuration models, and how data moves through a platform to set well-grounded requirements and earn engineers' trust.
  • Collaborative leadership: a proven ability to lead without authority and build the relationships that make cross-functional work move. 
  • Communication and presentation: a clear, confident communicator who can move between detailed requirements discussions with engineers and crisp strategic framing for executives, customers, and go-to-market partners. You can stand up in front of a room, make a case, and hold it under questioning.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: 

  • Reasoning about data residency in systems that cache, replicate, or fail over by design
  • Turning an audit requirement into something a customer can pull themselves, such as with tamper-evident logs, immutable configuration history, or machine-readable attestation
  • Making a product call on a regulatory requirement before the interpretation settles
  • Regulated verticals such as finance, healthcare, or public sector, and the frameworks their customers are held to, including PCI DSS, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or the sector-specific rules that set the bar

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager, Runtimes
jobs.description_html:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: Jul 22, 2026

Anticipated Posting Close Date*: Aug 21, 2026

*Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

 

Staff Technical Product Manager, Runtimes

The internet is being reshaped by AI, automation, and machine traffic. One of the defining infrastructure questions of the next decade is how and where code runs. This role owns Fastly's answer.

As a Staff Technical Product Manager on Fastly's Core Infrastructure Product Management team, you will manage Compute and VCL as a single, coherent runtime surface. These are how customers execute code close to their users, origins, APIs, and security enforcement points. You will define where these runtimes converge, where they stay purpose-built, and what primitives they share, turning a set of powerful execution models into one platform customers can understand, adopt, and trust for production workloads. This role reports to the Director of Core Infrastructure Product Management and has real latitude to set the runtime direction of the platform.

We're looking for someone who pairs a builder's bias for shipping with the judgment to take strong, well-reasoned positions on the runtime future of Fastly.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the runtime surface end-to-end: define and drive the strategy and roadmap for Fastly's runtimes, including Compute and VCL. Define where they converge, where they remain purpose-built, and what primitives they should share. You will own runtime and interoperability strategy and reduce duplicated abstractions so the platform feels like one.

  • Scale Compute for demanding workloads: enhance Compute as a runtime and platform surface – the primitives, predictable limits, and reliability customers depend on as they run larger and more critical workloads. Keep the runtime behaving as intended under real-world conditions.

  • Expand the runtime surface: bring new execution models onto Fastly as native runtime workloads, defining how they run on the platform and fit alongside Compute and VCL.

  • Define how runtimes meet the AI era: AI workloads, machine traffic, and new execution patterns are changing what customers need from a runtime platform. You will get ahead of that shift, building the primitives and controls customers will need before they know to ask for them.

  • Take and defend strong positions: bring clear, evidence-based points of view on runtime direction and drive them to a decision across Engineering, Product, and leadership. You will build alignment without relying on authority.

  • Execute across boundaries: partner closely with the Core Infrastructure technical lead on runtime direction, with go-to-market functions so customers can adopt what you build, and with the hybrid/on-prem team where runtimes extend into customer-controlled environments. You will bring structure to ambiguous problems and move decisions forward earlier.

What We're Looking For: 

  • Experience: 8+ years in product management or technical product leadership, ideally on infrastructure, platform, or developer-facing products.

  • Runtime and systems fluency: deep understanding of execution environments, including runtimes, containers, isolation models, serverless or edge compute, and the trade-offs between them. You can reason credibly about how code executes, where the constraints live, and why one model beats another for a given workload.

  • Execution focus: a demonstrated bias for shipping. You are hands-on and comfortable owning outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving conditions rather than waiting for perfect clarity.

  • Conviction and influence: a proven ability to form strong technical opinions, defend them with evidence, and lead without authority, including pushing back constructively. You are a force multiplier who raises the technical bar around you.

  • Communication and presence: a clear, confident communicator who can move fluidly between deep technical discussion with engineers and crisp strategic framing for executives and customers.

  • Customer empathy: genuine curiosity about the "why" behind customer problems, and the ability to translate runtime capabilities into developer productivity and business value.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these: 

  • Startup or 0-to-1 experience building and shipping technical products in resource-constrained environments.

  • A hands-on background with runtime and isolation technology, including container platforms, the WebAssembly component model and WASI 0.3, Firecracker or comparable microVM and sandboxing stacks, or similar execution engines.

  • Experience with edge compute, developer platforms, or runtime interoperability at scale.

Work Hours: This position will require you to be available during core business hours. 

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements: 

This position is open to Hybrid And Remote Work Locations.

The preferred locations for this position are:

  • New York, NY
  • San Francisco, CA
  • Denver, CO

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.  

There is a strong preference for Hybrid near a local office.  However, we may be willing to consider remote candidates within the US.

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Salary:

The estimated salary range for this position is $211,370.00 to $253,644.00.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs.

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings? 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 12 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days.

  • We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering multi-disciplinary evidence-based obesity treatment through telemedicine. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, and although historically only about 1% of patients received medical treatment for their disease, the field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth. Form Health provides high-quality expert care and leverages technology to enhance the patient experience. All Form Health patients work closely with their care team, which includes board certified physicians, advanced practice professionals and Registered Dietitians. Through our proprietary mobile app patients engage in regular video visits, as well as text messaging, photo journaling, digital data transmission, and customized educational materials. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect. 

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed innovative startup with an experienced clinical and leadership team. Our mission is to empower patients and be leaders in Obesity Medicine driving impact at a national scale. We are deeply invested in our core value to put patients first, and also deeply committed to creating a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and improve together.

 

About the Role:

The Care Delivery team builds the tools that let our clinical team run a high-performing virtual practice — from prescribing and prior authorizations to the day-to-day workflows clinicians rely on to do their best work with patients. This role is highly visible within Form Health: the tools you ship directly shape how our clinical team practices and, downstream, how our patients experience care. We're looking for someone who's genuinely energized by hard, regulated, multi-stakeholder problems — with clinical, patient, payer, and operational constraints — as well as someone who uses AI as a real part of supercharging their work, rather than a buzzword on a resume.

This role will report to our Lead Product Manager for Care Delivery, with significant ownership from day one and plenty of room to help shape how the practice scales as the team grows. This role is fully remote and can be located anywhere in the U.S. (Note: while not required, it is beneficial to be in or close to the Eastern Time zone given frequent collaboration with our Boston-based clinical and operations leaders)

What You Will Do:

  • Deeply understand Form Health's clinical and business needs: identify and prioritize jobs-to-be-done using research and user feedback
  • Own key care delivery capabilities end-to-end — e.g., prescribing, prior authorizations, virtual visit workflows 
  • Partner with clinical leadership to triage and prioritize incoming product requests, balancing clinical needs against broader roadmap priorities
  • Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements, including user stories, use cases, and functional specs
  • Partner with engineering, design, operations, and clinical teams to ship best-in-class tools for our clinical practice
  • Track key program and product metrics for your area, and report on progress and health to Form Health's leadership team
  • Facilitate sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, and  retrospectives to keep the team aligned and shipping
  • Partner with clinical education and enablement to roll out new features  smoothly — change management, communications, and training
  • Identify where AI and automation can responsibly reduce clinical or administrative burden (e.g., documentation, prior-auth workflows, care coordination), and partner with engineering to evaluate and ship those capabilities thoughtfully

About You:

  • 5+ years building enterprise experiences with complex workflows
  • Comfortable diving into technical problems — APIs, workflows spanning homegrown and third-party systems
  • Clear communicator cross-functionally in a remote-first environment
  • A track record that includes:
    • Evaluating third-party vendors and driving coordination across multiple systems
    • Defining where a product should go, rallying a team behind it, and delivering results iteratively
    • Owning a product area end-to-end — strategy and prioritization through rollout and adoption
  • Fluent in using AI as part of your own PM craft — drafting specs, synthesizing research, prototyping — and curious about where AI can responsibly augment clinical operations
  • Proactive ownership over your area of responsibility, with a strong sense of accountability and an execution-oriented mindset — comfortable applying structure to ambiguous situations in a fast-growing startup
  • Genuinely excited to make compassionate, evidence-based healthcare accessible — and energized, not deterred, by the complexity of a regulated, high-stakes domain

Preferred:

  • Understanding of healthcare, virtual care delivery, or health insurance 
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features, ideally within a tech-enabled services organization
  • Prior experience in a startup and/or high growth environment

More about Form Health’s benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity in a high growth start-up
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) 
  • 401k program
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off
  • Paid parental leave

 

Base Annual Salary
$150,000—$180,000 USD

Form Health’s commitment to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment:

Form Health is committed to creating a culture and environment that celebrates diversity and inclusion, while fostering safety and belonging. This extends from our remote patient care to our corporate offices and everywhere in between. We are looking for team members who want to help us further our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) efforts and who share our attitudes for creating an inclusive, safe, and positive work environment. 

Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States by their start date. Form Health does not provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position.
