jobs.title: Senior Compliance Program Manager, GRC
jobs.description_html:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Compliance Program Manager to join our CISO organization and help drive regulatory compliance, audit readiness and security governance across Keeper’s enterprise and federal environments. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help strengthen the compliance and governance programs that support Keeper’s enterprise and public sector customers.

 

About Keeper

 

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices, and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, including FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate Authorization, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why federal agencies, including NASA and the DOJ, trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.    



About the Role

As a Senior Compliance Program Manager, you will manage complex compliance and governance initiatives across Keeper’s enterprise and regulated environments, including FedRAMP High and DoD IL5.

You will be responsible for coordinating audit cycles, continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, third-party risk, policy governance, security training and supporting documentation. You will work closely with control owners and security leadership to translate regulatory requirements into clear plans, operational processes and accountable workstreams. This role requires strong compliance expertise combined with disciplined program management. You will maintain integrated plans, track risks and dependencies, drive cross-functional accountability and ensure documentation, training and evidence remain accurate, complete and audit-ready.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and manage compliance programs across audit cycles, continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, policy initiatives and supporting documentation
  • Establish program scope, milestones, dependencies, ownership and reporting across Security, Engineering, DevOps, IT and GRC
  • Maintain integrated program plans, risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies and escalate blockers with clear recommendations
  • Coordinate evidence collection, remediation tracking and control-owner activities for compliance and audit initiatives
  • Maintain working knowledge of frameworks including NIST 800-53, FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS
  • Partner with GRC and ISSO stakeholders on audit readiness, control documentation, remediation and continuous monitoring activities
  • Monitor evolving regulatory and security requirements and assess potential business and operational impact
  • Support compliance responses for customers, contracts, security reviews and RFPs
  • Support and help mature Keeper’s third-party risk management program, including risk-tiered assessments of vendors and business partners
  • Review vendor security documentation, attestations and supply chain risk factors and provide risk-based recommendations
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal and business owners on security requirements, contract terms and remediation expectations
  • Maintain the third-party risk register and track remediation, risk acceptance and program metrics
  • Author, maintain and govern information security policies, standards, procedures and control narratives
  • Support System Security Plan documentation and other compliance-related technical documentation
  • Develop and maintain information security training for employees and role-specific audiences including developers, administrators, privileged users and incident responders
  • Manage training lifecycle activities including scheduling, learning management system administration, completion tracking, phishing simulation and audit evidence
  • Develop training materials, job aids, scenarios and assessments in partnership with subject matter experts
  • Measure and report training effectiveness using completion, assessment and behavioral metrics
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to validate technical information and maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation
  • Translate complex technical and regulatory information into clear documentation for auditors, leadership and internal stakeholders
  • Mentor team members and cross-functional partners on compliance processes and documentation practices
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve regulatory research, documentation, analysis, training development and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in information security compliance, governance, risk, audit, program management or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience leading audits, assessments or compliance initiatives involving NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar frameworks
  • Strong working knowledge of NIST 800-53 Rev. 5, NIST RMF, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and related compliance requirements
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional compliance programs from planning through completion
  • Experience supporting regulated or federal cloud environments, ideally including FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5 or similar requirements
  • Experience with authorization documentation such as System Security Plans, POA&Ms, continuous monitoring artifacts or related evidence
  • Experience supporting or managing third-party risk management programs
  • Experience developing and governing information security policies, standards and procedures
  • Experience developing or delivering information security training for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong program management skills including planning, scheduling, risk and issue management, dependency tracking and stakeholder communication
  • Strong documentation governance skills, including managing reviews, approvals, versioning and controlled release
  • Strong ability to interpret technical and regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable operational guidance
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience communicating with executives, auditors and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent initiatives and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to support compliance research, documentation, analysis and program execution
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Technical Communication or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • At least one relevant professional certification such as PMP, CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGRC or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience supporting FedRAMP High or DoD IL5 authorization and continuous monitoring activities
  • Experience with NIST 800-53 AT controls and security awareness or role-based training programs
  • Experience with supply chain risk management and vendor security assessments
  • Familiarity with security contract requirements, data protection addenda and federal flow-down requirements
  • Experience with phishing simulation platforms, learning management systems or compliance automation platforms
  • Experience preparing customer-facing compliance or security responses
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-50, NIST SP 800-16 or related security training guidance
  • Additional security, audit, risk or project management certifications

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (IL5 / FedRAMP High)
jobs.description_html:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with direct experience building and managing infrastructure in IL5-compliant environments. This is a 100% remote position, with the opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and bring your IL5 DevOps expertise to mission-critical work.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for organizations globally with zero-trust privileged access management built with end-to-end encryption. Keeper’s cybersecurity solutions are FedRAMP and StateRAMP Authorized, SOC 2 compliant, FIPS 140-2 validated, as well as ISO 27001, 27017 and 27018 certified. Keeper deploys in minutes, not months, and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack to prevent breaches, reduce help desk costs and ensure compliance. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is the leader for password, passkey and secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. Learn how our zero-trust and zero-knowledge solutions defend against cyber threats at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer who thrives in high-security, compliance-driven environments. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation within IL5 / FedRAMP High deployments. You will collaborate closely with security engineering, platform engineering, and compliance teams to deliver highly available, resilient, and audit-ready systems in AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government environments. This is a senior technical role requiring experience operating hardened environments, automating infrastructure under strict compliance controls, and designing secure cloud architectures.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage IL5 / FedRAMP High–compliant infrastructure in AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices
  • Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines that meet IL5 and FedRAMP High compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls, monitoring, and reporting
  • Configure logging, alerting, and telemetry in restricted and hardened environments
  • Harden operating systems and container runtimes in accordance with DISA STIGs, CIS benchmarks, and security best practices
  • Support secure secrets management, access controls (RBAC, ABAC), and audit logging
  • Participate in architecture discussions to ensure infrastructure is scalable, resilient, and compliant
  • Assist with documentation, evidence collection, and remediation activities supporting ATO (Authority to Operate) processes

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering roles
  • Hands-on experience operating IL5 or FedRAMP High–compliant environments (required)
  • Deep familiarity with AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government
  • Strong experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages
  • Experience building secure CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
  • Knowledge of STIG hardening, CIS benchmarks, and compliance automation
  • Understanding of zero-trust architectures and secure enclave design
  • Ability to work collaboratively with security, platform, and compliance stakeholders
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and sound judgment in high-pressure operational scenarios
  • Due to this role’s involvement in IL5 and other U.S. Government cloud environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience contributing to an ATO for a FedRAMP or DoD deployment
  • Experience running Kubernetes in high-compliance environments
  • Familiarity with secrets management solutions such as HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, or similar
  • Exposure to vulnerability scanning, compliance drift detection, or SIEM integration

jobs.description_html:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Federal Platform Engineer to support the deployment, operation, and sustainment of Keeper solutions across U.S. Government environments, including IL5, IL6, and classified networks. This is a 100% remote position with travel as needed.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver secure, reliable, and compliant platform operations for mission-critical federal environments.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices, and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, including FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate Authorization, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why federal agencies, including NASA and the DOJ, trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.    

About the Role

The Senior Federal Platform Engineer will be responsible for the hands-on delivery, deployment, automation, and sustainment of Keeper solutions in high-security U.S. Government environments. This role combines DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, and site reliability responsibilities, with a strong focus on restricted and controlled environments. You will build and maintain deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure, support release and cutover activities, troubleshoot production issues, and help ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and audit-ready across IL5, IL6, and classified deployments. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in environments where change control is strict, access is limited, and operational rigor is critical.

  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for federal environments
  • Support software releases, deployment execution, cutovers, validation, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring across IL5, IL6, and classified networks

  • Maintain hardened infrastructure, configuration baselines, patching processes, and operational controls for restricted environments

  • Build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational telemetry to improve system visibility and reliability

  • Support continuous monitoring, audit readiness, and authorization activities by producing required technical evidence and artifacts
  • Assist with vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance drift detection, and system configuration validation
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to improve automation, troubleshooting, documentation, scripting, and operational efficiency

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Release Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related technical role

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment workflows, and production change management

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages

  • Experience with observability, including logs, metrics, alerting, and production troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, RMF, DoD Cloud Computing SRG, and related operational controls
  • Experience working in environments with strict change control, limited access, and formal release processes
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose issues across infrastructure, applications, networking, and deployment pipelines
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to support scripting, automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational analysis
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Team Description:
Kitware is a leader in advanced research and algorithm development in artificial intelligence (AI), spanning computer vision (CV), natural language processing (NLP), vision-language models (VLMs), and other generative AI technologies. Our solutions embracing AI add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We have developed a deep understanding in extracting useful, actionable information from multiple data sources like images, video, metadata, audio, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance AI, CV, and other related fields through research and development and collaborative projects that can contribute to our open source software platforms, such as XAITK, NRTK, and GeoWATCH.
 
About the Projects: 
Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Much of Kitware’s work involves applying state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to dynamic, real-world problems. We consider the work that we do on our government contracts as one of the ways that we give back to the community. We partner with premier government R&D agencies such as DARPA, IARPA, AFRL, Army C5ISR, NOAA, and other branches of the US Government on a range of efforts, including prime contracts, SBIRs, and STTRs. In addition, we provide commercial services to companies ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Kitware employs an open source business model to foster extended, collaborative communities and to provide effective, flexible, and high-quality technical solutions.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Kivo

Kivo Health is a series A healthcare AI company delivering AI-powered care to seniors with chronic disease, starting with chronic lung disease (COPD). Backed by top tier investors, including YCombinator, Kivo is growing fast towards achieving its mission to help 1 billion seniors breathe easier and live better.

About the Role

Kivo Health is building a tech-enabled healthcare clinic to help real people breathe better, using innovative technology to make a lasting impact. We're YC-backed and well-funded, and looking for a fullstack engineer to join our small, high-leverage engineering team in Seattle.

You'll work alongside a diverse team of industry experts in healthcare and startup technology. Our engineering team is intentionally small and made up of generalists rather than specialists, so you'll move fluidly across dev tooling, product features, and core web app work. Our stack includes Python/Django on the backend and TypeScript, React, and React Native across web and mobile. This is an in-office, Seattle-based role.

We're hiring for multiple engineering openings across a range of experience levels. Final title and compensation will be based on your background and interview performance.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, test, and ship software across our web and mobile platforms, using AI tools to work efficiently and effectively.

  • Build tooling that makes the whole engineering team faster and more effective.

  • Solve genuinely hard problems in the product.

  • Work on core web application features for both patients and internal users.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve our tools, workflows, and the product itself.

Who You Are

  • You've fully embraced AI to co-create software, using it not just to write code but to test it, design it, and build agents that extend what you can do.

  • You're a software generalist, comfortable moving between dev tooling, product features, and general web app work as the team's needs shift.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven startup culture and are comfortable with ambiguity on a team that's still actively defining its own practices.

  • You're excited to work directly with the company founders on a small team where your work has outsized visibility and impact.

  • You have a strong desire to make a positive impact on people's lives, and you're motivated by the mission here specifically.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a similar.

  • 5+ years of experience building robust software technologies.

  • Experience working with AI tools.

  • Experience in a startup environment.

Kivo Health is committed to providing fair, competitive, and transparent compensation. The final offer for this role is determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s unique experience, skillset, education, certifications, and geographic location.

We believe in hiring practices that are equitable and inclusive. Kivo Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Products
jobs.description_html:
We Breathe Life Into Data

At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease. 

As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.

The Opportunity at Komodo Health

Komodo Health's AI Platform and Services organization builds the platform every AI product at Komodo runs on: agent infrastructure, evals, data context, and the surfaces customers touch. Small pods build on shared primitives and ship in weeks. Product managers here build the first versions of what they propose and to iterate alongside their teams quickly.

The suite that built this business was designed for an analyst at a screen. The platform underneath it now reasons. Our flagship product Navigator runs investigations that used to take a person weeks, and an ai-augmented product suite interoperates with it to streamline workflows. We are just getting started. What the next generation of the suite actually is remains an open question, and today it needs ownership.

That question is this seat. You will define the next generation of Komodo's product suite and prove it by building it. The current surfaces are your material and your distribution. The mandate is what comes after them. Principal here means your answer sets the pattern for every surface that follows. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will lead through your thesis and your builds, embedded in small engineering pods, not through a team of direct reports.

Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…

  • Put a thesis on record for what the next generation of the suite is, argued in working software customers have touched, and won cross-functional and leadership support for it.
  • Built the first version of at least two new products from that thesis yourself, then ran a pod of four or fewer from prototype to GA with no dedicated project management.
  • Those products live in customer environments, with measurable revenue, adoption, or retention impact.
  • Made the current suite smaller. At least one existing legacy solution retired or folded into its successor, without customer churn.
  • You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities:
  • Own the thesis for what customers touch. Study how they actually work, decide what should exist, and revise the argument as models improve.
  • Build first versions with AI tools and platform primitives. Bring engineering in to scale what shows value, and drop what does not.
  • Work inside customer environments when the problem calls for it, scope in real time while contracts are being negotiated, and treat deployment as part of the product.
  • Propose and defend the shape of the growing portfolio. As the new generation lands, you decide what the existing solutions become.
  • Package for the field. Partner with sales and marketing on what we sell, run the market analysis behind it, and make sure every new product can be positioned, enabled, and sold.
  • Set the pattern. Your architecture and your build habits become how the surface pods around you work.

What you bring to Komodo Health (required):

  • Builds the first version. You will show us something you built, not something you managed, this is evaluated in the interview.
  • AI native at product depth. You can reason at a low level about the AI products you intend to ship: context and grounding, evals and quality gates, agent behavior, and cost. Using chat tools to work faster is the baseline everywhere, so it earns nothing here.
  • Comfortable inside customer environments and contracting cycles, with the judgment to commit responsibly in real time.
  • Zero to one at Principal  scope. 10+ years in product, including at least one product you conceived and shipped that earns real revenue today. We will ask what existed before it, and what was retired to make room for it.
  • Excellent written communication. Your reasoning gets adopted because it is clear.

Additional skills and experience we’d prioritize (nice to have)…

  • Healthcare or regulated data experience (claims, EHR, patient journeys, provider analytics), or a track record of getting fluent fast in a comparably complex data domain like supply chain, energy, or financial data. Time at a company through a platform transition. Experience retiring a product without losing its customers.

jobs.description_html:
We Breathe Life Into Data

At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease. 

As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.

The Opportunity at Komodo Health

Join Komodo Health’s Data Foundations team and play a critical role in shaping the core data products that fuel our Healthcare Map. You’ll transform massive, complex healthcare datasets into performant, trustworthy data assets that power customer-facing products, internal innovation, and AI/ML use cases. By building and scaling our foundational data systems, you’ll directly enable the transparency and efficiency required to drive better health outcomes across the industry.

Mission

The Senior Data Platform Engineer will design, build, operate, and improve the large-scale pipelines and foundational data platform behind Komodo’s Healthcare Map. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on processing complex healthcare data at scale, improving reliability and performance, and contributing to the technical direction of core data systems.

Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…

  • Architectural Advancement: Delivered high-impact technical initiatives that improve pipeline performance, scalability, and system efficiency.
  • Platform Hardening: Improved the reliability, observability, and cost-efficiency of core Data Foundations systems.
  • Healthcare Data Innovation: Built deep domain expertise and contributed new approaches to challenges such as patient journey mapping and identity resolution.
  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Partnered with Data Product and Engineering teams to ship scalable, production-grade data solutions.
  • Architecture Partnership: Raised the bar across the team through mentorship, design reviews, and engineering best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, operate, and optimize large-scale batch pipelines using Python, SQL, Spark, and Airflow on AWS
  • Make storage and data layout decisions (table formats, partitioning, file sizing, compaction) that keep large datasets fast to query and cost-efficient
  • Ingest data from many external sources and keep pipelines correct through frequent schema changes
  • Transform healthcare claims, EHR, and reference data into trusted, serving-ready data products for customers and internal teams
  • Strengthen reliability through data quality checks, validation, lineage, observability, and alerting
  • Debug complex data, system, and performance issues across compute-heavy workflows
  • Contribute to system design, code quality, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and rotational production support

What you bring to Komodo Health:

  • Strong hands-on experience building, owning, and debugging production data pipelines at multi-terabyte scale
  • Advanced Python, including performant, memory-efficient code for large-scale data processing, plus strong SQL
  • Deep production experience with Airflow, including operating and scaling it, not just writing DAGs
  • A solid understanding of how data is physically stored: columnar vs. row formats, and open table formats like Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi (updates, compaction, small files, partitioning)
  • Experience with Spark or a comparable distributed processing framework
  • Proven experience designing and operating data systems in AWS
  • Strong instincts for data correctness, root-cause analysis, and production troubleshooting
  • The ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly with engineering, product, and data partners
  • Comfort using AI-assisted engineering tools for coding, debugging, documentation, and technical exploration

AI-Augmented Engineering Expectations:

  • You will be expected to leverage AI-augmented engineering tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude, to improve productivity and technical decision-making. This may include using AI to generate and refine code, accelerate documentation, automate test case creation, debug complex issues, explore unfamiliar technical concepts, and assess architectural trade-offs and risks.

Additional skills and experience we’d prioritize (nice to have)…

  • Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong core software engineering fundamentals and experience in more than one language
  • Data governance and lineage experience
  • Experience delivering external-facing data products through APIs, serving layers, or customer access patterns
  • Experience applying AI or agentic workflows to engineering, data quality, delivery, or operations
  • Success in high-growth or ambiguous environments

No healthcare background required. You’ll build that domain expertise here.

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Material Security, you'll own the reliability of the infrastructure every product team builds on, including GCP, Kubernetes, and Postgres across hundreds of GCP projects. This is a software engineering role, where you’ll be building systems and the culture that removes manual on-call work, fixes the underlying causes of alerts, and gives engineers a clear view of system health. You'll work with every team and work with leadership to decide where things go..

Responsibilities

  • Design and build software that removes manual on-call intervention and recurring sources of toil.

  • Lead infrastructure projects end to end.

  • Find where cost-driven limits create latency or reliability problems, and fix the trade-off.

  • Build tooling that shows system health across our GCP projects at a glance.

  • Define SLOs with product teams and raise the bar on reliability practice across engineering.

  • Pioneer reliability engineering for agent-first production systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical Ability: Solid software engineering fundamentals and raw coding ability. Production code is your default way of solving a problem.

  • Automation First: You have built tools and automation that other engineers depended on, not just runbooks that describe a manual fix.

  • Ownership: Comfortable driving ambiguous, cross-team reliability work on your own, from diagnosis to a shipped fix.

jobs.title: Design Lead, Consumer
jobs.description_html:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the role

We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.

What You'll Do:

  • We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.
  • This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.
  • It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.
  • You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.
  • You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.
  • You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.
  • The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.
  • Experience formally managing or leading design teams.
  • Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.

It's about identifying the right problems, setting and fully owning the design vision for multiple complex areas, making strategic calls under ambiguity, and leading high-impact initiatives that raise the bar for the team around you.

  • Identify and resolve cross-functional tensions, bridging gaps between design, clinical, and product perspectives.
  • Strengthen community within and outside the design team by championing company-wide cultural initiatives.

  • AI fluency: You use AI tools daily (Claude, Figma AI, Cursor, or similar) with strong prompting and synthesis skills. You're also helping others develop that muscle.

  • Systems thinking: Ability to think beyond a flow and communicate a holistic system that can scale for any program
  • Appetite for complexity: Energized by ambiguity and solving complex problems, and comfortable making calls when the path isn't clear.

Medsien is the leading provider of scalable remote care management for a quality patient experience. Hundreds of organizations trust Medsien’s unparalleled technology solutions to implement exceptional remote care management programs, personalize every interaction, and improve the lives of the people who need it most. Based in San Francisco and venture-backed by top-tier investors, Medsien was founded to reimagine remote care management. 

More than 60% of all U.S. adults—over 150 million people—live with at least one chronic condition, which requires dedicated, ongoing medical support outside the four walls of their doctor’s office. And yet, only 20% of these patients have access to remote care from the comfort of their homes, putting their health at significant risk. Together, we can save lives and create a real impact. 

Medsien is a venture-backed healthcare SaaS company experiencing rapid growth and looking to expand our team. We are seeking an organized, motivated, and passionate Senior Product Manager to join our talented and inspiring team. 

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll work closely with senior leadership, engineering, and operations teams to drive product strategy and execution. We're looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on individual who is passionate about building impactful products, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and takes ownership from concept to launch. You'll play a key role in developing solutions that enable healthcare providers to deliver high-quality care to their patients.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

  • Own and drive product initiatives from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with company goals and priorities.
  • Demonstrate initiative, take ownership, and execute independently with minimal oversight.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to define product requirements, prioritize initiatives, coordinate resources, develop roadmaps, and drive execution through key milestones.
  • Translate business needs, customer feedback, and product insights into clear, actionable requirements for engineering teams.
  • Define, track, and analyze product metrics to measure success, identify opportunities, and inform product decisions.
  • Drive product development within agile teams, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality execution.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, UX Research, and Operations to continuously improve the customer experience.
  • Proactively identify challenges, resolve blockers, and make informed trade-offs to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Communicate product priorities, progress, and strategic decisions clearly to internal stakeholders and senior leadership.

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management, with a strong track record of building, launching, and improving successful products.
  • Experience owning products or major product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and requirements definition through development, launch, and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of agile product development methodologies and experience working closely with engineering teams.

We bring together expertise in AI, cybersecurity, and software to create products that seek to finally shift the advantage in security from offense to defense.

 

Our Team and Values

Joining Method means becoming part of an elite, mission-driven team that values innovation, transparency, and high standards. We work with purpose, embracing diverse perspectives and experiences while maintaining a high bar for quality. Our team is built around trust, efficiency, and respect. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully. We believe in small, focused teams capable of tackling complex challenges and achieving outsized results. At Method, you’ll have the autonomy to drive projects forward, the support to navigate challenges, and the opportunity to shape the future of cybersecurity.

You would be one of the first Recruiter hire at Method responsible for running the full lifecycle of building the best recruitment at the intersection of AI, cybersecurity, and national security. The main responsibility of this role initially is talent acquisition. Method is experiencing massive growth and needs to significantly expand the team in a short period of time. A Principal Product Manager leads teams to iteratively deliver working software that meets user needs and business goals, working collaboratively with designers, engineers, project managers, and stakeholders.   • Define quarterly or program increment goals to establish near- and mid-term milestones for delivering working software
  • Iterate on the product vision, strategy, and roadmap as the team learns from feedback
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their goals and constraints, and use this information to determine product priorities  
  • Build and maintain trust with stakeholders by continuously aligning on a shared vision and set of priorities, and demonstrating how the team is delivering on this vision
  • Coordinate across teams to implement software according to the roadmap and adapt based on learnings
  • Break software features down into user stories or tasks that can be worked on in a sprint 
  • Collaborate prioritizing and refining the backlog of user stories and tasks to reflect product priorities
  • Define sprint goals; lead and contribute to sprint planning discussions that enable designers and engineers to design and build software features
  • Ensure that user stories have clear descriptions and acceptance criteria so that design and engineering tasks can be evaluated for completeness
  • Review product designs and working software to reflect the desired behavior and performance
  • Engage with stakeholders for approval of key decisions about how software products and services will function

  • Collaborate with other teams to obtain data needed for metrics

  • Report metrics to stakeholders and team members verbally and in writing

  • Communicate with users about new product features
  • Update user-facing documentation about the product

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering — streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed — not another CRUD app behind a form. 

You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide — in the best way. 

AI-native. Non-negotiable.  You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer — demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. 

What You'll Own

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there — meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you. 

Who You Are 

  • You see what needs to exist and you go build it — you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec. 
  • You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it — not because of a title. 
  • You own the entire arc — design, build, ship, operate — and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging. 
  • When you hit the edge of what you know — a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen — curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect. 
  • "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on. 

What You Bring

  • Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier — you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like. 
  • 5–7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users. 
  • Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic. 
  • A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems — you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up. 
  • Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We are looking for an innovative engineer for the GTM Product Team to strengthen the technology beneath OPSWAT's marketing operations. Marketing runs on HubSpot today, and it works hard for us: 1.1 million contacts, 817 active workflows, and the integrations that connect it to SugarCRM, Salesloft, My OPSWAT, websites and our data master. Your first job is to make that foundation more reliable — keeping the integrations healthy, resolving the sync and data-quality issues that slow the team down, and giving Marketing Operations a technical partner who understands their platform from the inside.

From there, you will help us build the next generation of that capability in house. The four functions HubSpot performs for us are the roadmap: marketing automation and email; lead capture from web, portal, events and webinars; lead management, meaning scoring, lifecycle and routing; contact data governance and consent and tight integration with our OPSWAT Data Master (ODM). Along the way you will bring AI into the product to enable smarter lead qualification, routing and scoring and more automated campaign managements.

What You Will Be Doing

Build the Platform

  • Build one governed front door for every lead, whatever the source — web forms, My OPSWAT, webinars, field events, partner and list imports — so each lead is validated, de-duplicated, consented and enriched once, at the gate, and nothing reaches the CRM or the data spine any other way.
  • Build AI-native lead qualification: a model that reads fit and engagement across every signal we hold — product usage in My OPSWAT, Academy progress, web behavior, intent, firmographics — ranks the whole database with real resolution, explains every score in plain language, and learns from what SDRs actually convert.
  • Build intelligent lead routing: the right lead to the right rep at the right moment, with territory, capacity, availability and priority held as data that Marketing Operations can shape and preview themselves, and a decision record behind every assignment so anyone can see why a lead went where it did.
  • Make every hand-off dependable: each lead tracked from capture to first touch, stalls surfaced automatically, every priority tier followed up, and nothing lost between systems.
  • Give Marketing Operations a self-service campaign layer: per-campaign behavior — routing, priority, nurture — configured in minutes with a preview of what it would have done to yesterday's leads, so new campaigns stop requiring new workflows and old overrides expire on their own.
  • Build the platform AI-native from day one: expose its data and actions through an MCP server so OPSWAT's internal agents and assistants can look up a lead, explain a routing decision, or trigger a campaign action in natural language — and design every capability so an agent can use it as readily as a person can.
  • Make consent and suppression a single source of truth, enforced at the gate and impossible to bypass, and stream every signal and every decision into OPSWAT Data Master so marketing, product and sales data finally join in one place.
  • Build the seams to SugarCRM, the email service provider, visitor identification, enrichment and My OPSWAT so that a failure in any one of them is contained, retried and visible — never silent, never lossy.
  • Leveraging OPSWAT Agentic SDLC — use the Platform team's agentic coding platform as your primary means of production, own the quality and security of what ships, and document the system as you go so it stays knowable.

Keep HubSpot Running Through the Transition

  • Own the health of HubSpot's existing integrations until each one is retired: the SugarCRM sync through the Sugar Data Tool, Salesloft, the My OPSWAT feed (portal and Academy), 6sense enrichment, web forms and the Forms API.
  • Triage and resolve integration incidents across HubSpot and its neighbors — root-cause them, fix them permanently, and write down what happened.
  • Make safe, minimal changes in HubSpot when the business needs them, and hold the line against new workflow and list sediment that the migration would only have to unwind.
  • Build the Forms Gateway pull-forward so website capture decouples from HubSpot early, and run the interim enrollment connector that keeps Salesloft working through cutover.
  • Reconcile HubSpot and platform data continuously during the parallel run so drift is caught long before a cutover gate.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 6+ years building and operating production backend systems, with at least 3 in Python
  • Demonstrated, recent, daily practice building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode, Codex or similar). You can show us the workflow, the review and test loop, and something real that shipped through it.
  • Production support of a marketing automation platform's integrations — HubSpot strongly preferred; Marketo or Pardot considered — including its APIs, its data model, and its sync to a CRM. You have kept one of these healthy while other things changed around it.
  • Production experience with event-driven and durable-execution patterns: message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, replay. Temporal or a comparable workflow engine strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on integration engineering against real vendor APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries — built and operated, not configured through a wizard.
  • PostgreSQL to a strong level: schema design, JSONB, partitioning, migrations with Alembic, and query performance work you can describe.
  • Cloud deployment on Azure or AWS: containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, secrets management, observability.
  • Experience shipping LLM features into a product: structured outputs, evaluation discipline, confidence thresholds, fallbacks and guardrails — consuming a provided model gateway rather than building the infrastructure.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the skill to explain a technical trade-off to a marketing operations lead in their terms.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • SugarCRM logic hooks and REST API, or another CRM's server-side extension model; Salesforce Apex or triggers transferable.
  • Marketing technology domain knowledge: lead scoring and routing, consent and suppression, deliverability and ESP warm-up, campaign attribution.

Why OPSWAT?

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Secure File Gateway and ICAP
jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Opportunity

OPSWAT is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the development and growth of the Secure File Gateway, a strategic product designed to complement our established ICAP Server solution, which today is deployed by organizations operating in critical infrastructure and high-security environments. 

ICAP Server sits directly in the path of sensitive file flows, enforcing security policy, inspecting content in real time, and enabling safe access to web and internal systems. The Secure File Gateway will build on these core inspection and policy enforcement capabilities while addressing new customer needs, architectures, and deployment models. 

In this role, you will own the Secure File Gateway from inception through scale, while working closely with the ICAP Server product to ensure strong alignment, interoperability, and a cohesive platform strategy. This is a rare opportunity to help define a new product category at OPSWAT while partnering with a mature, revenue-generating product used in the most demanding environments.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Secure File Gateway and ICAP Server, aligning customer needs, market trends, and business priorities. 
  • Drive product adoption and growth by improving usability, performance, scalability, and integration within enterprise security stacks. 
  • Lead market and competitive analysis across ICAP, proxy, secure web gateway, and inline inspection technologies to identify differentiation opportunities. 
  • Translate customer feedback, field insights, and usage data into clear requirements and prioritize initiatives. 
  • Partner deeply with engineering to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities—balancing innovation with operational excellence. 
  • Collaborate with sales, sales engineering, marketing, and customer success on go-to-market strategy, launches, and enablement. 
  • Support strategic opportunities by participating in customer conversations, technical positioning, and complex deal cycles. 
  • Define and track success metrics tied to adoption, customer value, and platform performance. 
  • Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring ICAP continues to meet the expectations of regulated and mission-critical environments. 

What We Need From You

Cybersecurity & Technical Depth 
Strong understanding of ICAP, proxy technologies, secure web gateways, networking fundamentals, and content inspection workflows. You can translate deep technical capabilities into clear customer value and product direction. 

Product Leadership & Execution 
Proven experience owning roadmaps, writing high-quality requirements, and working closely with engineering teams to ship enterprise-grade software. 

Customer & Market Orientation 
Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers, gathering structured feedback, and incorporating real-world security use cases into product decisions. 

Go-To-Market Partnership 
Comfort collaborating with sales and marketing on positioning, launches, and adoption. Experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles is a strong plus. 

Communication & Influence 
Clear, confident communicator who can align stakeholders across product, engineering, and GTM teams—and represent the product externally when needed. 

Experience 
3–5 years of product management experience in B2B software, ideally within cybersecurity, networking, or infrastructure platforms. Experience with platform or integrated product portfolios is highly valued. 

What Sets You Apart

  • Customer-First Mindset – You instinctively start with customer pain and translate it into pragmatic, high-impact product decisions.

  • Execution Bias – You balance long-term vision with consistent delivery, creating momentum through meaningful, incremental improvements. 
  • Global Collaboration – Comfortable working with distributed teams and contributing to a globally aligned product organization. 

Why OPSWAT?

At OPSWAT, we protect the systems the world depends on. ICAP plays a critical role in securing web traffic and sensitive content flows for organizations operating in the most demanding environments. 

You’ll join a fast-growing cybersecurity company where product managers have real ownership, visibility, and impact. This role offers the opportunity to influence a critical product line, work alongside deeply technical teams, and help shape the future of secure web gateway and proxy technology. 

If you want to build products that matter—and see your work directly protect critical infrastructure—we’d love to meet you.

jobs.description_html:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Role Summary

The Talent Acquisition Business Partner (TABP) owns end-to-end recruitment for a dedicated business unit, acting as a strategic partner to hiring managers rather than an order-taking recruiter. This is a hunter role: the TABP does not wait for applicants to come in, but proactively sources, networks, and builds relationships to find talent before it is on the market. This role reports into the Head of Talent Acquisition and is accountable for quality of hire, pipeline health, and hiring manager trust within their assigned business area. Success in the first six to twelve months means a fully staffed pipeline built through direct sourcing and headhunting, consistently high quality-of-hire outcomes, and hiring managers who treat the TABP as a trusted advisor rather than a service desk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Headhunt and proactively source passive talent through direct outreach, market mapping, and networking, rather than only relying on inbound applicants
  • Build and maintain a personal network of talent and industry contacts as an ongoing pipeline, not a one-off search
  • Own full-cycle recruitment for a dedicated business leader relationship, from intake through offer
  • Partner with hiring managers on role scoping, market reality checks, and interview process design
  • Developing hiring manager trust, understanding business forecast and aligning to the global needs of your assigned business unit

  • Experience partnering directly with senior hiring managers or business leaders

  • Comfort working with applicant tracking system platforms (Greenhouse preferred) and pipeline reporting
  • Fluent in English; additional regional language a plus depending on market

jobs.description_html:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

We are seeking a Director Product Manager, Okta Identity Threat Detection and Response Products, an individual contributor role, to drive the evolution of Okta’s cutting-edge identity security offerings. This position requires a strong technical foundation, keen product intuition, cybersecurity knowledge, and exceptional collaboration skills to shape the future of our strategic security products. You'll leverage significant cross-functional influence to execute key initiatives in this critical domain.

Built upon the robust Okta Identity Cloud, our mission is to ensure Okta provides the most comprehensive, user-friendly, admin-friendly, and secure Identity Security product suite available. This team is responsible for products including Okta Identity Threat Protection with Okta AI, Okta ThreatInsight, and Okta Network Zones, among other vital security functionalities. Our customers depend on these solutions to safeguard their digital assets and ensure secure access for their users. This role is pivotal in ensuring that security is seamlessly integrated into every facet of our products.

Success in this role demands a deep understanding of customer security requirements, a strong empathy for both end-user and administrator experiences, and the ability to strategically prioritize amidst competing demands from various Okta teams.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Roadmap and Vision

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for Okta Identity Security functionality to ensure Okta's continued leadership in the security space.
  • Evangelize your vision to engineering teams, the broader product organization, and customers.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive roadmap, prioritizing features that enhance both customer security posture and administrative ease of use.
  • Analyze and leverage data to inform product and roadmap decisions, ensuring data-driven strategic choices.

Product Delivery and Execution

  • Ensure the timely and within-budget delivery of the Okta Identity Security product roadmap.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and design to specify experiences that are platform-first and delight customers at scale.
  • Work with scrum teams and Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to deliver features on time that address key security use cases.
  • Rigorously prioritize across multiple product investment areas within the security domain.
  • Partner with the data team to track product usage metrics, specifically tying them to improved security outcomes and business success.

Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering

  • Work with engineering, other product managers, and customers to capture detailed security requirements and document user stories and use cases.
  • Engage with customers to deeply understand their challenges related to identity-centric threats, access control, and network security.
  • Ensure that beta customer feedback is incorporated into product iterations. Maintain close relationships with customers during beta programs to integrate their insights effectively.
  • Collaborate with technical marketing and sales to understand the competitive landscape for identity security and Okta’s position within it.
  • Partner with product marketing to support the creation of compelling messaging and content, and define the go-to-market strategy for existing and new security offerings.
  • Inform current and future pricing and packaging changes for Okta Identity Security products based on your subject matter expertise.

Own the Product

  • Maintain a customer-success-focused mindset, actively working to unblock sales and assist customers with security-related issues.
  • Responsible for supporting the field on critical requests and customer security needs.
  • Drive the development of world-class identity security products and platform capabilities.
  • Lead Okta Identity Security quarterly business reviews and collaborate with the go-to-market team to expand the customer pipeline from roadmap to packaging.
  • Leverage your domain expertise to identify new product opportunities for Okta Identity Security to expand our portfolio.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.
  • Proven track record of demonstrating strategic vision and product design for security-focused products.
  • Experience creating new product offerings, including Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, pricing, product naming, legal contracts, and New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Experience with defining and driving Threat Protection, Threat Intelligence, SaaS Security and Network Security as a product suite.
  • Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise security products or services.
  • Thirst for learning: able to go broad and deep across business and technical security contexts.
  • Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects – you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details.

The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

About You

Production builder: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

Careful evaluator: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

What you will be doing

  • Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
  • Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
  • Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.
  • Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
  • Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.
  • Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.
  • Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.
  • Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.
  • Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
  • Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

Scope by level

Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster.

Our stack

Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

And extra credit for

  • Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
  • Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
  • Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.

The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.

Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. This includes a depth of knowledge across classic vectors — Account Takeover (ATO), resource draining, and fraudulent account creation — as well as their evolving equivalents in multi-agent and autonomous system environments.

  • Field & Customer Engagement: Actively engage with the field organization (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers) to build deep knowledge of the voice of the customer. Drive customer conversations during pre-sales, renewals, and at key events to gather feedback and support adoption.
  • AI-Powered Productivity: Drive efficiency and strategic insight by leveraging AI tools for high-value activities, including prototyping, synthesizing customer insights, accelerating competitive and market analysis, and rapidly generating high-quality product documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • AI Agent Experience:  Significant product experience with AI Agent creation, orchestration and the use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for exposing context, tools, and resources to agents. Ability to use this experience to define how Auth0's should securely authenticate, authorize, and monitor non-human AI principals at runtime.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description_html:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Senior Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

About You

Production builder: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

Careful evaluator: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

What you will be doing

  • Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
  • Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
  • Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.
  • Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
  • Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.
  • Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.
  • Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.
  • Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.
  • Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
  • Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

Scope by level

Senior: Own an agent capability or evaluation pipeline with measurable improvements.

Our stack

Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

And extra credit for

  • Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
  • Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
  • Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.
