jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Semgrep

Semgrep, the leader in code security for builders, empowers invention without friction. Teams catch, flag, and fix real issues before they ship, powered by security that learns as they build. Semgrep secures code as it’s written and provides guardrails that pave the road for developers to move fast and stay secure. Built for builders and trusted by security, Semgrep lives where developers work, delivering fixes without breaking flow, and giving security teams visibility, control, and confidence. Semgrep gets smarter as you build, with AI that learns your context to cut false positives and prioritize reachable vulnerabilities, validated by 95% of security reviewers across 6M+ findings. Semgrep makes zero false positives a reality with AppSec teams triaging 80% fewer false positives across Code and Supply Chain, dramatically shrinking the backlog.


Founded in San Francisco and backed by Menlo Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Sequoia Capital, Semgrep is recognized by Gartner in Application Security Testing and is trusted by leading organizations, including Vanta, Lyft, and Dropbox. Learn more at semgrep.dev.

About the role

As a Fullstack Engineer, you’ll work across the stack to design, build and maintain a fast and reliable user experience for our customers. You’ll collaborate closely with designers and product managers to develop flows that help AppSec professionals and developers alike to achieve their security goals, own the end-to-end implementation of features in our frontend and backend and scale these systems as we continue to grow rapidly this year.

Our stack utilizes Typescript and React on the Frontend, Python, Flask and SQLAlchemy on the Backend, is deployed via Kubernetes and hosted on AWS. Professional experience with these technologies is preferred but not required provided you are open to learning them quickly!

This is a hybrid role with the expectation you’ll join us 3+ days per week in our San Francisco, New York, Boston or Denver offices depending on team. Remote employment will be considered for exceptional candidates as well.

Compensation

The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $163,000 to $246,500 USD.. The actual base salary will be determined based on a number of factors, which may include job-related skills, relevant experience, qualifications, location, internal equity, and market data. In addition to base salary, total compensation may include equity, variable compensation, and benefits. We view equity as a meaningful part of our compensation philosophy and a way for employees to share in the long-term value they help create.

Compensation ranges are reviewed regularly and may be adjusted as the role, individual performance, or market conditions evolve.

What we offer (FTE only)

Our goal is to competitively and fairly compensate every Semgrep employee with a system that equally rewards those who are vocal and those who are less comfortable making demands during the final steps of the hiring process. To that end, we generate internal compensation bands that are used when discussing and negotiating salaries. We update these based on market data to make sure they’re above the average for comparable roles.

We invest in our employees’ well-being and long-term success through a competitive, market-aligned benefits program that meets or exceeds local market standards across all of the regions in which we hire. Benefits offerings vary by location to reflect local requirements and norms. For more detailed, location-specific information, please visit Semgrep Benefits.

Who we are

We bring together people from a wide range of backgrounds and disciplines—from physics and philosophy to formal methods research and full-fledged corporations. We’re new parents and new grads, dog lovers and dogfooders. We get together often to bike, bake, and meet up in parks. In our interactions, we believe respect and honesty go hand in hand, and prioritize both.

Semgrep is an equal-opportunity employer seeking a diverse range of backgrounds. We value who you are — including your cultural heritage, your socioeconomic status, your age, your race, your gender, your sexual orientation, your disabilities. We value what’s vitally important to you — your family, your religion, your politics. We value what you love in this world — your music, your weekend pursuits. We believe in welcoming varied professional backgrounds, educations, and interests. If you’re exceptional in your role, believe in Semgrep’s mission, and treat Semgrep’s values as your own, you belong here.

Please Note: For US-based roles open to remote work, we are currently able to hire employees in the following states only: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineering Architect
jobs.description_html:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

 

As a Principal AI Engineering Architect, you will be tasked with leading the development and deployment of SentinelOne's next-generation AI-powered cybersecurity solutions. This critical role will shape SentinelOne's competitive advantage by translating cutting-edge AI research into production-grade, globally scalable products that proactively stay ahead of cybercriminals and tomorrow's threats. You will drive the strategy and execution for our core AI platforms, directly impacting our ability to deliver industry-leading protection to our customers.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Define and execute the technical roadmap for AI engineering, focusing on bringing the most recent advances in machine learning technology to help our customers efficiently discover and defeat threats.
  • Represent AI Engineering as a key contributor to the Architecture Board defining the overall architecture strategy for the SentinelOne Platform and Services.
  • Understand and define strategies to support cross domain requirements to use AI Platform and Services across SentinelOne.
  • Serve as a lead individual contributor who also mentors across distributed teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous innovation.
  • Design and build net-new AI capabilities to be used across SentinelOne's industry-leading cybersecurity platform.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across multiple engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and innovation in AI-powered cybersecurity products.
  • Oversee the establishment of best practices for MLOps, security, and performance monitoring to ensure the reliability and efficacy of our AI defense mechanisms.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 15 or more years of progressive experience in software or machine learning engineering.
  • Proven track record of delivering multiple high-scale, production-ready AI or data products from concept through deployment and maintenance.
  • Deep expertise in building highly available, low-latency machine learning systems, including experience with machine learning workflows and processes.
  • Experience in endpoint security, OS concepts, or a related field with comparable large-scale event processing and real-time processing challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, develop, and retain top-tier AI engineering talent.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Python and modern frameworks (e.g., Pydantic), cloud-native MLOps platforms (e.g., Kubeflow), and large-scale data processing technologies, including hands-on familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and operating in cloud environments, especially AWS and Google Cloud.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply.  If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Base Salary Range
$224,000—$308,000 USD

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

  • Engineer for production reliability: Troubleshoot complex issues across AI services, gateways, integrations, and deployment environments. Implement appropriate testing, diagnostics, performance monitoring, and operational controls.
  • Collaborate on platform architecture and execution: Partner with infrastructure, enterprise applications, data engineering, and security teams to translate architectural requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable production services.

Hands-on experience with Kong AI Gateway, LiteLLM, or similar technologies is a strong plus.

    Own the design and delivery of integrations that connect SentinelOne products into customer environments. Often this is work you will do alongside the customer's engineers, shaping both the solution and the knowledge transfer that goes with it. Produce the runbooks, integration docs, and executive-level technical communication that let customers operate independently.
  • Upstream Contributions to the Core Product
    When something needs fixing or improving in the core platform to make a customer whole, you go do it. Partner with platform teams to get contributions reviewed and supported long-term, and know when to invest in the long-term fix versus the near-term unblock. Along the way, build the tooling that codifies repeatable patterns and scales the whole Forward Deploy function.
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship
    Raise the bar for the Forward Deploy Engineering team. Mentor Senior Forward Deploy Engineers, set standards for how engagements are scoped and delivered, and shape how the team operates as it grows.
  • Build and Review Technical Specifications
    Architect end-to-end solutions for complex problems with loose definition, sometimes spanning multiple codebases and owning teams. Document trade-offs and critical implementation details; review and provide meaningful feedback on other specs, understanding broader patterns and downstream/upstream dependencies.
  • Code Review
    Champion code quality, security, and efficiency. Your keen eye for detail will guide you in reviewing and elevating our codebase– including the codebases you're visiting.
  • Support and Team Collaboration
    Respond to ad-hoc customer and internal escalations promptly (no regular on-call rotation). Assist your colleagues, share constructive feedback, and contribute to weekly syncs and daily Slack standups.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

We do not require a perfect match with everything below; however, the more this describes you, the better of a fit you will be for this role.

  • Experience
    • Solid computer science background with 6+ years engineering experience including both backend and frontend.
    • Proven expertise designing and operating distributed systems or data-intensive services.
    • Track record of leading substantial pieces of work end-to-end, under ambiguity, with multiple stakeholders.
    • Experience working directly with customers or senior stakeholders to shape technical solutions.
  • Technical Mastery
    • Deep proficiency in at least one production language (Java strongly preferred; 5+ years) and working comfort in at least one additional language.
    • You value elegant code that is concise and readable.
    • You'll pick up new tools and codebases as the work demands, and will likely end up working with modern Java, React, TypeScript, Kafka, Redis, GraphQL, Node.js, SentinelOne's own platform, and more.
    • You enjoy writing modern Java (we love lambdas) and prefer composition to inheritance.
    • You're comfortable weighing in on CAP theorem considerations, and are energized by selecting the data structure with the perfect trade-offs for a problem at hand.
  • Domain Familiarity
    • Experience in the cybersecurity domain is strongly preferred. (think SIEM, EDR/XDR, log pipelines, detection engineering, threat hunting, etc.).
  • A Collaborative, Curious, and Practical Mindset
    • You're energized by walking into an unfamiliar codebase and being genuinely useful in a week, and by leading others through the same kind of work.
    • You believe a vague customer request is an interesting technical problem waiting to be reframed, and that "a problem well-stated is half-solved."

jobs.description_html:
About Shift5

Shift5 delivers operational intelligence for onboard OT across defense, aerospace, and commercial transportation fleets. We capture and analyze databus data to detect anomalies, predict failures, and secure critical infrastructure against cyber threats.

The Role & Team

The Platform Engineering team owns four core capabilities: Operating Systems (BaseOS, Manifold, Yocto), Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS/GovCloud to edge), Developer Experience (CI/CD guardrails, internal tooling), and AI Enablement (secure AI orchestration and tooling).

As Principal Platform Engineer, you are the senior-most individual contributor on the team, serving as the primary technical anchor for architecture and a key multiplier for the engineering org. You will drive overall technical strategy, mentor senior engineers, and step into direct team leadership or people management as needed.

What You'll Do

  • Release Engineering: Architect, develop, and operate end-to-end release infrastructure and GitOps delivery pipelines using tools like Atlantis, ArgoCD, Earthly Lunar, GitHub, and internally developed tools.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and manage a complicated AWS estate spanning commercial and govcloud using services like EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, Transit Gateway, etc.
  • Supply Chain Security & Compliance: Lead artifact security (Harbor, Cosign, Vault Transit Engine) and build automated, compliance-by-default pipelines (NIST controls, SBOM generation) to eliminate program friction.
  • OS Lifecycle & AI Enablement: Support hardware OS image builds (Yocto, Manifold) and productionize internal AI gateways, RAG tooling, and developer AI workflows (Cursor).
  • Technical & Team Leadership: Author RFCs/design docs, run architecture reviews, plan roadmaps, and mentor mid/staff-level engineers. Provide direct management (1:1s, hiring, performance reviews) during transitions or scale.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with security, embedded, and field teams to ensure seamless delivery across airgapped and edge environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Predictable Delivery: Release engineering is seamless, observable, and fully trusted across teams.
  • Automated Security: Compliance evidence and SBOMs are generated natively in CI/CD without manual overhead.
  • Governed AI: AI tooling is securely integrated, well-documented, and actively adopted by developers.
  • Team Growth & Resilience: Engineering standards elevate across the org, priorities remain clear, and team leadership operates without single points of failure.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 10+ years in software/platform engineering, with 5+ years managing production infrastructure at scale.
  • Technical & People Leadership: Proven track record leading projects, designing architecture, mentoring engineers, and readiness (or prior experience) for direct people management.
  • Cloud & Modern Delivery: Hands-on mastery of Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions/Earthly, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu, AWS/GovCloud).
  • Supply Chain Security: Strong background in artifact registries, container signing (Cosign/Sigstore), Vault, and SBOM generation.
  • Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

Preferred:

  • Background in defense, aerospace, or regulated environments (NIST 800-53, IL4/IL5, CMMC).
  • Embedded Linux/OS experience (Yocto, SLE Micro) and airgapped/edge deployment models.
  • Experience deploying internal AI/LLM infrastructure (RAG, model gateways, governance).
  • Scripting proficiency in Go, Python, and Bash.

  • Be a trusted resource and guide for our customers and partners pursuing advanced regulatory projects.

  • Support key product demonstrations and technical validation events in coordination with the flight testing and solutions engineering teams.

jobs.description_html:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

Skydio runs its business on Palantir Foundry. Sales, finance, manufacturing, and operations teams build the apps they work in every day there, and some of that data reaches our customers directly in our products. Underneath all of it is one ontology: the shared business objects, actions, and links that connect our systems - that people and AI agents use to find and act on company data. New use cases for work in Foundry are growing fast, and each one should land on that shared model rather than beside it.

Our Business Data Platform team is hiring a data product manager to help own that ontology and the path from a team's idea to a working use case. You will learn how each part of the business operates, decide what to reuse, extend, or build, and keep the model clean as it grows. You will work closely with our data security engineer so new use cases land in the right place with the right protections. You will report to the head of Business Data Platform.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own and evolve the Foundry Ontology with the head of Business Data Platform: the stable business objects, actions, and links between them (accounts, orders, sites, parts, people) that every app and agent builds on, designed so new use cases plug in without rework

  • Learn how our GTM, finance, manufacturing, and operations teams run, and model it so data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, and our other systems connects in one place

  • Work with leaders to decide what the business needs to see now, and turn it into metrics, dashboards, and apps on the ontology, knowing when to build around imperfect data and when to push for a fix at the source

  • Run intake for new use cases: help each team define its objects, actions, and who can see and do what, then decide what to reuse, extend, or build, and who builds it, including our Palantir forward deployed engineers

  • Work with our data security engineer to place each new use case in the right project and access boundary, so teams can build quickly on protected data

  • Keep the ontology clean and well typed, with clear names, descriptions, and types, so people and AI agents can find the right object and use it correctly. Bring these standards to our cross-functional Data Council

  • Connect systems through the ontology and its APIs, so internal apps, integrations, and some customer-facing products read and write the same governed data

  • Lead enablement: run office hours, onboard new teams and builders, and keep documentation current, so people get productive in Foundry and can ship new use cases with little overhead

What makes you a good fit:

  • 3+ years in product management, consulting, or a forward deployed role, ideally at a software company shipping products for customers

  • You understand how a business runs end to end: how a GTM org sells and forecasts, how finance closes and reports, how manufacturing plans and builds. You do not need to have worked in all of them

  • You design data models and ontologies: entities, relationships, and actions that hold up as new use cases arrive

  • You are technical enough to write SQL, read a pipeline, and reason about APIs and integrations between systems like Salesforce, NetSuite, and Workday

  • You get context out of busy business users, question a requested solution without losing their trust, and scope an honest first version

  • You learn new systems fast and write down what you learn so the next person doesn't have to ask

  • You treat access rules as part of the product and understand row-level security and data classification

  • You build and ship apps yourself, at work or on the side, and AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf are part of how you work every day. You can stand up a React app that pulls from live data, in Foundry or anywhere else

  • Palantir Foundry experience strongly preferred, especially Ontology design: object types, link types, actions, and functions

Our customers—from public safety agencies to industrial and enterprise operators—deploy fleets ranging from a single drone to tens of thousands of drones and docking stations to support critical missions such as infrastructure inspection, emergency response, search and rescue, and large-scale mapping.

Your work will enable customers to plan complex aerial missions, manage and monitor large fleets, visualize rich spatial data, and seamlessly integrate drone operations into their workflows.

You’ll develop primarily on Skydio Cloud (our SaaS platform), with occasional work on software that runs directly on the drone. This is a true full-stack role, combining backend systems in Python and Go with TypeScript and React on the frontend. You will collaborate closely with Autonomy, Backend Infrastructure, Product, Design, and Field teams, owning technical direction and features end-to-end while helping shape Skydio’s long-term platform architecture.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Continually design and expand Skydio Cloud’s core data model and API for drones/docks and the data they produce. See our public API to see what’s possible

  • Build the core features of our customer facing web app, for example: over the air updates, real-time fleet health, photo and video asset management, security and permissioning, user and device management, and 3D reconstruction

  • Collaborate across functions (product managers, designers, engineers, and support) to design and deliver Skydio Cloud features that enable customers to scale

  • Design secure, efficient, observable, scalable, and robust software for dealing with petabytes of real-time data and video from fleets of Skydio drones

  • Leverage your experience and best practices to not only uphold but improve Skydio’s engineering standards. From code review to post-mortems, you’ll be expected to help the team grow

  • Ensure Skydio’s platform is available 24/7 by joining in the rotating on-call schedule across all engineering teams. While reliability is critical, our platform is stable and incidents are rare, crime never sleeps, but thankfully, you still can

What makes you a good fit:

  • You have fun building product features from backend to frontend, from idea to realized customer value (5+ years of experience preferred).

  • You are capable of taking a concept and systematically driving it through the software lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.

  • You have experience building and delivering scalable and secure cloud based applications with a high proficiency in modern cloud technologies.

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Bonus points for:

  • Direct experience with our stack (Python, Go, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes, Temporal, Typescript, React, ThreeJS) or similar technologies.

  • Experience with geospatial data, mapping, or visualization tools such as Mapbox, Cesium, PostGIS, ArcGIS, or QGIS.

  • Experience with photogrammetry, scanning, mapping, or 3D reconstruction pipelines.

  • Build the business models that support in-flight data access, and monitor usage and costs to validate those models in practice.

When given a goal and a complex process with lots of moving parts, you can break down the challenge into meaningful steps, and clearly communicate how each of them moves the ball forward – whether the process is a technical program like device certification, or a business process like negotiating a telecom contract

  • You bring strong analytical skills to problems, and once you develop a plan, you can communicate it throughout both Skydio and our partner organizations. Working with multiple complex projects and overlapping deadlines does not scare you.

Their mission is clear: find the missing person, get the lights back on, keep the roads open, and keep the good guys safe. Our mandate is to solve one of the most complex problems of our time: how to build autonomous flying robots that help our customers get the job done, no matter what.

If reading that excites you, we want to talk to you.

Skydio isn’t just building drones; we are defining the future of autonomous robotics. To win, our products must be more than just capable, they must be undeniably reliable. We are looking for a UX Product Designer who understands that trust isn't a buzzword; it's built through absolute system transparency, pragmatic workflows, and giving the operator a clear handle to grab when things get chaotic.

Our UX Product Designers are inventing the interfaces of the future. You will not be designing generic dashboards. You will be helping to design the critical trust-bridge between human operators and advanced AI hardware, translating extreme technological complexity into intuitive, reliable, and beautiful experiences.

About the Role

As a UX Designer, you are a passionate craftsperson who embraces how technology is shifting the design discipline. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex features, collaborating effectively with Design Leadership and Product Managers, and executing with an incredibly high bar for detail.

You will work closely with Design Leadership, Product Managers, and Engineers to map out Critical User Journeys (CUJs) and build cross-platform experiences (Web, Mobile, Ground Control Stations) that our customers implicitly trust.

You will be instrumental in designing intuitive, high-quality user interfaces that bridge complex autonomous systems with streamlined tactical workflows, improving operator decision-making.

jobs.title: Director of Production
jobs.description_html:
Skyways designs, builds, and operates fully autonomous long range cargo aircraft. Founded in 2017, the company has spent nearly a decade developing and deploying autonomous logistics systems for real world operations.

Our V2 aircraft carries 30 lbs up to 500 miles, and V3 has a maximum range of well over 1,000 miles, a maximum useful load of 100 lbs, and a maximum endurance of nearly 20 hours. Both use a hybrid electric architecture that takes off like a helicopter and cruises like a plane, enabling long range autonomous delivery without traditional runway infrastructure.

Today, Skyways aircraft fly revenue missions for commercial customers across three continents. We are scaling full rate production and building toward large fleets of autonomous cargo aircraft.

Backed by Y Combinator and a $37M AFWERX STRATFI award from the U.S. Air Force, Skyways is creating a new form of transportation to advance our civilization from Austin, Texas.


The Opportunity

Skyways is building autonomous aircraft that are already flying real missions. The next challenge is not proving it works. It’s building it reliably, repeatedly, and at scale.

We are looking for a Director of Production to take us from low-rate builds to a true production system. This role owns everything required to make aircraft that don’t just fly once, but fly every time.

You will build the production system, not inherit one. That includes the factory, the processes, the team, and the operating cadence. This is a hands-on leadership role where execution matters more than strategy slides.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_html:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to define where Socket goes next and build the product function to support our next stage of growth. We’ve built a platform with strong product-market pull, a rapidly growing customer base, and a lot of room to grow. You’ll set the product strategy, bring our growing portfolio together into a cohesive platform, and help define what software supply chain security looks like as AI changes how software gets built.

You’ll work directly with Feross and the leadership team, and have real influence over what we build, where we invest, and how we grow. Partnering closely with Engineering, Sales, Customer Engineering, and Threat Intelligence, you’ll turn customer needs and market opportunities into clear product direction and products that ship. You’ll stay close to customers, understand where the biggest problems are, and help us focus on the opportunities that will have the greatest impact. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll shape both the big picture and the decisions that bring it to life.

You’ll also build the product function itself: establishing how we prioritize across our portfolio, make tradeoffs, measure success, and communicate our roadmap. You’ll create the practices and team that allow us to move quickly without losing focus, bringing clarity to what we’re building, why it matters, and how each product fits into the bigger picture.

What You'll Do

  • Set product strategy across Socket’s portfolio. Connect customer needs, market opportunities, and our technical strengths to a focused set of priorities.

  • Get close to customer problems. Join customer calls, learn from support and sales conversations, and understand what’s behind a feature request before deciding how to solve it.

  • Partner with Engineering to turn complex security challenges into intuitive, technically sound products. Define clear requirements and success metrics, help navigate technical trade-offs, and give engineers the ownership to determine how we build.

  • Make prioritization decisions explicit. Balance customer commitments, support escalations, reliability, and new opportunities against engineering capacity. Be clear about product boundaries and what a new priority displaces.

  • Own outcomes, not just launches. Define the customer impact we’re aiming for, the assumptions we need to validate, and how we’ll measure success. Use adoption data and customer feedback to inform what we do next.

  • Partner with Sales on positioning, demos, and launches that clearly communicate what we’re building, who it’s for, and why it matters.

  • Build a practical way to plan and communicate product work. Keep priorities, decisions, and roadmaps clear, and help customer-facing teams distinguish commitments from ideas we’re still exploring.

  • Grow the product function over time. Help shape how we hire, collaborate, and develop the team while staying close to the work.

What You'll Bring

  • Senior product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from strategy through launch and learning from the results.

  • Experience building for developers, security teams, or other technical users, ideally in security, infrastructure, or B2B software.

  • Technical fluency. You can work through architecture and implementation trade-offs, ask good questions, and earn the trust of engineers.

  • Strong product judgment. You can separate important problems from competing requests, set boundaries, and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • An understanding of how customer value translates into business results. You know how technical products are evaluated, adopted, and expanded within an organization.

  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain complex problems simply, document the reasoning behind a decision, and help teams understand what we’re doing and why.

  • A hands-on approach. You’re comfortable building where there’s no established playbook, creating structure where it helps, and moving quickly without losing sight of the details.

  • Preferred

    • Experience with software supply chain security, application security, vulnerability management, or developer tooling.

    • Experience building a product function at an early-stage company while continuing to ship.

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About the Role

Socure is building the future of trust for digital ecosystems. To accelerate our mission, we are expanding the platform to include agentic workflows and internal productivity tools that power innovation across the company. These systems will underpin how Socure builds, deploys, and scales AI-driven identity solutions while enabling internal teams to operate with speed, intelligence, and precision.

Reporting to the Head of New Product Engineering, you'll join a new Internal AI Engineering team with a mandate to design and ship the agentic systems that reshape how Socure operates across sales, marketing, revenue ops, finance, talent, and legal. As a Staff AI Engineer on this team, you'll define what to build - not just execute what's been scoped. You'll be the first major internal partner building on Socure's Agentic AI Foundations platform - using its primitives to ship faster and providing the real-world pull-through that shapes its roadmap. By delivering intelligent automation and agentic workflows you will play a central role in Socure's transformation into an AI-native company, driving step-function gains in efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making across the enterprise.

What You'll Do

  • Prioritization of High-Impact Automation - Partner with business teams (e.g., Revenue Ops, Marketing, Finance Ops, Talent Acquisition) to catalog manual, high-frequency workflows and rank them by impact, feasibility, and urgency.

  • Production Agent Design & Development - Build multi-step, tool-augmented agent workflows that can plan, execute, observe outcomes, and iteratively improve. Design and implement planner–executor and reflection-based architectures to enhance reasoning quality and task reliability. Develop stateful agent systems and incorporate human-in-the-loop controls, including approval gates, fallback paths, and escalation mechanisms.

  • Platform Integration - Leverage the Agentic AI Foundations team's platform covering agent runtime, orchestration, memory, tool registry, guardrails, and observability. Provide feedback that shapes platform priorities.

  • Innovation & Standards - Leverage LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms to create differentiated internal solutions that can't be bought off the shelf. Stay ahead of emerging AI technologies and regulatory frameworks to ensure Socure leads the industry in secure, compliant, and intelligent internal systems.

  • Technical Patterns - Discover reusable agent design patterns while building real workflows and contribute them back to the Agentic AI Foundations paved paths so the work compounds across Socure.

  • Operational Excellence - Leverage the evaluation harness and tracing substrate provided by Agentic AI Foundations for continuous performance assessment, failure-mode analysis, and optimization of speed and accuracy of specific agentic solutions.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems or LLM-powered applications in production.

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs and at least one agentic framework (e.g. LangGraph, CrewAI or AutoGen).

  • Strong Python skills and experience building production-grade backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.

  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguity: you've walked into an undefined problem space, figured out what to build, built it, and measured the results.

  • Experience shipping AI/automation solutions that directly impacted business operations.

  • Strong systems thinking: you design for reliability, observability, and maintainability from day one, not as an afterthought.

  • Ability to collaborate directly with non-technical business stakeholders to understand their actual workflows and translate those into technical solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience with multi-agent systems, workflow orchestration, or complex tool-use patterns in production.

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, Arize, or custom eval pipelines) for AI systems (agent reliability, accuracy benchmarking, failure-mode analysis).

  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, or memory/grounding systems.

  • Experience with real-time or streaming AI systems.

  • Familiarity with AI safety and security practices, including prompt injection prevention, hallucinations mitigation and data protection/privacy.

  • Background in a regulated industry (fintech, healthcare, government) where compliance and security review processes are standard.

  • Experience with agent skill abstraction and structured tool integration via MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling or similar protocols.

  • Experience with AWS-hosted LLM infrastructure (Bedrock, AgentCore/Strands, Lambda, SageMaker) or equivalent cloud ML services.

jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

Senior Product Manager, Identity Products

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to build and take to market a new category of products at Socure: proactive identity notifications. These are subscription products that continuously monitor identities on our customers' behalf and push an alert when something material about that identity changes.

This is a zero-to-one role with a near-term launch. You will own the first product in this line end to end: defining what good looks like, closing any performance gaps that stand between us and a product customers will pay for, shaping the event contract and subscription model, and running it from beta through GA. More event types will follow close behind, and the scope will continue to expand as the portfolio grows.

Data is the heart of this role. The quality of a proactive notification product is the quality of the data underneath it: how much of the real world it sees, how accurate it is, and how quickly it knows. You will own that. You will establish the performance metrics that define success, decide what we need to source and what a candidate source has to prove, and make the call on which sources have earned their place and which have not. A dedicated Data Partnerships team runs discovery, negotiation, licensing, and vendor management against the brief you set, alongside data science and engineering.

You will also own commercialization. Pricing and packaging, commercial terms, early-adopter recruitment, beta and GA phasing, enablement, and coordinating every function to a launch date all sit with you.

This is a highly technical and highly commercial role. It suits a PM who is equally comfortable arguing about precision and recall methodology with a data scientist in the morning and defending a pricing model to the executive team in the afternoon.

What you'll do

Product definition and launch

  • Own the roadmap, definition, and launch of proactive identity notification products, from first beta customer through general availability.

  • Define the customer-facing event contract: what the notification contains, its lifecycle semantics, and how customers consume and act on it.

  • Design a systematic customer feedback loop so every notification we send makes the next one better.

  • Begin the product definition for the next event types on the roadmap, where the customer problem is more open-ended and the framing work is still to be done.

Data source strategy

  • Own what we source and why: define the gaps in our coverage, specify what a candidate source must prove, and set the bar it has to clear. Data Partnerships runs discovery and commercial negotiation against that brief.

  • Run rigorous, hypothesis-driven evaluations that measure incremental lift rather than headline coverage claims, and make the buy, build, or walk-away call.

  • Specify the licensing, retention, and derivative-use terms the product needs, and treat them as first-class inputs to every sourcing decision rather than an afterthought. Legal, Data Protection, and Data Partnerships paper the deal.

  • Hold the portfolio to its KPIs: decide which sources have earned their cost, which need renegotiating, and which to retire.

Performance measurement and KPIs

  • Define and instrument the KPIs for this product line, including coverage, precision, and recency, and build the internal benchmarking capability to measure them independent of customer-reported feedback.

  • Go a step further than measurement: define the target for each KPI that constitutes winning in the market. This requires competitive benchmarking and direct customer research, and it is the most important judgment call in the role.

  • Quantify the incremental value a subscriber receives per period, and use it to inform pricing and positioning.

  • Use SQL and analytics tooling to interrogate the data yourself rather than waiting on someone else's analysis.

Architecture and platform partnership

  • Partner with platform engineering teams to define how identity signals are resolved, merged across sources, and published, and make the architectural tradeoff calls on where that processing belongs.

  • Shape a generalized, reusable notification mechanism so each new event type is faster to ship than the last.

  • Balance latency, cost, and refresh cadence against the customer value each incremental improvement buys.

Commercialization and go-to-market

  • Define pricing, packaging, and commercial terms for a subscription product, in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Revenue.

  • Identify, recruit, and work hand-in-hand with early-adopter and design-partner customers.

  • Establish and track beta and GA phases, and coordinate cross-functional readiness, including end-to-end testing, to a committed date.

  • Build the positioning, marketing plan, and sales enablement materials with Product Marketing, and be the internal subject matter expert the field relies on.

Customer and competitive research

  • Build a firm, evidence-based read on how we perform against market leaders and where our real differentiation lies.

jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

Role overview

Socure is redefining digital identity. Our products help organizations establish trust, prevent fraud, manage risk, and make better decisions across digital journeys.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help make Socure’s products clear, trustworthy, and fast. Depending on business priorities, you may work on RiskOS workflows, agentic experiences, self-serve onboarding, Document Verification, customer and developer experiences, or new product opportunities. You will work on problems that span complex enterprise workflows, AI-assisted decisioning, customer onboarding, and the systems that help customers move from evaluation to successful operation.

This is a hands-on product design role for someone who can move confidently from research and problem framing through exploration, prototyping, testing, detailed execution, and launch. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, solution consultants, customer-facing teams, and design leadership to reduce the time and effort required to understand, adopt, integrate, and operate Socure products.

The right candidate does not need to be an expert in identity or fraud on day one. They need strong product judgment, systems thinking, curiosity about technical systems, and the ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into simple, clear solutions without oversimplifying the decisions that matter.

Role details

  • Team: Design

  • Title: Senior Product Designer

  • Location: San Francisco, CA · Hybrid

  • Level: Senior · IC

  • Type: Full-time

  • Start: Immediate

What you’ll do

Understand the problem

  • Work with researchers, product managers, engineers, solution consultants, and customers to understand builder goals, technical constraints, operational needs, and barriers to adoption.

  • Partner with the researcher to conduct customer interviews, usability studies, workflow reviews, competitive research, and product-data analysis.

  • Synthesize research and product signals into clear themes, opportunity areas, user needs, and design implications.

  • Build enough domain fluency in identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC, watchlist screening, compliance, and risk decisioning to make responsible design decisions.

Frame the right problem

  • Turn ambiguous business and customer needs into clearly framed problems, measurable outcomes, and practical design hypotheses.

  • Map end-to-end customer and user journeys across product discovery, onboarding, configuration, integration, decisioning, case management, operations, and ongoing use.

  • Identify where customers lose time, confidence, or momentum—and help the team prioritize the problems with the greatest effect on activation, time-to-value, implementation effort, and trust.

  • Partner with product and engineering early enough to shape the problem and solution, not just polish a predetermined feature.

Explore and validate solutions

  • Generate and compare multiple approaches before converging on a direction.

  • Design flows for use-case discovery, account setup, workflow configuration, agent interaction, API keys, test identities, sandbox testing, usage visibility, case management, production readiness, and ongoing operations.

  • Prototype at the right fidelity—from quick flows and low-fidelity concepts to realistic Figma, coded, or AI-assisted prototypes connected to representative states and data.

  • Test concepts with customers and internal users, document what was learned, and iterate quickly based on evidence.

  • Design for the full range of states that make technical products usable: loading, empty, success, partial completion, validation, permissions, errors, unavailable services, uncertain results, and recovery.

Deliver high-quality product design

  • Produce clear, detailed designs and specifications that engineers can build accurately and efficiently.

  • Connect product interfaces, APIs, documentation, dashboards, hosted UI, agentic interactions, developer tools, and operational workflows into coherent experiences.

  • Make complex RiskOS capabilities—identity graph, Sigma fraud models, Predictive DocV, watchlist screening, KYC, fraud, and compliance workflows—understandable to builders without hiding meaningful tradeoffs.

  • Design experiences that help customers move from understanding a problem to evaluating, configuring, integrating, and successfully operating a Socure solution.

  • Partner through implementation, review working software, perform design QA, and refine the experience based on real behavior and feedback.

  • Present work clearly, explain tradeoffs, respond constructively to critique, and make decisions visible to cross-functional partners.

Use AI to increase speed and quality

  • Use tools such as Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor to accelerate research synthesis, content exploration, flow generation, prototyping, design critique, documentation, and design QA.

  • Use AI as a collaborator for breadth and speed while applying independent judgment to evaluate outputs, protect user trust, and make the final design decisions.

  • Create realistic prototypes and testable product concepts with AI-assisted or coded workflows when static screens cannot answer the product question.

  • Document important context, design rationale, behavioral rules, and edge cases so that both people and AI-assisted development tools can use the work accurately.

  • Help the team develop responsible patterns for AI-assisted design, including privacy, security, transparency, human oversight, and safe handling of customer information.

Strengthen the system around the work

  • Contribute reusable patterns to the Socure design system across navigation, forms, workflow configuration, status, permissions, API keys, environments, testing, billing, and usage.

  • Identify when a new component, pattern, or content convention should become part of the shared system rather than a one-off solution.

  • Work with designers and engineers to improve consistency between Figma, coded components, documentation, and shipped product behavior.

  • Share methods, findings, and practical feedback through design critiques, working sessions, and cross-functional reviews.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of product design experience designing and shipping digital products, with ownership of meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery.

  • A portfolio showing strong end-to-end product thinking: the problem, the evidence, the options considered, the final experience, the implementation, and the outcome.

  • Experience designing self-serve, product-led, developer-facing, SaaS, fintech, workflow, platform, or other technically complex products.

  • Strong research and synthesis skills. You can choose an appropriate method, ask useful questions, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and turn findings into decisions.

  • Strong problem-framing skills. You can define the user, context, unmet need, business objective, constraints, and success measures before jumping into screens.

  • Strong interaction and visual design craft, including information architecture, workflows, forms, states, content hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

  • Experience exploring multiple directions and validating concepts through prototypes, usability testing, customer feedback, or product data.

  • Ability to design for complex systems and non-happy paths, including permissions, configuration, dependencies, errors, asynchronous work, and transitions between environments.

  • Product judgment: you understand how design can improve activation, conversion, time-to-value, implementation effort, retention, operational efficiency, and customer trust.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to collaborate with engineers on APIs, data, system behavior, integrations, front-end constraints, and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable learning how the product works.

  • Experience working with a design system and contributing patterns that are reusable, accessible, documented, and feasible to implement.

  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI, Cursor, or comparable tools to improve speed, exploration, research, prototyping, or documentation.

  • The judgment to know when AI output is useful, when it is misleading, and what still requires human research, reasoning, taste, and accountability.

  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain complex ideas to executives, product managers, engineers, researchers, and customers.

  • Comfort working in an environment where priorities evolve, information is incomplete, and progress depends on proactive collaboration.

What success looks like

In this role, you will help Socure:

  • Reduce the time it takes for a new customer to understand the right solution and reach a meaningful first test.

  • Make Socure products easier to understand, evaluate, configure, integrate, and operate across enterprise, self-serve, and agentic experiences.

  • Increase confidence in Socure’s risk decisions by making system behavior, status, requirements, and next steps clear.

  • Reduce avoidable implementation and support effort through better flows, reusable patterns, and clearer documentation.

  • Help product and engineering teams make better decisions earlier through research, prototypes, and explicit design rationale.

  • Increase design throughput without lowering the quality, accessibility, consistency, or trustworthiness of the experience.

Tools and environment

  • Figma and Figma AI

  • Claude and ChatGPT

  • Cursor and AI-assisted coding or prototyping tools

  • Design systems and component libraries

  • Prototyping and usability-testing tools

  • APIs, documentation, dashboards, hosted components, agentic workflows, and enterprise product experiences

  • Analytics, customer feedback, research repositories, and product-data tools

We use Figma as our primary design tool and actively incorporate AI-assisted workflows into how we research, explore, prototype, document, and review product experiences. We are interested in candidates who are curious and practical about these tools—not candidates who use AI as a substitute for design thinking.

Nice to have

  • Experience with developer tools, APIs, SDKs, webhooks, hosted UI components, or technical documentation.

  • Experience designing sandbox, test-mode, simulation, staging, environment-management, or operational workflows.

  • Experience with pricing, billing, usage metering, credits, entitlements, or plan comparisons.

  • Experience in fintech, identity, fraud, compliance, crypto, marketplaces, infrastructure, or other trust-sensitive domains.

  • Basic familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or front-end implementation.

  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows, agentic products, conversational interfaces, or systems with probabilistic outputs.

  • Experience working with accessibility standards, content design, or responsible AI and trust patterns.

About the team

You’ll join a collaborative product design team working closely with product, engineering, research, growth, solution consulting, customer success, and other customer-facing teams. The team values strong craft, direct communication, thoughtful research, rapid learning, and close partnership through implementation.

This role has meaningful ownership from day one. You will be expected to lead the design work for defined product areas, influence decisions through evidence and clear reasoning, and raise the quality of the work around you through collaboration and critique. You will have support from design leadership and senior partners while remaining accountable for moving your work forward.

Portfolio requirement

A portfolio is required. Please show one or two substantial product-design projects that demonstrate how you:

  • Understood the users and business context.

  • Framed the problem and defined success.

  • Used research, data, or testing to guide decisions.

  • Explored alternatives and made tradeoffs.

  • Designed the complete experience, including important states and edge cases.

  • Worked with engineering through implementation.

  • Measured or assessed the outcome and learned from it.

We care about the quality of the thinking and the shipped result—not only polished screens.

About Socure

Socure is the leading AI identity verification and fraud prevention platform, trusted by over 3,000 customers including top financial institutions, fintechs, and government agencies.

Socure’s products bring together identity intelligence, fraud prevention, document verification, compliance checks, and AI-native decisioning to help organizations establish trust and manage risk. Our teams are building the next generation of experiences across RiskOS, self-serve products, agentic workflows, Document Verification, and other products that make trusted digital interactions possible.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer – Backend Platforms and Agentic & ML Systems to help build the backend, artificial intelligence, and machine-learning foundations that power Socure’s agentic investigation systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to work across backend services, distributed systems, AI agents, retrieval, machine-learning models, and production infrastructure. You will design, implement, test, and operate software that supports agent orchestration, asynchronous workflows, knowledge retrieval, model integration, evaluation, and reliable production operation.

You will contribute to systems supporting multi-step investigations across use cases such as watchlist review, sanctions and PEP matching, adverse-media analysis, fraud-ring correlation, case management, and other risk and compliance workflows.

A key part of the role is helping agents work with accurate, relevant, and timely domain knowledge. You will build capabilities that dynamically provide contextual information to agents, combine structured and unstructured data, support knowledge-graph and retrieval workflows, and preserve evidence and provenance for downstream decisions.

You will work with experienced engineers, machine-learning practitioners, product partners, and investigation experts to turn complex problems into dependable software. The role is calibrated for an engineer who can own well-scoped features and components, learn quickly, contribute to design discussions, and grow toward broader technical ownership.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and operate backend services that support agent orchestration, task execution, state management, model integrations, and investigation workflows.

  • Build synchronous and asynchronous workflows for agent tasks, including queues, retries, resumability, cancellation, idempotency, scheduling, and failure recovery.

  • Contribute to agent frameworks and developer harnesses that support tool calling, structured outputs, reusable skills, actor-based workflows, human review, and policy-controlled execution.

  • Implement services that dynamically inject relevant knowledge into agent workflows based on investigation type, entity context, workflow state, customer policy, prior findings, and current task requirements.

  • Build domain-grounding capabilities that help agents distinguish authoritative facts, customer-defined policies, derived signals, hypotheses, and unverified observations.

  • Develop knowledge-ingestion and enrichment pipelines that normalize, classify, chunk, index, version, and refresh structured and unstructured data.

  • Implement retrieval workflows using combinations of semantic search, lexical search, metadata filtering, hybrid retrieval, reranking, entity-aware retrieval, and temporal filtering.

  • Contribute to knowledge-graph systems that represent entities, relationships, events, evidence, provenance, and risk signals.

  • Support graph traversal, multi-hop retrieval, graph-enhanced context assembly, and integration between graph, vector, search, document, and API-based data sources.

  • Implement context-selection logic that balances relevance, freshness, source authority, latency, tenant permissions, and model context limits.

  • Add safeguards against stale, contradictory, duplicated, irrelevant, poisoned, or unauthorized information entering agent contexts.

  • Build state and memory capabilities for agents, including short-term task state, investigation history, entity context, retrieval state, and provenance.

  • Integrate agents with internal APIs, identity and risk data sources, case-management systems, watchlist systems, model endpoints, webhooks, and event streams.

  • Develop secure connector and tool-execution patterns, including authentication, authorization, credential management, tenant isolation, audit logging, and sandboxed execution where appropriate.

  • Integrate machine-learning models used for classification, ranking, extraction, entity resolution, summarization, and other investigation-related capabilities.

  • Partner with machine-learning and data-science teammates on feature definitions, training data preparation, labeling strategies, dataset quality, model interfaces, and deployment workflows.

  • Contribute to model training, fine-tuning, and adaptation workflows, including dataset preparation, experiment tracking, evaluation, versioning, deployment, and rollback.

  • Implement model-serving and model-routing integrations that select models based on task requirements, latency, cost, quality, context, and data boundaries.

  • Improve system performance through caching, batching, parallel execution, retrieval optimization, context reduction, model selection, prompt optimization, and efficient inference configuration.

  • Build evaluation and regression tests for retrieval quality, grounding, citation correctness, model behavior, tool selection, workflow completion, and end-to-end investigation outcomes.

  • Create test cases covering domain-specific scenarios, ambiguous cases, adversarial inputs, policy variations, knowledge freshness, retrieval failures, and production incidents.

  • Instrument services with logs, metrics, traces, latency measurements, cost attribution, retrieval diagnostics, model-version tracking, and operational dashboards.

  • Use production telemetry, failed runs, investigator feedback, and evaluation results to improve prompts, tools, memory, knowledge sources, model behavior, and workflow design.

  • Participate in on-call and incident response for systems owned by the team. Help improve monitoring, service-level objectives, capacity planning, and recovery procedures.

  • Write technical designs, document implementation decisions, participate in code and design reviews, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

  • Collaborate with Product, Fraud and Risk, Investigation Operations, Platform Engineering, SRE, Security, Privacy, and Data Science.

  • Contribute to engineering standards for testing, observability, deployment, security, maintainability, and responsible AI development.

Job Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Professional experience building software or backend services, including experience taking features from implementation through testing and production operation.

  • Experience with backend development, API design, service-oriented architectures, asynchronous programming, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

  • Understanding of distributed-system concepts such as queues, retries, idempotency, timeouts, concurrency, partial failures, and service reliability.

  • Experience with a programming language used for backend or data-intensive systems, such as Python, Java, Go, TypeScript, or a comparable language.

  • Experience building applications that use large language models, AI agents, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, structured generation, or related generative-AI technologies.

  • Understanding of agent architecture, including orchestration, state transitions, task execution, tool use, context management, memory, human escalation, and observability.

  • Experience building backend services, agent components, developer tooling, data pipelines, or other reusable platform capabilities.

  • Experience grounding AI or agent workflows with domain knowledge, entity context, customer policies, case history, live data, model outputs, or other task-relevant information.

  • Practical understanding of retrieval concepts such as embeddings, vector search, lexical search, metadata filtering, hybrid retrieval, reranking, query expansion, or multi-stage retrieval.

  • Experience with one or more of the following: knowledge graphs, graph databases, entity graphs, graph traversal, graph-enhanced retrieval, entity resolution, ontology or schema design, provenance, or temporal data modeling.

  • Experience combining structured data, unstructured documents, search systems, vector retrieval, and live API-based data sources.

  • Understanding of context assembly and prompt-context construction, including relevance, freshness, source authority, permissions, context size, latency, and deduplication.

  • Working knowledge of machine-learning concepts, including supervised learning, classification, ranking, embeddings, feature engineering, model evaluation, data quality, and model drift.

  • Experience supporting machine-learning workflows such as dataset preparation, labeling, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model evaluation, versioning, deployment, or monitoring.

  • Experience evaluating AI or machine-learning systems using offline datasets, regression tests, production monitoring, task-level metrics, or qualitative review.

  • Experience optimizing AI or ML systems for latency, throughput, cost, and quality through caching, batching, parallelism, retrieval optimization, context reduction, model selection, or inference configuration.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized environments, preferably AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with several of the following: relational databases, queues or event streams, object storage, caching systems, search platforms, vector databases, graph databases, and observability platforms.

  • Understanding of service authentication, authorization, secrets management, tenant isolation, data protection, and privacy-sensitive system design.

  • Ability to write maintainable, well-tested code and troubleshoot issues using logs, metrics, traces, debuggers, and other engineering tools.

  • Ability to break down technical problems, estimate work, identify dependencies, raise risks, and deliver features with appropriate guidance.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and an ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, data science, and operations partners.

  • Startup DNA required: you thrive in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments and take ownership like a founder, not an employee.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI or machine-learning systems for fraud, identity, financial crime, compliance, trust and safety, investigations, or other regulated domains.

  • Experience with agent frameworks, model gateways, evaluation and tracing platforms, GraphRAG, enterprise search, MCP-style connectors, or custom orchestration systems.

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, vLLM, GPU-backed inference, or comparable technologies.

  • Experience deploying fine-tuned or domain-specific models alongside larger managed models.

  • Experience with workflow engines, durable execution, distributed task processing, or long-running job orchestration.

  • Experience with graph databases or graph-processing technologies such as Neo4j, Neptune, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or comparable systems.

  • Experience building data-enrichment pipelines, entity-resolution systems, semantic search, knowledge platforms, or retrieval-augmented applications.

  • Experience with model monitoring, feature and data drift detection, experiment tracking, model governance, or responsible AI practices.

  • Experience improving agent and model behavior using traces, evaluation results, investigator feedback, retrieval diagnostics, and production failures.

  • Experience working with fraud, identity, risk, compliance, or other high-consequence data.

  • Contributions to reusable libraries, technical documentation, testing frameworks, architecture patterns, or engineering practices.
