jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to join our Digital Intelligence team and lead the evolution of our Device Recognition products. In this role, you will own the technology that recognizes devices across sessions, customers, and channels, and binds them to verified identity through Socure's Global Device ID and Identity Graph. You will define how we collect signals through our Web and Mobile SDKs, how we build durable device fingerprints across browsers, operating systems, and device types, and how recognition holds up as platforms tighten their privacy controls.

Reporting directly to the Head of Digital Intelligence Products, you will work at the intersection of device intelligence, data science, and massive-scale engineering. You won't just be writing tickets; you will be deep in the data, writing your own queries, building prototypes, and testing hypotheses before the team commits to building.

This role is open to current product managers and to experienced engineers who want to branch out into product. If you have built device fingerprinting or tracking technology, are comfortable debating methods and trade-offs with engineers & data scientists, and measure your work by outcomes, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Device Recognition Roadmap: Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for Device Recognition and the Global Device ID, improving recognition accuracy, persistence over time, and linking of devices across customers. You will own priorities, scope, and release trade-offs.

  • Define Signal Collection: Partner with Engineering to define, prioritize, and deliver signal collection across our Web, iOS, and Android SDKs. You will own the trade-offs between signal richness, SDK footprint, performance, and privacy on each platform.

  • Navigate Platform Nuances: Track and respond to changes across browsers, operating systems, and device types, including privacy features such as tracking prevention, storage partitioning, fingerprinting protections, and app tracking restrictions that affect recognition.

  • Get Your Hands Dirty: Write your own SQL, analyze signal stability and distributions, and build prototypes to validate ideas before engineering invests in them.

  • Data Science Partnership: Work hand-in-hand with Data Scientists on the matching and linking logic behind device recognition. Together with Data Science and Engineering, you will define acceptance criteria for recognition performance (e.g., match rate, false merge and false split rates) and track them in production.

  • Continuous Discovery & Experimentation: Utilize prototyping and experimentation to de-risk solutions before building. You will validate hypotheses about signal stability, spoofing, emulators, and anti-detect browsers through data analysis and pilot programs.

  • Customer Evaluation: Define how customers evaluate and calibrate Device Recognition, including POCs against competitors.

  • Cross-Suite Integration: Engage with internal product teams to ensure Device Recognition integrates seamlessly with Behavioral Analytics, the broader Digital Intelligence suite, and other Socure Products (RiskOS, Document Verification, etc…) to provide a unified risk score to our clients.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to help drive adoption and usage, create technical documentation, and evangelize the product to clients in Fintech, E-commerce, and Gaming.

  • Support Wider Digital Intelligence Initiatives: Provide product expertise and support for adjacent Digital Intelligence products and critical initiatives, ensuring resource alignment with the highest company priorities.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Management or Software Engineering experience, with at least 2+ years in a highly technical domain (Device Intelligence, Fraud Prevention, Identity, Cybersecurity, or AdTech). Engineers moving into product are welcome; tell us about the products you shaped.

  • Device Fingerprinting & Tracking: Hands-on experience building or managing device fingerprinting, device recognition, or tracking technology. You understand how browser, hardware, and network attributes combine into a device identifier, and where each one breaks down.

  • SDK & Platform Depth: You understand data collection through JavaScript and native SDKs, and the nuances between web, iOS, and Android, as well as across browsers and device types. You know what changes when a user goes incognito, clears storage, updates an OS, or runs an emulator or anti-detect browser.

  • Hands-On Technical Fluency: You are proficient in SQL and comfortable performing your own data analysis to answer questions without waiting for an analyst. You can build working prototypes in Python or a similar language. You understand API design (REST/JSON) and the basics of machine learning pipelines.

  • Outcome Over Output: You are goal oriented and focus on moving business metrics (e.g., "Increase cross-customer device recognition by 20%") rather than just shipping features. You are familiar with setting and tracking KPIs like match rates, False Positive Rates, and Fraud Detection Rates.

  • Problem Solving: You can partner with engineering and data science to break down complex, ambiguous problems, like "how do we recognize a returning device after its browser storage has been cleared?", into shippable iterations.

  • AI Fluency: You use AI tools in your daily work, including data analysis with Data Science, prototyping, and reporting.

  • Communication: You communicate clearly and concisely, in writing and in person, with engineers, data scientists, customers, and executives.

Bonus Points

  • Device-Focused Company Experience: Prior experience at iovation, Sardine, Fingerprint, ThreatMetrix, IPQS, or other device-focused companies.

  • Device Integrity & Attestation: Familiarity with hardware-backed and platform signals such as Apple App Attest, DeviceCheck, and Google Play Integrity.

  • Graph & Entity Resolution: Experience linking entities (devices, users, accounts) across large datasets, including identity graphs.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of privacy landscapes regarding device data and tracking (GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA) and how consent and retention requirements influence product architecture.

  • Network Intelligence: Experience with IP, proxy, VPN, and carrier signals and how they complement device recognition.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Ecosystem
jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Socure’s Partner Ecosystem brings third-party data and decisioning partners into RiskOS. Every partner we onboard has to be integrated cleanly, operated reliably, implemented correctly in customer environments, and understood well enough that our Solutions and Sales teams can put it to work. This role owns the technical side of all of it.

You will be the technical point of accountability for the RiskOS partner ecosystem. You will align with partners on an integration approach. Solutions teams come to you when an implementation doesn't behave. You will define scope, requirements, and priority for the Partner Integration engineering pod. Internal teams come to you to understand what a partner product actually does and when to use it.

This is not just a coordination or ticket-writing role. You will personally run partner API discovery, write the specs the pod builds from, sit in the middle of live troubleshooting, and own the documentation the rest of the company depends on. You will drive the partner engineering pod's roadmap and execution without managing the engineers directly — technical credibility, clarity, and relationships are how the work gets done here.

It is also a role that will grow. As our partner marketplace takes shape, you will be the technical driver behind it: defining what it takes for a partner product to be integrated and consumed at scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own partner integrations end to end

  • Own the program for every new integration: discovery, technical scope, specs, sequencing, and launch readiness — and the pod's roadmap, priorities, and capacity tradeoffs that deliver it.

  • Establish reusable integration patterns — authentication, data mapping, error handling, retries, fallbacks — so each new partner integration is faster than the last.

  • Work with Product and Legal/GRC so contractual and compliance constraints shape the design up front rather than surface as rework.

Be the technical counterpart to our partners

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for partner engineering and solutions teams, from API discovery through release and deprecation cycles.

  • Evaluate partner APIs, data models, SLAs, and support posture to identify the optimal integration path — and push back where their proposed pattern creates fragility, latency, cost, or compliance risk.

  • Define what "integration-ready" means for the marketplace — technical requirements, certification, acceptance criteria — and eventually hold that bar with partners who build into our platform themselves.

Make partner products succeed in customer environments

  • Work with pre-sales Solutions to help them understand partner products: what they do, what they require, what they cost, and what they can't do.

  • Work with post-sales Solutions and Implementation to ensure correct configuration across sandbox and production, and flag workflow designs that will produce poor decisioning outcomes.

  • Build the enablement material that lets Solutions teams handle routine cases independently.

  • Own triage and resolution for integration escalations, define monitoring requirements for integration health, and run a recurring audit cadence that produces remediation rather than a list of known issues.

Own documentation and product expertise — and scale it with AI

  • Own the technical documentation library: integration specs, API references, configuration guides, and troubleshooting runbooks. Treat documentation drift as a defect.

  • Use AI aggressively to draft specs and documentation — with the judgment to catch hallucinated behavior and verify against source API docs — and build repeatable AI patterns so throughput isn't bound by your calendar.

  • Develop working expertise in every partner product and act as the internal explainer for Sales, Solutions, Product, and Support.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years in technical program management, technical product management, solutions architecture, solutions engineering, or integration engineering, including direct ownership of external-facing technical work.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive engineering execution without direct authority. You have owned a team's roadmap and delivery as an individual contributor and made it work through influence and credibility.

  • Deep, practical fluency with REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, data mapping and normalization, and the failure modes of third-party dependencies. You can read an API doc set and immediately identify what will break in production.

  • Strong debugging instincts across distributed systems. You are comfortable in logs, traces, and payloads, and can isolate whether a problem is ours, the partner's, or a configuration issue.

  • Proven ability to work directly with external technical teams — holding a firm technical position, saying no well, and keeping the relationship intact.

  • Genuine people skills. This role runs on relationships: with partners, with engineers you don't manage, with Solutions teams under customer pressure, and with leadership. Technical strength alone will not carry it.

  • Exceptional written communication. The specs and documentation you produce are what other teams depend on; writing is a core competency here, not a nice-to-have.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your actual workflow, with the discipline to verify output rather than trust it. You should be able to describe patterns you've built that made recurring work faster for more people than just yourself.

  • Comfort moving between a partner architecture discussion, a customer implementation escalation, and an internal enablement session in the same day.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Background in identity, fraud, risk, KYC/KYB, credit, or adjacent data-provider ecosystems.

  • Experience integrating and operating many third-party data vendors at scale, including managing vendor API versioning and deprecation.

  • Experience building or scaling a partner marketplace, app store, developer platform, or partner certification program.

  • Familiarity with decisioning or workflow orchestration platforms and how data products are composed within them.

  • Experience working alongside pre-sales and post-sales organizations in B2B enterprise SaaS.

  • Exposure to the compliance and contractual dimensions of third-party data use: data rights, permissible purpose, retention, and audit requirements.

  • Prior hands-on engineering background, even if you've since moved into solutions, program, or product work.

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. We are seeking a talented and motivated full-time Product Manager, Aperture to help shape the product strategy for Tailscale's AI gateway. Aperture gives organizations visibility and control over how their teams use AI. It routes and secures LLM traffic through Tailscale's identity layer instead of distributing API keys, so security and platform teams can see who's using which models, enforce usage policy, and eliminate key sprawl. 

You'll be the first dedicated PM on this team, working directly with our co-founder and working alongside a small, AI-native engineering team to take Aperture from its current early-stage footing into a core part of how Tailscale's customers adopt AI safely. This is a foundational role: you'll bring product rigor and customer focus to a team that's moved fast and proven real demand, and you'll have outsized influence over what Aperture becomes as it matures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape Aperture's product roadmap, in close partnership with our co-founder, Engineering Manager and the engineering team, translating a fast-moving, still-forming product area into clear priorities.
  • Work directly with reference/design-partner customers to translate their AI governance and security needs into concrete product requirements.
  • Partner with engineering to balance rapid prototyping with the production rigor required for an AI product customers depend on during their daily work.
  • Represent Aperture externally — to customers, partners, and the community — as a credible voice on AI governance and enterprise AI adoption.
  • Track and report on adoption, usage, and the metrics that matter for a product still establishing product-market fit.
  • Partner with GTM and Customer Success as Aperture moves toward defined pricing and a repeatable sales motion.

What We Are Looking For

  • Lifecycle Management: Automating the onboarding, offboarding, and synchronization (SCIM) of users and devices as they change roles or leave organizations.

Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own Tailscale's networking features — the layer that decides how traffic finds its destination by name on top of Tailscale’s seamless mesh connectivity solution. Concretely, you will own four feature sets: App Connectors, DNS, Funnel, and Tailscale Serve & Services.

A tailnet gives every device an identity and an address. Networking features are what turn addresses into something a person, a script, or an AI agent can actually use — a name, a service, an app, a URL.

  • App Connectors route traffic to specific SaaS and private applications by name, so access follows the app rather than the IP.
  • DNS — MagicDNS, split DNS, custom name servers, search domains
  • Tailscale Serve & Services make a workload — not a machine — the unit of connectivity and access: addressable, load-balanced, and durable across the instances behind it. This is the wedge that lets customers replace a service registry, and eventually much of what they use a service mesh for, with Tailscale.
  • Funnel is Tailscale's ingress story: securely exposing a Service running inside the tailnet to the public internet, from a hobbyist sharing a dev server to production webhooks and public endpoints.

This is the most user-visible role in Tailscale's Dataplane Platform, and the work is as much product design as it is networking. DNS settings, connector topologies, and service definitions are configured by network engineers and IT admins in the admin console, API, and CLI, and the distance between "magical" and "unusable" is the object model, the defaults, and the error messages. 

See How Tailscale Works, Tailscale Funnel, and Four ways to Tailscale a service to learn more.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description_html:
We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join a team dedicated to building the governed data foundation that powers decision-making across Talkiatry. You'll work alongside a collaborative team of engineers to design and maintain reliable, well-documented data models that stakeholders can trust and explore independently.

About Talkiatry:

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

 

You will:

  • Build and maintain clean, scalable, well-documented data models using dbt, Snowflake, and Databricks that serve as the trusted foundation for decision-making across the org

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business questions and translate them into governed, reusable data products — not one-off reports

  • Contribute to a self-service analytics environment where stakeholders can independently explore data through well-structured, reliable models

  • Adhere to and help evolve our data governance, data quality, and documentation standards

  • Support dashboard and reporting needs where appropriate, with an emphasis on enabling stakeholders rather than building on their behalf

  • Collaborate with data and engineering teams to ensure data products are integrated into the broader product and engineering development process from the start

Your Qualifications:

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related role

  • Proficient SQL skills with a working understanding of data modeling concepts (star schema, slowly changing dimensions, grain)

  • Hands-on experience with dbt and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery

  • Familiarity with at least one BI or data exploration tool such as Omni, Looker, or Tableau

  • A bias toward building reusable, documented, and governed data products over ad hoc solutions

  • Exposure to working cross-functionally with non-technical stakeholders to understand business needs

  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain data concepts and trade-offs to a range of audiences

Why Talkiatry:

  • Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care

  • Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup

  • Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more

  • Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands

Talkiatry participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. only after a job offer is accepted and Form I-9 is completed. For more information on E-Verify, please visit the following: EVerify Participation & IER Right to Work.

At Talkiatry, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace and candidate experience. We strive to create an environment where everyone has a sense of belonging and purpose, and where we learn from the unique experiences of those around us.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Scientist
jobs.description_html:
We are looking for a Sr. Product Data Scientist to join our growing Data team in our Product organization. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad scope across product insights, experimentation, modeling and applied analytics. The ideal candidate is not only technically strong, but also proactive in uncovering opportunities, framing insights, and ensuring leaders have the context they need to make the right calls. We are looking for this individual to bring analytical thought leadership as we continue to rapidly grow and iterate on our product offerings across Talkiatry.

You’ll own projects that range from producing growth and performance analyses that guide strategic and product decisions, to designing and evaluating experiments, to improving patient engagement and clinical efficiency. You’ll be expected to communicate insights proactively, frame results in business terms, and work closely with your core cross-functional teammates (Product, Engineering and Design) as well as stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, and Finance.

Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

You will:

Proactive Insights & Storytelling

  • Identify growth opportunities for the Product teams by analyzing data and understanding patient behaviors.

  • Help Product teams maximize impact, by working wtih PMs and engineers to understand costs and constraints, while looking at underlying data and making reasonable assumptions to size opportunities.

  • Identify risks by exploring data and monitoring trends to understand the impact of emerging issues before they become problems.

  • Frame analyses and estimates in terms of “so what” for the practice to ensure findings don’t just inform, but influence the team.

  • Develop regular deliverables that turn historical data into forward looking guidance for product and operational teams.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Clinical Hiring- Trainee Programming & Events
jobs.description_html:
Talkiatry is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Clinical Recruitment Marketing & Events to sit at the intersection of Marketing and Talent Acquisition, driving the strategy and execution of national psychiatrist and Advanced Practice Provider (APP) recruitment events. This role builds trust-based relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs, including program directors, faculty, and trainees, across the country, translating those relationships into a strong pipeline of clinicians who will join Talkiatry post-training.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role for someone who combines event strategy, marketing execution, and recruitment expertise to deliver measurable outcomes that support clinical excellence and organizational growth.

We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

What You'll Do:

Residency and Fellowship Program Outreach and Events

  • Serve as a brand ambassador for Talkiatry; engage trainees and build relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs nationwide, including program directors, faculty, program coordinators, chief residents, and chief fellows.

  • Build and grow a national footprint of target programs, prioritizing outreach based on program size, specialty focus (e.g., child & adolescent, addiction, forensic psychiatry), and geography.

  • Plan and execute dinners, social events, and virtual events for residents and fellows, and deliver ongoing clinical education and clear introductions to Talkiatry's practice management model, incentives, and a transition-to-practice pathway for those nearing graduation.

  • Articulate Talkiatry's mission and core values in ways that resonate with program leaders.

  • Maintain long-term relationships with program leaders to support annual visits (virtual or in person) and serve as a consistent, credible point of contact throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

  • Use various tools and databases to connect with residency/fellowship program contacts, and track all contacts and outreach in the ATS/CRM.

  • Collaborate with marketing on presentation materials, collateral, and e-invites.

  • Own full-cycle event planning and track fiscal activities associated with each event.

  • Attend residency and fellowship events as needed.

Networking Event Planning for Practicing Providers

  • Plan and execute virtual career/open house events:

    • Partner with marketing on content development and preparation.

    • Drive event advertising and psychiatrist outreach via social media, email blasts, etc.

    • Create event invitations and manage registration.

    • Ensure the technology platform is arranged and functioning.

    • Staff events with members of the Talkiatry clinical team.

  • Plan and execute in-person networking events, some of which are associated with conferences.

  • Track fiscal activities associated with each event.

  • Attend conferences as needed.

Conference and Event Strategy & Execution

  • Conceptualize event themes and formats tailored to each psychiatry residency/fellowship program's needs and goals.

  • Manage end-to-end event logistics: timelines, technical coordination, budgets, vendor engagement, and contract negotiation.

  • Plan and execute exhibiting at various conferences each year.

  • Manage the scheduling, agenda development for attending staff, documentation, and tracking of each event's action items, including booth selection and payment, ordering of swag, display materials, lead retrieval, booth essentials, catering, packing, and shipping, and marketing and outreach for events.

  • Track fiscal activities associated with each event.

  • Prepare post-event expenditure and outcomes reporting to track ROI and inform future event strategy.

  • Consistently exceed the annual goal of 30+ successful events per year, while identifying opportunities to scale further.

Marketing & Brand Presence

  • Develop marketing assets and social media content that support event promotion and brand visibility within the clinical/residency community.

  • Partner with the marketing team on copywriting, scripting, and editing for recruitment and brand campaigns.

Cross-Functional Recruitment Support

  • Partner closely with clinical leadership and the National Residency Team to align event strategy with recruitment goals and generate high-quality psychiatrist and APP candidates.

  • Apply recruiter-level knowledge to build lasting candidate relationships, guiding residents and fellows through interviewing, contracting, and onboarding, and remaining a point of contact for ongoing support.

  • Source and support outreach for psychiatry residency and fellowship program educational and outreach events.

Flexible, Company-Wide Support

  • Flex across departments during periods of high demand, assisting with company-wide marketing, job board management, invoicing, and contract renewals.

  • Maintain continuous communication with vendor representatives and recruitment management teams to ensure alignment.

Role Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, Communications, Business, Human Resources, or a related field required, or commensurate experience.

  • Minimum of 6-8 years of experience in talent attraction, with at least 2 of those years spent in trainee outreach (e.g., residency/fellowship, early-career, or campus recruiting), healthcare, physician recruitment, or clinical/medical education experience strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS), CRM/database tools, and standard office software (Microsoft Office / Google Workspace).

  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time, including overnight and multi-day trips to conferences and residency/fellowship programs nationwide.

  • Availability to work occasional evenings and weekends to support events.

You'll Be Successful If You:

  • Have a proven track record in physician and/or APP recruitment, ideally within psychiatry, behavioral health, or a related clinical field, and enjoy building and maintaining relationships with physicians.

  • Have demonstrated success in strategic event design and management, including budget ownership and vendor/contract negotiation.

  • Have experience building relationships with clinical stakeholders- residents, fellows, program directors, faculty, and clinical leadership, ideally within psychiatry residency or fellowship programs.

  • Are proficient with talent acquisition platforms like LinkedIn, PracticeMatch, other job boards, and applicant tracking systems.

  • Have a proven track record of delivering data-driven insights and translating those into recommendations.

  • Have strong project management skills; able to juggle multiple events, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously, and multitask under deadlines.

  • Have a high level of attention to detail.

  • Are marketing-fluent; comfortable with social media, content development, and campaign copy.

  • Have excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent the organization at conferences and tradeshows.

  • Have excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop productive working relationships across a diverse spectrum of internal and external stakeholders, exhibit sensitivity, and appreciate cultural differences.

  • Claim ownership and responsibility on projects to achieve your goals; you take initiative.

  • Are a confident problem solver who can act decisively and calmly, and who is resourceful, creative, and flexible when priorities shift in a fast-paced environment.

  • Are willing and able to travel frequently (regional/national).

  • Prior recruiting experience strongly preferred ; a background as a clinical or physician recruiter is a significant plus.

What Success Looks Like:

  • A robust, warm pipeline of psychiatry residents and fellows actively engaged with Talkiatry ahead of graduation.

  • Rolodex/Contact database of all trainees in Psychiatry, across programs in the U.S.

  • High-quality events delivered annually on budget and on strategy, resulting in leads, both warm and longer-term relationships.

  • Strong, durable relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs that make Talkiatry a repeat, trusted partner.

  • Seamless collaboration between Marketing and Talent Acquisition, with each function reinforcing the other.

Why Talkiatry:

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description_html:
Talkiatry is looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape the future of mental health care experiences across multiple strategic product areas. You'll lead design work spanning our Clinical AI products, patient portal experiences, and design system evolution—helping define how patients interact with psychiatric care in both AI-assisted and human-centered contexts.

In this role, you'll divide your time across several high-impact areas: designing AI-powered experiences that support patients between sessions, improving core patient portal flows that help people access and manage their care, and serving as a craft leader who modernizes our design system and raises the visual quality bar across all Talkiatry products.

As a Staff designer, your impact will extend beyond any single product area. You'll work closely with product, engineering, clinical, and AI partners across multiple teams, bringing both deep craft and strategic thinking to ambiguous problems. You'll help establish interaction patterns for emerging technologies while also refining foundational experiences that serve patients every day.

We're looking for a designer who is energized by variety and ambiguity, capable of moving between AI-enabled experiences and core product flows, and equally passionate about interaction design, systems thinking, and exceptional visual craft.

You will:

  • Design AI-powered experiences that support patients between scheduled psychiatry sessions, from early concepts through launch and iteration.

  • Define how patients interact with conversational AI, helping establish patterns for experiences that may not yet have conventional design precedents.

  • Improve core patient portal experiences, including intake flows, appointment management, visit preparation, and other touchpoints that help patients access and navigate their care.

  • Translate complex AI capabilities and limitations into intuitive, transparent, and trustworthy product experiences.

  • Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams across multiple product areas to shape product strategy and determine what we build.

  • Prototype and test interaction patterns—from conversational AI flows to traditional web and mobile experiences—to learn quickly and reduce uncertainty.

  • Advocate for patient needs while helping teams navigate safety, trust, accessibility, and usability considerations across both AI-powered and traditional product experiences.

  • Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Use research, product data, experimentation, and qualitative feedback to continuously improve experiences after launch.

  • Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft to all your work, from early product thinking through highly polished final execution.

  • Serve as a senior individual-contributor design leader, influencing product and design decisions across your areas of ownership and beyond.

  • Lead the evolution of Talkiatry's design system, defining the next generation of our visual design language and establishing patterns that scale across web, mobile, and emerging interaction models.

  • Raise the craft bar across the Product Design team through thoughtful critique, mentorship, collaboration, and high-quality example-setting.

You have:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, including experience owning complex digital products from discovery through implementation and iteration.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking, interaction design, and exceptional visual/UI craft. A portfolio is required for consideration.

  • Strong experience designing rich web and native mobile products.

  • Experience operating with a high degree of autonomy and leading design within ambiguous or zero-to-one product spaces.

  • Experience designing products where trust and transparency are critical to the user experience.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to design individual experiences while considering the broader product ecosystem.

  • Deep understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and responsive interface design.

  • Strong user research skills with the ability to independently plan and conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesize insights to inform design decisions.

  • Experience creating and evolving scalable design systems, or a strong point of view on how systems can improve both product quality and team velocity.

  • Strong prototyping skills and the ability to communicate complex interactions before they are fully built.

  • Experience collaborating closely with product managers and engineers and contributing meaningfully to product strategy, not just execution.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain design rationale, facilitate productive critique, and influence senior cross-functional partners.

  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and a willingness to learn through experimentation when established design patterns do not yet exist.

We'd be especially excited if you have:

  • Experience designing conversational interfaces, chat-based products, voice experiences, or AI assistants.

  • Experience designing products powered by AI, machine learning, or large language models.

  • Experience establishing interaction patterns for emerging technologies where best practices are still being defined.

  • Experience in healthcare or regulated industries.

  • Experience helping establish or significantly evolve the visual language of a product or design system.

  • Experience designing patient-facing or consumer health products.

This role includes work on emerging AI experiences, but we don't expect candidates to have spent years designing AI products. Genuine enthusiasm for the space, strong foundational product-design skills, and evidence that you can thoughtfully tackle unfamiliar interaction problems matter more than having a particular AI job title on your résumé.

Healthcare experience is not required, but is a plus.

Why Talkiatry's Product Team:

  • Make a meaningful impact: Help build products designed to expand access to high-quality mental health care and improve the patient experience.

  • Work across the product portfolio: Move between AI-powered experiences, core patient flows, and design system work, with variety and strategic influence across multiple product areas.

  • Shape an emerging product space: Work at the intersection of mental health, product design, and AI, where many of the interaction patterns have yet to be invented.

  • Join a talented, collaborative team: Work alongside experienced people across design, product, engineering, clinical care, and operations who are motivated by a shared mission.

  • Lead design system evolution: Play a central role in modernizing our design system, raising craft standards, and shaping how Product Design grows at Talkiatry.

  • Work remotely: This role is remote within the United States.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Talkiatry offers medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, generous paid time off and company holidays, paid parental leave, and additional employee benefits.

  • Keep growing: Develop new skills and expand your impact as Talkiatry and the Product Design organization continue to grow.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

About the Role

We are looking for product focused full stack engineers to work on Teleport itself. You will build the user interfaces and backend APIs to implement them for all parts of Teleport. You will work on the full product lifecycle from working with customers to understand their problems, writing RFDs for your proposed design, implementation, testing, and documentation.

Teleport is an open source project and most of the code you will write will be open source and written in Go (or Rust), TypeScript, React.

What You'll Do

  • Making Teleport more efficient by adding server-side pagination and filtering capabilities

  • Making Teleport easier to use by designing experiences that guide the user through the setup and onboarding process.

  • Building user interfaces that support our passwordless vision.

What We're Looking For

  • Go experience

  • TypeScript and React experience

  • Strong understanding of web security

How We Hire

  • You will join 30 minute intro call and we will walk you through the compensation, interview process and requirements.

  • You will join a 30 minute call with the hiring manager, and we will walk you through the take home exercise and help answer questions

  • You join a Slack channel and submit a coding challenge in Go and TypeScript using GitHub.

Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities

Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.

Candidate Privacy Notice: For information about our collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this position, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice of Collection at goteleport.com/legal/apply/job-applicant/

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Company Description

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

Role Description

As we scale our product surface area, we’re looking for Product Managers who are excited to own a variety of high-impact products, and drive outsized outcomes in hard-to-solve and ambiguous problem spaces. This is a role designed for builders who thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex user and workflow problems, and take full ownership of outcomes - from defining the problem space to shipping, scaling, and driving real customer and business impact.

As a Product Manager, you will be accountable for setting the vision, strategy, and end-to-end execution of one or more core product areas. This is not a “manage the roadmap” role—it’s a “make it successful” role. You’ll develop a deep understanding of users, their day-to-day workflows, and the broader ecosystem they operate in. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems to solve and turn messy, real-world complexity into simple, scalable experiences. You will hold the standard on quality, and not rest until your product is creating the level of impact in the field that you expect.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, customer-facing teams, and other product managers. You will lead product discovery, define clear requirements, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and push products from 0→1 and from 1→scale with urgency and clarity. This is a highly cross-functional and user-centered role—ideal for someone who loves building foundational experiences that make complex work feel effortless.

Responsibilities

  • Own the success of one or more core product areas, focusing on outcomes and real-world impact - not just outputs, timelines, or feature delivery.

  • Define and drive product vision and strategy by synthesizing user needs, workflow complexity, and business priorities into a clear, scalable roadmap.

  • Lead product discovery through user interviews, workflow mapping, usability testing, shadowing, and qualitative/quantitative research.

  • Translate ambiguous, messy problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and intuitive experiences.

  • Build, launch, and iterate on new capabilities from 0→1 and from 1→scale, ensuring fast learning cycles and high-quality execution.

  • Partner cross-functionally with design and engineering to translate product vision into intuitive user experiences that are technically feasible and built to scale.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Operations, and Marketing to ensure strong product adoption, clarity of value, and real customer impact.

  • Set a high bar for execution, usability, and coherence across the platform.


Candidate Qualifications

  • A minimum of 4 years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, workflow-heavy products, or operationally complex environments.

  • Proven ability to take ambiguous product ideas from concept to launch and from prototype to real-world usage, with thoughtful prioritization of the highest-impact problems.

  • Strong user instincts: You care deeply about how products feel, flow, and fit into people’s daily work and can uncover user needs through strong product discovery practices.

  • Technical fluency: Able to break down how complex systems work under the hood, distill technical needs and constraints, and partner with engineering to make smart tradeoffs.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to clearly articulate product decisions, tradeoffs, and priorities to diverse audiences.

  • Collaborative leader: demonstrated ability to lead across design, engineering, CX, and go-to-market teams to drive clarity, alignment, and momentum.

  • Bias to action: energized by moving fast, testing ideas, learning from feedback, and iterating.

  • Ownership mindset: accountable for outcomes, comfortable operating in low-structure environments, and eager to lead end-to-end.

Why Tennr?

  • Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.

  • Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure

  • Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.

  • Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week

  • Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

Benefits

  • Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 100% paid employee health benefit options

  • Employer funded 401(k) match

  • Competitive parental leave

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (II-III), Space Agentic AI
jobs.description_html:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

As a member of the Applied Algorithms and Autonomy team, you will contribute to the design and development of machine learning and AI capabilities for True Anomaly. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will support the development of models and pipelines that enable object classification, anomaly detection, and data-driven decision-making. You are curious, driven, and eager to grow — someone who takes ownership of their work and isn't afraid to tackle hard problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in the development, training, and evaluation of ML models across a range of mission-relevant tasks
  • Support data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering pipelines
  • Run experiments, track results, and contribute to model evaluation and iteration
  • Write clean, documented, and testable Python code as part of a collaborative engineering team
  • Learn and grow alongside senior engineers, contributing meaningfully from day one

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, machine learning, data science, electrical engineering, or a similar discipline, plus 2-4 years of experience; or a Master's degree in one of these fields with no experience required.
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and model evaluation
  • Exposure to ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX through coursework, research, or personal projects
  • Strong mathematical fundamentals in linear algebra, statistics, and probability
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment
  • Passion for spaceflight and advancing capabilities related to space domain awareness and space security

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Internship, research, or project experience applying ML to real-world or research datasets
  • Familiarity with classification, regression, clustering, or anomaly detection techniques
  • Experience with version control (Git) and basic software engineering practices
  • Exposure to MLOps concepts such as experiment tracking or model versioning
  • Coursework or project work in deep learning, computer vision, or time-series analysis

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $125,000 - $220,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience. 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work Location— this is a fully onsite role. Candidates must be based in or able to commute to our Denver or Long Beach office daily. 
  • Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
  • Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite 

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

As a Platform Engineer on the AI team, you will build the infrastructure, tooling, and integrations that put AI directly into the hands and workflows of every team across the company. This is not a research role. It is a building role. You will implement capabilities that engineers, program managers, operators, and business teams use every day to move faster and produce better work.

Your work will include building connectors between AI models and internal systems, developing custom AI-powered applications for specific workflows, implementing API integrations, and contributing to platform infrastructure. You will work closely with Senior and Staff engineers who will provide technical guidance, code review, and mentorship as you grow your expertise in AI systems and platform engineering.

The platform engineering org, reporting to the Chief Security Officer, works across the enterprise, from engineering and product to marketing and finance. You will have the opportunity to see your work directly accelerate how a fast-growing defense technology company operates with AI.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain AI platform components: API integrations, system connectors (MCP, tool use), authentication flows, and data pipelines that connect AI models to internal tools
  • Develop custom AI-powered applications and workflows for specific business use cases, working from requirements and technical designs provided by senior engineers
  • Write clean, well-tested code in Python, TypeScript, or similar languages, following team coding standards and best practices
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and platform architecture decisions, contributing your perspective and learning from more experienced engineers
  • Help maintain documentation for AI platform services, including API references, integration guides, and troubleshooting resources

Creative engineers like you are essential to this mission, to inspire, build, and ship. This is some of the most meaningful work you’ll ever do, in an industry devoted to protecting the people you care about. 

We are seeking a senior 3D developer with expertise in real-time rendering to join a growing creative team at an early and pivotal moment for the company. You'll own the visual layer of how we render the common operating picture and 3D information (orbits, spacecraft, sensor volumes, live telemetry) in the browser. This is primarily a React and three.js role, but we will also consider transferable skills from other real-time 3D environments such as Unity, Unreal, and Babylon.js. 

You’ll work directly with our Creative Director who’s building this team for people who care as much about the craft as the mission. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Nobody has defined what mission-critical space software should look and feel like. There's no decade-old design system handed down from a legacy defense contractor to follow. We're dedicated to building incredible real-time 3D content, directly in the browser, driven by live mission data, at a fidelity operators trust. This is a significant problem, and we need your help. 

You’ll have real ownership. From prototypes that shape our product strategy to the views operators depend on in no-fail environments, your work will be visible at the highest levels of government and military. If you’ve ever wanted your craft to carry real weight, then this is that job. 

  • Build and own our React and three.js rendering layer—the 3D viewport and the control measures that make up the common operating picture.
  • Turn design intent into production front end: components, interaction, motion, and the small details that make an interface feel polished.
  • Work with our data and platform engineers to render live telemetry and mission data at workable frame rates.
  • Own the 3D scene craft: renderers, materials and shaders, lighting, camera behavior, and level of detail.
  • Prototype visual and interaction concepts quickly, so we can test ideas and iterate. 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Show us things you’ve built – shipped apps, demos, experiments. What runs interests us more than what’s on a CV.
  • Strong React and TypeScript, with deep three.js or react-three-fiber experience, solid WebGL fundamentals, comfort in GLSL, and a real instinct for performance.
  • A strong visual eye. You’re a creative who codes, judging your own work the way a designer would: not just whether it runs, but whether it looks and feels right.
  • Backgrounds in games, real-time data visualization, creative technology, and interactive agencies all fit here. Defense and space knowledge is welcome, but not expected.
  • You won’t be asked to model or texture assets, but fluency with a 3D pipeline (Blender, glTF, texture and geometry budgets) is a plus.
  • Leverage your experience to work quickly and efficiently, we’re a lean team, everyone needs to pitch in and move fast.
  • Own your work end to end, from prototype to production, including the polish, the performance, and the hard problems in between.
  • Turn your hand to what's needed. Real-time 3D is your focus, but you'll also take on data visualization and standard front-end work.

  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

Software is the central nervous system for True Anomaly's engineering and product thesis. Software bridges the gap between military objectives, theoretical astrodynamics and the human and autonomous control of spacecraft and ground systems in time and space. True Anomaly is seeking a dedicated Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to drive feature development and architectural decisions across our React/TypeScript frontend and Elixir backend, shaping the evolution of our spacecraft modeling, simulation, and ground control software.

This is a high-autonomy, high-accountability role. You'll own entire feature domains from conception to production across the full stack, drive architectural decisions that affect both the frontend experience and backend infrastructure, and set the standard for code quality that junior and mid-level engineers will follow. You won't wait to be assigned work; you'll identify what needs to be done, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. When you see tech debt on either side of the stack, you'll flag it, scope it, and champion the work to address it. When patterns aren't serving us, you'll propose better ones and lead their adoption.

You do not need to have experience building space ground systems or experience in aerospace. You'll have ownership of challenging, greenfield problems and a chance to fundamentally impact the outcome of future conflict (and the future of the company), all while enjoying world-class benefits including platinum healthcare, flexible work hours/location, highly competitive compensation and a generous stock options package.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Own and deliver complex features end-to-end across the full stack, from 2D and 3D web-based frontend interfaces through distributed Elixir backend services, from technical design through production deployment and iteration
  • Drive architectural direction across frontend and backend systems, establishing patterns and conventions that scale across the team and codebase, with particular attention to the boundaries and contracts between layers
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks across the stack
  • Set the quality bar through rigorous code review, championing testing practices in both React and Elixir, and writing code that serves as a reference implementation for the team
  • Mentor and elevate junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, design discussions, and constructive code review that teaches, not just approves, helping engineers grow their skills on whichever side of the stack they're less experienced in
  • Collaborate as a technical partner with product, design, QA, space operators, and astrodynamics algorithm engineers, contributing to system-wide architectural decisions with a perspective that spans the full stack
  • Ship efficiently and iteratively, breaking complex cross-stack work into well-scoped increments while maintaining a bias toward completion over perfection
  • Document decisions and patterns, ensuring the team's collective knowledge grows and onboarding becomes easier over time

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE 

  • You see a PR from a junior engineer that implements a feature on the frontend but introduces an inefficient API call pattern; you don't just fix the frontend; you suggest a backend change that solves the problem at its root and explain the tradeoffs
  • You notice the same data transformation happening in both the Elixir backend and the React frontend; you determine the right layer for it, consolidate, and document the decision for the team
  • You're assigned a feature and the requirements are ambiguous; you proactively clarify with product and design, propose a technical approach that accounts for both frontend UX and backend system design, and share it with the team before diving into implementation
  • You see downtime as an opportunity, not a break; you're the kind of engineer who notices a flaky integration between the frontend and a WebSocket endpoint and decides to finally fix both sides
  • You disagree with an architectural decision; you articulate your concerns constructively, propose alternatives with tradeoffs, and commit fully once a decision is made
  • You're thinking beyond your current ticket; you understand how frontend features depend on backend services and vice versa, and you surface risks, coupling issues, or opportunities early

 QUALIFICATIONS 

  • 7+ years of software development experience with meaningful depth across both frontend and backend development
  • Expert-level command of HTML/CSS and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, including nuanced understanding of performance implications and browser internals
  • Deep expertise in modern React, including advanced patterns (compound components, render props, custom hooks architecture), state management strategies, and performance optimization techniques
  • Strong proficiency in Elixir and OTP, including deep understanding of BEAM internals, process architecture, supervision strategies, and fault-tolerant system design
  • Strong testing philosophy and hands-on experience across the stack, including Vitest, React Testing Library, and end-to-end testing on the frontend; ExUnit, property-based testing, and integration testing for distributed systems on the backend; you understand what to test, not just how
  • Proven experience designing and evolving component libraries, design systems, service architectures, and API boundaries Fluency with gRPC, RESTful, and WebSocket-based services, including designing APIs that serve both frontend and backend needs effectively
  • Strong database experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, and understanding of data modeling tradeoffs
  • Track record of working in Git-based workflows with high standards for commit hygiene, PR quality, and collaborative review processes
  • U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar discipline
  • Experience as a technical lead or primary implementor on a product with real users and production constraints, with responsibility spanning both frontend and backend
  • Experience building and shipping complex, data-dense applications with demanding performance requirements (large datasets, real-time updates, complex visualizations) across the full stack
  • Deep experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, or other web-based 3D libraries, including performance profiling and optimization
  • Deep understanding of OTP including BEAM scheduling, GenServers, run queues, pg, the Actor model, and advanced patterns like dynamic supervisors, registries, and distributed process groups
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and distributed tracing in production systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience in UI/UX design collaboration and tools like Figma, able to speak the language of design and advocate for engineering constraints
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills that let you thrive in a culture that values respectful, professional, and constructive conflict

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $180,000 - $265,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

  • Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

You'll implement security controls for our multi-cloud environments, working closely with staff engineers on architecture decisions while securing production workloads across Azure and AWS. Strong Azure security expertise is highly valued; deep AWS knowledge will be increasingly critical as our cloud footprint evolves. Working as part of the Platform Security team, you'll have impact within the security team and partner engineering teams.

  • Design and troubleshoot multi-account and multi-VPC network topologies—diagnosing connectivity issues and security group misconfigurations across cloud environments
  • Build automation and tooling to enforce security policies, detect misconfigurations, and respond to threats in cloud environments
  • Execute cloud security posture management (CSPM), threat detection, and incident response projects
  • Implement security improvements to infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement secure cloud architectures for new capabilities and workloads
  • Build security testing tools, CLI utilities, and dashboards to continuously validate security controls
  • Solve complex security challenges in multi-cloud environments
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate development and automate security workflows

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: comfortable with data structures, algorithms, API design, debugging production systems, and working across multiple languages
  • Strong Terraform skills including module design and infrastructure-as-code security best practices
  • Experience building security tooling or automation used by engineering teams

True Anomaly is seeking an exceptional Staff Full Stack Software Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of our spacecraft modeling, simulation, and distributed ground control platform across the entire stack.

This is a high-impact, strategic leadership role. You'll identify strategic technical investments, champion them across the organization, and lead their execution. You won't just build features; you'll shape the product direction, influence company objectives, and mentor the engineers who will build the next generation of our platform. When you see systemic issues affecting velocity, reliability, or quality across the stack, you'll diagnose root causes, build consensus around solutions, and drive organizational change to address them.

You do not need to have experience building space ground systems or experience in aerospace. You'll lead high-priority, greenfield initiatives with strategic importance to the company and a chance to fundamentally impact the outcome of future conflict (and the future of the company), all while enjoying world-class benefits including platinum healthcare, flexible work hours/location, highly competitive compensation and a generous stock options package. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Lead and deliver large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that span the entire stack, aligning frontend experience, backend infrastructure, and system architecture with strategic company objectives, from technical vision through production deployment and long-term evolution
  • Define and drive the full-stack technical roadmap and architectural strategy, establishing patterns, frameworks, and systems that enable the entire engineering organization to move faster across both React/TypeScript and Elixir codebases
  • Serve as the primary technical decision-maker for cross-stack architecture, evaluating and adopting new technologies, defining the boundaries and contracts between frontend and backend systems, and establishing engineering standards that balance innovation with maintainability
  • Proactively identify systemic technical debt, scalability challenges, and architectural limitations across the stack, then build business cases, secure buy-in, and lead multi-quarter initiatives to address them
  • Elevate the engineering organization through technical mentorship, establishing best practices, leading design reviews, and developing the skills of senior, mid-level, and junior engineers across both frontend and backend disciplines
  • Partner with executive leadership, product, design, space operations, and astrodynamics teams as a key technical stakeholder, influencing product strategy and company direction with a perspective that encompasses the entire technical surface
  • Drive engineering efficiency and excellence by establishing metrics, tooling, and processes that improve code quality, system reliability, deployment velocity, and developer experience across the stack
  • Build and maintain technical documentation, architectural decision records, and knowledge-sharing systems that scale organizational learning
  • Represent the full-stack engineering perspective in strategic planning, resource allocation, and cross-company technical decisions Identify and develop emerging technical leaders within the team, creating growth pathways and opportunities for engineers to expand their impact across the stack 

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE 

  • You recognize that the team is repeatedly solving similar problems differently across the frontend and backend; you design and champion unified patterns, drive their adoption across teams, and measure their impact on velocity and reliability
  • You identify a fundamental mismatch between the frontend data model and the backend service architecture before it becomes a scaling crisis; you build a compelling case with data, present it to leadership, secure a quarter of engineering time, and lead a coordinated migration across both layers
  • You're involved in early product strategy discussions, not just implementation; you're shaping what we build by contributing technical insights about feasibility, risk, and opportunity that account for the full system
  • A critical production issue arises that spans the frontend and backend; you quickly establish incident command, coordinate the response across teams and layers, drive it to resolution, and lead the post-mortem that prevents recurrence 
  • You see a pattern of frontend and backend engineers making architectural decisions in isolation from each other; you establish a lightweight cross-stack review process that improves decisions while respecting team autonomy
  • You're asked about the 6-month technical roadmap and can articulate not just what's being built across the stack, but why it matters, what success looks like, what the risks are, and what alternatives were considered Junior and mid-level engineers come to you not because they're stuck on a problem, but because they want to validate their architectural thinking; and you help them grow as technical decision-makers who think beyond their layer of the stack
  • You notice the team is spending significant time on a class of integration bugs between the frontend and backend; you trace it to a root architectural cause, propose a fundamental rework of the contract between layers, and lead its implementation You disagree with a strategic product or technical decision being made at the executive level; you present a well-researched alternative with clear tradeoffs and business impact, influencing the final direction 

 QUALIFICATIONS 

  • 12+ years of software development experience, with demonstrated expertise across both frontend and backend development
  • Expert-level mastery of HTML/CSS and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, including deep understanding of performance optimization, browser internals, memory management, and runtime characteristics
  • Deep expertise in modern React and the broader frontend ecosystem, including architectural patterns for large-scale applications, advanced state management, performance profiling and optimization, and emerging frontend technologies
  • Expert-level mastery of Elixir and OTP, including deep understanding of BEAM internals, scheduling, memory management, garbage collection, process architecture, and runtime characteristics at scale
  • Deep expertise in designing, building, and evolving large-scale distributed systems, including architectural patterns for fault tolerance, consistency, availability, clustering, and horizontal scalability
  • Proven track record of establishing comprehensive testing strategies across the full stack, including unit, integration, property-based, and end-to-end, including championing testing culture and tooling adoption 
  • Extensive experience designing, building, and evolving component libraries, design systems, service architectures, and internal infrastructure that serve multiple teams and products
  • Expert-level understanding of distributed systems integration patterns including gRPC, REST, WebSockets, and GraphQL, with experience defining API contracts and influencing architecture decisions across the stack
  • History of leading technical initiatives in Git-based workflows, establishing code review standards, and fostering collaborative engineering culture
  • U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar discipline
  • Proven experience as a technical lead, staff engineer, or principal engineer on production systems with significant user bases and business-critical requirements, with responsibility spanning multiple layers of the stack 
  • Track record of leading large-scale migrations, architectural overhauls, or platform rewrites across frontend and backend systems while maintaining product velocity and system reliability
  • Deep expertise building and optimizing complex, data-intensive applications with demanding performance requirements (real-time processing, large-scale datasets, complex visualizations, distributed systems) across the full stack Advanced proficiency with Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, or other web-based 3D rendering technologies, including low-level performance optimization and shader programming
