  • Advanced experience with database design and optimization at scale, including PostgreSQL internals, replication strategies, and data modeling for distributed systems Extensive experience with monitoring, observability, and distributed tracing across the full stack, including designing observability strategies and incident response frameworks
  • Experience bridging engineering and design through deep UI/UX collaboration, design systems development, and tools like Figma, able to influence design decisions with technical constraints and possibilities
  • Experience in highly regulated industries (aerospace, defense, healthcare, finance) with understanding of compliance, security, and operational constraints

You will lead complex payload programs from requirements definition through design, development, qualification, production, integration, and operational deployment. You will also manage vertical integration projects that connect payloads with the spacecraft bus, flight software, ground systems, launch operations, and mission architecture.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at the intersection of technical execution and program leadership. You will proactively manage risk, resolve cross-functional dependencies, guide tradeoffs, and create the structure required to deliver cutting-edge systems in a high-ambiguity, fast-paced environment. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

YOUR MISSION

The Technical Program Manager, System Data Analysis serves as a technical data integrator across subsystem and system-level test activities, transforming engineering, test, and mission data into accurate, actionable insights before and after test campaigns. This role is focused on technical data integration & analysis, supporting test planning and execution by defining data-analysis approaches, preparing pre-test and pre-mission data products, coordinating data needs across engineering and test teams, and ensuring that instrumentation, telemetry, and other data systems support test objectives. Following test execution, this role leads data processing, analysis, synthesis, and reporting to support test assessment, anomaly identification, and technical decision-making. This position works closely with engineering, test operations, systems engineering, modeling and simulation, program leadership, customers, and other external stakeholders. The successful candidate will combine strong technical data-analysis skills with the communication and organizational abilities required to coordinate across multiple teams, create clear test outbriefs, manage the data sets' integration across the program's various needs, and flow relevant datasets and insights to the modeling and simulation team.

What You’ll Own

  • Support data analysis across subsystem-, system-, ground-, and flight-test programs from pre-test planning through post-test assessment; develop analysis plans aligned with test objectives, requirements, success criteria, and expected system behavior.
  • Define data products, processing workflows, analysis methods, and visualizations in coordination with engineering, test, instrumentation, telemetry, ground systems, and modeling and simulation teams.
  • Review test plans, procedures, instrumentation, telemetry, and data-acquisition approaches to ensure required data is available, usable, and traceable.
  • Perform data ingestion, conditioning, synchronization, reduction, validation, and analysis; analyze time-series, telemetry, instrumentation, and performance data.
  • Assess data quality, completeness, calibration, consistency, and traceability; compare measured results with requirements, predictions, simulations, reference cases, and expected system performance.
  • Identify and support the characterization, triage, and resolution of anomalies, discrepancies, and unexpected system behavior.
  • Synthesize data across multiple subsystems and test sources to develop system-level conclusions; flow relevant datasets, assumptions, lessons learned, and insights to modeling and simulation teams.
  • Create technically rigorous test reports and executive-ready outbriefs for engineering teams, leadership, customers, and external stakeholders; translate complex findings into clear conclusions, visuals, recommendations, and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain analysis documentation, data dictionaries, scripts, plots, and traceability; manage deliverables, dependencies, risks, and data limitations; support readiness, post-test, anomaly, and other technical reviews while improving repeatability through automation, standardized data products, and configuration management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or computer engineering, applied mathematics, physics, data science, or a related technical field
  • 7+ years of relevant engineering industry experience
  • Demonstrated experience processing and analyzing data from engineering, ground, flight, or integrated system activities, including time-series, telemetry, instrumentation, data-acquisition, or other engineering datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience with MATLAB and Simulink skills for data processing, analysis, visualization, modeling, and simulation, with experience integrating with or analyzing C/C++-based system models. Ability to understand model inputs, outputs, interfaces, configuration parameters, and implementation assumptions.
  • Understanding of data-processing workflows, including filtering, conditioning, synchronization, calibration, reduction, validation, visualization, and assessment of data quality, completeness, and consistency.
  • Ability to synthesize data from multiple subsystems and compare measured results with requirements, models, simulations, predictions, or expected system performance.
  • Strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, including experience creating test reports, technical briefings, and outbriefs for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across engineering, test, operations, modeling and simulation, program management, and external stakeholder teams, including support for test planning, readiness reviews, post-test reviews, and anomaly investigations.
  • Ability to manage multiple analysis efforts, priorities, dependencies, and deliverables in a high-tempo, matrixed environment; influence teams without direct authority and maintain a strong commitment to data integrity, analytical rigor, and traceability.
  • Experience with Atlassian tools, including Jira and Confluence.
  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in engineering, applied mathematics, physics, data science, or a related technical discipline
  • Active U.S. security clearance (S, TS, TS/SCI)
  • Experience analyzing data from integrated spacecraft, missile systems, launch vehicles, high-performance flight systems, or other safety-critical platforms.
  • Experience supporting subsystem-level and integrated system-level testing, including flight test, ground test, hardware-in-the-loop, software-in-the-loop, or mission simulation.
  • Experience developing automated data-processing pipelines, reusable analysis tools, or standardized technical data products.
  • Experience with MATLAB toolboxes for signal processing, control systems, statistics, or data acquisition, and with Simulink model validation, model correlation, or test-to-model comparison.
  • Experience with Python, SQL, or other technical data-processing languages.
  • Experience with telemetry systems, instrumentation, sensors, timing systems, or flight-test data products.
  • Familiarity with requirements verification, acceptance criteria, test success criteria, anomaly resolution, root-cause analysis, or fault isolation.
  • Experience presenting technical results to customers, government stakeholders, executive leadership, or external partners; background in systems engineering, GNC, propulsion, avionics, communications, flight software, or integrated vehicle systems.
  • Experience with configuration management, controlled technical data environments, test ranges, mission operations, ground systems, or operational data flows.

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $155,000- $220,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

  • Ability to maintain or obtain TS//SCI clearance
  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver or Long Beach. Strong preference in Denver, but open to Long Beach as well. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site
  • Work Travel — This role will require travel to test sites, estimated at 10% of the time.

Working here 

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

 Opportunity

As a Recruiter at Twin Health, you will directly shape the teams executing our mission to reverse chronic metabolic disease. Because we build cutting-edge AI, we expect our Talent Acquisition team to practice what we build. You will leverage modern AI-driven sourcing, structured screening intelligence, dynamic messaging, and workflow automation to cut down administrative drag and shorten time-to-fill, freeing you up to deliver an authentic, high-touch candidate experience.

Supporting hiring across Corporate, Marketing, Finance, and key business functions, you will partner closely with hiring managers to build efficient, scalable pipelines. If you are agile across multiple functional verticals, love working with operational rigor, and view AI as a force multiplier for genuine human connection, this role is built for you.

This position is open to candidates in EST or CST time zones. 

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a diverse portfolio of 15-20 non-technical roles, including corporate, marketing, finance, accounting, operations, and other general business functions
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, hiring priorities, and ideal candidate profiles
  • Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies across multiple channels, including LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and outbound outreach
  • Screen candidates for role fit, competencies, and alignment with Twin’s mission and values
  • Manage interview logistics end-to-end, ensuring a seamless and professional experience for candidates and interviewers
  • Drive offer processes, including compensation alignment, offer approvals, and closing candidates
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation in the ATS and ensure data integrity across all recruiting workflows
  • Ensure consistent, compliant, and equitable hiring practices including responsible AI use: monitoring for bias, protecting candidate data and privacy, and staying current on evolving AI-in-hiring regulations
  • Support recruiting operations, reporting, and process improvements as the company scales using AI-enabled analytics to surface pipeline insights and inform hiring strategy
  • Deliver a high-touch, thoughtful candidate experience from first outreach through onboarding handoff
  • Balance speed and quality while managing multiple requisitions across different functions simultaneously
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications 

  • 3+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit across multiple functional areas
  • Strong sourcing and outreach skills, with the ability to adapt messaging to different talent markets
  • Exceptional attention to detail and comfort managing complex processes, documentation, and scheduling
  • Highly organized, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple searches at once
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools in recruiting or day-to-day work (e.g., generative AI assistants, AI sourcing platforms, ATS AI features, workflow automation tools), with concrete examples of how you’ve used them to improve outcomes
  • Working knowledge of effective prompting and the ability to critically evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality
  • Understanding of responsible AI use in hiring, including fairness, transparency, data privacy, and applicable regulations
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with candidates, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and adjusting quickly as business needs evolve
  • Experience using ATS platforms and recruiting tools (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter, scheduling tools)
  • Experience in healthcare tech, SaaS, or venture-backed startups is a plus
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits 

The compensation range for this position is $105,000 - $115,000  annually.

Opportunity

This role is a unique opportunity to build the data foundation behind how Twin proves its value to every partner it serves. You won’t just maintain pipelines; you’ll design the claims data model that powers partner reporting, performance guarantee measurement, and a new partner-facing portal.As the Real World Data Lead, you’ll own Twin’s claims data architecture from end to end. You’ll take partner claims data from its ingested raw form, standardize it to deliver trusted, analytics-ready tables to internal teams and external partners. You’ll also consolidate our existing reporting marts onto this common foundation. This is a highly visible role at the center of how Twin demonstrates outcomes and savings. You’ll collaborate closely with data engineering, application engineering, health economics, and partner-facing teams.

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

  • Build Twin’s Tuva-based claims data model by designing and implementing the architecture in dbt and Snowflake, from the Tuva Input Layer through Tuva Core and the data marts our reporting depends on.
  • Develop and maintain partner connectors that map each partner’s ingested claims and eligibility data to the Tuva Input Layer. You’ll partner with the ingestion team to define clear data contracts at the handoff between raw and modeled data.
  • Own claims data quality by running structural and logical data quality checks, monitoring each partner data source, and reconciling modeled outputs against partner-reported totals.
  • Consolidate existing reporting marts onto the common data model, retiring duplicated claims logic. You’ll run old and new versions in parallel so current reporting continues uninterrupted during migration.
  • Build the partner portal serving layer with versioned, contract-enforced tables designed for application queries. This includes pre-aggregated models, performance tuning, and freshness commitments that partners can rely on.
  • Enforce partner data isolation and PHI security in Snowflake using role-based access, row access policies, secure views, and masking, so that each partner sees only its own data.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for metrics by ensuring that savings, PMPM, utilization, and outcome measures in the portal match the definitions used for contract measurement. You’ll work closely with health economics and actuarial partners on those definitions.
  • Manage the model lifecycle, including Tuva version upgrades, regression testing, CI/CD, documentation, and change communication to downstream consumers.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications 

  • Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. You bring 6+ years of experience in data or analytics engineering, including 3+ years working directly with healthcare claims data.
  • Claims Expertise: Deep familiarity with medical and pharmacy claims and eligibility data, including adjudication, reversals, claim lag, and standard code sets (ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, NDC, NPI). Experience with payer data formats (837, 835, 834) is a plus.
  • dbt Expertise: Extensive experience building and maintaining production dbt projects, including model contracts and versions, testing, and CI. Hands-on experience with the Tuva Project is strongly preferred.
  • Snowflake Proficiency: Advanced SQL and Snowflake experience, including query performance tuning, RBAC, row access and masking policies, and warehouse cost management.
  • Data Product Mindset: Proven experience delivering data to applications or external customers through stable, versioned interfaces, with a clear sense of what “production-grade” means when a partner is on the other end.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with data engineering, application engineering, and analytical teams to define data contracts, metric definitions, and ownership boundaries.
  • Innovation & AI Mindset: Demonstrated interest in using AI-assisted development and coding agents to accelerate connector development, testing, and documentation.
  • Passion: Twin’s purpose to transform lives by empowering people to reverse, prevent and improve chronic metabolic diseases excites you.
  • This hybrid opportunity based out of our New York office. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Opportunity

We are building a new interface to health: the Digital Twin.

The Digital Twin is a living, real-time model of each member’s metabolism and behavior—continuously learning from sensors, meals, sleep, movement, labs, and daily choices. It detects patterns, anticipates what’s coming, and guides members toward better health through timely, personalized actions.

To the member, it feels like a single, ever-present guide.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager, AI Experiences to define how members and care teams interact with this intelligence.

You will own the experiences that make AI a core part of how people use Twin—combining conversation, UI, personalized content, insights, and actions into experiences that feel natural, trusted, and useful.

You will own three critical areas:

  • Ask Your Twin (AYT) and its evolution to AYT Everywhere — moving from a destination members go to for chat toward intelligence that is available throughout the Twin experience.
  • Ask Your Agent, our AI Copilot for the Care Team — helping clinicians and care-team members understand what is happening with a member, decide what matters, and take action.
  • AI Experience interaction behaviors and primitives — defining how conversation and AI work across the product, including how insights, charts, recommendations, content, and actions become interactive and conversational.

The challenge isn't simply to get members to chat more. It's to use AI to make Twin meaningfully more effective at changing behavior and improving health outcomes.

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

Own Ask Your Twin (AYT) and its evolution to AYT Everywhere

  • Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for AYT
  • Evolve AYT from a chat destination into an intelligent experience available throughout Twin
  • Define when AI should respond, proactively engage, surface an insight, recommend an action, or get out of the way
  • Drive meaningful improvements in behavior change, engagement, and clinical outcomes

Own Ask Your Agent, the AI Copilot for Twin’s Care Team

  • Define how care-team members use AI to understand what matters about a member, ask questions, explore signals, and determine the right next action
  • Design experiences that reduce cognitive and operational burden while increasing the quality and effectiveness of care

Own AI experience primitives and interaction behaviors across Twin

  • Define how conversation + UI + personalized content + insights + actions work together as one experience
  • Make insights, charts, recommendations, plans, and content conversational—allowing users to ask questions, explore, understand why something matters, and take action
  • Define when the right interaction is chat, voice, traditional UI, proactive guidance, or a combination
  • Create reusable interaction patterns that enable other Twin teams to build consistent AI-native experiences

Define how Twin’s agents behave

  • Establish interaction and conversation patterns that make AI feel natural, personalized, useful, and trustworthy
  • Define proactive vs. reactive behaviors, context and continuity, human/AI handoffs, and escalation
  • Design experiences that work well despite the imperfect and non-deterministic nature of AI

Establish metrics and evaluation systems

  • Measure guidance quality, conversation effectiveness, problem resolution, member trust, and Care Team effectiveness
  • Connect AI experience metrics to behavior change, engagement, and clinical outcomes
  • Combine AI evaluation with product experimentation and real-world user outcomes

Operate at frontier speed

  • Rapidly move from insight → prototype → experiment → production → learning
  • Partner deeply with Design, AI Engineering, Clinical, Data, and Product teams
  • Continuously evaluate emerging capabilities across LLMs, agents, voice, personalization, and multimodal experiences
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including significant ownership of consumer- or user-facing products.
  • Significant recent experience building and shipping AI-native or agentic products used directly by end users.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an AI agent that was central to the user's experience or workflow.
  • Experience defining and measuring the quality of AI interactions using both AI evaluation techniques and product/outcome metrics.
  • Strong understanding of LLM and agent capabilities, limitations, and failure modes.
  • Strong experimentation and analytical skills, including KPI definition and evaluation design.
  • Ability to operate from product vision and strategy through detailed interaction decisions and rapid experimentation.
  • Builder mindset—you move quickly from concept to prototype to shipped experience.

Healthcare experience is valuable but not required. We care more about having built exceptional AI-native experiences that people use, trust, and act on.

Compensation and Benefits 

The compensation range for this position is $205,000 - $240,000 annually.

We're expanding beyond our existing diabetes and weight-loss programs into new cardiometabolic conditions and populations, including older adults who may have very different needs and comfort levels with technology. The foundation is strong: the clinical model, the sensors, the care team, and an app members already use. What we don’t yet know is what the right experience looks like for each new segment, and finding out is the job. If we get it right, it will look very different from what we ship today, and it will shape what Twin builds next.

You’ll own the member experience end to end, from enrollment and onboarding through sensors, daily engagement, clinical care, and long-term outcomes. You’ll figure out what to build, build the first version, then scale what works.

This is for a product leader who has shipped consumer products people love, is comfortable with an open problem, and wants to work across design, engineering, clinical, and operations to get it done.

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

  • Set the product vision and strategy for new programs. Identify the biggest opportunities, make clear choices about where to invest, align leadership around the direction, and own the end-to-end member experience from concept through scale.
  • Define what the right experience is for each new segment, then design and ship it.
  • Decide what to reuse, adapt, or replace from the current Twin app. Be willing to throw things out.
  • Take ideas from 0 to 1, then 1 to 100: prototype, test with real members, launch, and scale.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the members in each segment (needs, behaviors, technology comfort, accessibility, barriers to engagement, and the people who support them) and turn it into strategy and requirements. Spend regular time with them.
  • Work across team boundaries (Member Experience, Core Mobile, Sensors, Clinical, Operations, Engineering, Design) and with other product teams, so the experience feels like one product.
  • Partner with Clinical and Operations leaders on workflows that scale without hurting the member experience.
  • Spot friction across the full journey, set clear ownership across teams, and drive issues from discovery to resolution, even when the fix spans several product areas.
  • Define and track success metrics across activation, engagement, member experience, retention, and clinical outcomes. Run experiments and iterate on the results.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Consumer Product Mindset: Deep user empathy and strong user-centered thinking. You’ve shipped products people use by choice and can show us how users shaped them. Experience designing for diverse populations, such as older adults, people with accessibility needs, or varying digital literacy, is a plus.
  • End-to-End Product Thinker: Sees across organizational and product boundaries, finds gaps and dependencies, and builds a coherent experience from work owned by multiple teams.
  • Collaborative: Has worked with other product teams to deliver something that crossed team lines.
  • 0 to 1 and 1 to 100: Has launched something new and also scaled something that was already working.
  • Analytical: Defines meaningful success metrics, uses quantitative and qualitative insight to prioritize, and lets the data challenge assumptions.
  • Technical Knowledge: Knows enough to work closely with engineers on mobile and AI, and to make sound tradeoffs.
  • Strategic Thinking: Can say where their area should be in two years and why.
  • Excitement: Excited about this opportunity and this space.
  • Bonus: Health tech experience.

Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on the member-facing programs that introduce people to our life-changing care. Your top priority will be architecting the end-to-end service journey—from the moment a member is introduced to our offering through their complete onboarding. You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.

Responsibilities 

  • Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.
  • Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.
  • Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications 

  • Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.
  • Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.
  • Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).
  • Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.
  • Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. 

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $210,000 annually. 

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Recruiter to lead full-cycle recruiting for production, engineering, and other positions as needed. This role will source, screen, and coordinate candidates through the hiring process, manage day-to-day administration of our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and support onboarding logistics to ensure a smooth transition for new hires.

Key Responsibilities

Recruiting & Sourcing

  • Support full-cycle recruiting for production, engineering, and other roles (e.g., systems engineers, software/hardware engineers, program managers, cleared personnel, and other roles)
  • Manage requisition workload across multiple open roles simultaneously, prioritizing based on business needs and urgency
  • Source passive and active candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, niche technical/defense job boards, industry associations, veteran networks, and referrals
  • Screen resumes and conduct initial phone/video interviews to assess technical qualifications and cultural fit
  • Partner with hiring managers to gain a clear understanding of technical requirements and must-have qualifications for each role
  • Coordinate interview panels, assessments, and debriefs with hiring teams
  • Support hiring for cleared positions and understand basic requirements around security clearances (e.g., Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI) and eligibility requirements
  • Develop sourcing strategies and maintain candidate pipelines to support current and future hiring needs

ATS & Process Management

  • Manage day-to-day administration of the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), including job requisition setup, workflow configuration, and data integrity, keeping leadership informed of any process or workflow changes
  • Ensure accurate and timely candidate status updates, dispositioning, and pipeline tracking within the ATS
  • Generate and analyze recruiting metrics/reports from the ATS (time-to-fill, source of hire, pipeline conversion, etc.) for leadership review
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, templates, and processes, and propose changes for approval
  • Maintain compliance-related documentation within the ATS (EEO/AAP data, OFCCP requirements, etc.)

Candidate Experience & Onboarding Coordination

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring process, ensuring timely and professional communication
  • Coordinate interview scheduling logistics across multiple stakeholders and time zones
  • Assist in the offer process, including background checks, and other pre-employment requirements
  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires and first-day preparation
  • Continuously recommend improvements to the candidate journey to reflect a positive, professional experience
  • Provide clear timeline expectations and feedback to candidates at each stage

Additional Support

  • Represent the company at technical conferences, defense industry events, career fairs, and veteran hiring initiatives
  • Track and report on recruiting KPIs and provide regular pipeline updates 
  • Keep leadership informed of pipeline status, candidate feedback, and any risks or roadblocks throughout the hiring process

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition, or HR (technical/engineering or defense industry experience a plus, not required)
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Exposure to or hands-on experience with an ATS (e.g., Greenhouse, iCIMS, Workday or similar)
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • PHR/SHRM-CP or similar HR certification (or actively pursuing)

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Wraithwatch

Wraithwatch was founded by alumni from SpaceX, Palantir, and Anduril to build the next generation of AI-powered cyber defense systems for the United States and its allies. We are deployed today to customers spanning the federal government, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and emerging technology. Our core product is a continuously adaptive cyber defense platform utilizing generative artificial intelligence agents to autonomously model and construct a digital twin of an organization's entire IT and cybersecurity environment and analyze it for weaknesses, misconfigurations, and chains of possible attack.

We currently operate numerous live federal deployments with more coming online this year. Each one is a distinct environment with its own infrastructure, compliance requirements, and operational constraints. We need someone to make all of them run reliably at the same time.

The Role

You are responsible for the infrastructure that keeps Wraithwatch running in production across our federal and commercial deployments.

You will build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, and operational tooling that let a small team ship software reliably across all of these environments without things falling apart. When something breaks at 2am in a production federal environment, you're the person who gets it back up. When we need to roll a release across 20 deployments in a week, you're the person who makes that possible without manual SSH sessions into each one.

This is not a role where you're managing infrastructure for a single product in a single cloud account. You're building the deployment and operations backbone for a company that is scaling fast across highly constrained federal and Fortune 500 environments, and every shortcut you skip today becomes a fire you fight next month.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines that reliably ship software across 20+ federal environments in parallel.

  • Own the operational health of all production deployments — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and post-mortems.

  • Design infrastructure that accounts for the reality of federal environments: air-gapped networks, strict compliance requirements, variable network topologies, and limited access windows.

  • Build tooling that gives the engineering team visibility into the state of every deployment without requiring manual inspection.

  • Automate everything that can be automated. We cannot scale to hundreds of environments with manual processes.

  • Work with the product engineering team to ensure new features are deployable across all environments without environment-specific hacks.

  • Manage and improve cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and on-prem deployments depending on customer requirements.

  • Participate in on-call rotations for production environments.

Qualifications

Basic:

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and configuration management (Ansible, Salt, or similar)

  • Deep Linux systems knowledge — you should be comfortable debugging at the OS level, not just the application level

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for complex multi-environment deployments

  • Proficiency with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred)

  • Comfortable working in highly constrained or regulated environments where you can't just spin up whatever you want

  • Willingness to work extended hours when production issues demand it — we are a seed-stage startup with federal customers who do not tolerate downtime

Preferred:

  • Experience deploying software into federal, DoD, or IC environments

  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, STIG compliance, or ATO processes

  • Experience with air-gapped or disconnected network deployments

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale across many isolated environments simultaneously

  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, or similar)

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, Care Access Network
jobs.description_html:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

At Zocdoc, we are building products that help people access care more easily and help partners deliver better scheduling experiences at scale. As a Lead Product Designer on Care Access Network, you will shape partner-facing experiences that help healthcare organizations understand what is possible with Zocdoc and imagine new ways we can work together. You will bring product design, storytelling, and rapid prototyping together to create compelling visions of future partnership opportunities across dashboards, workflows, reporting, concepts, and tailored experiences.

This is a lead-level individual contributor role for a designer who can move fluidly between strategy, craft, systems thinking, and hands-on making. You will work in a highly consultative environment, using design as a superpower to help prospective and existing partners see around corners, align on opportunity, and build confidence in where the business relationship can go next. You will also help define how design works in a more AI-native product development model, using modern tools and working prototypes to accelerate learning and increase leverage.

 

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Influential with cross-functional partners through strong storytelling, clear artifacts, and a high degree of ownership.
  • Personally motivated by turning ambiguous opportunities into clear, compelling product direction across multiple surfaces and stakeholders.
  • Energized by working with many different partner contexts and translating business needs into persuasive product stories, prototypes, and concepts.
  • Excited to pair strong product design craft with rapid prototyping, especially when early concepts help clients and internal teams see the art of the possible.
  • Comfortable operating in consultative, commercial, or pitch-oriented environments where design helps move conversations forward and opens the door to future partnership opportunities.
  • Curious about AI-native product development and eager to use emerging tools to increase speed and quality without lowering the craft bar.

 

Your day to day is…

  • Leading end-to-end design across Care Access Network partner experiences, including dashboards, workflows, reporting, and supporting surfaces that help partners and developers understand performance and opportunity.
  • Creating rapid prototypes that explore new scheduling experiences, partnership concepts, and future-facing ideas that help strategic partners and internal teams learn quickly.
  • Developing polished concepts and tailored design narratives that reflect partner brands, business goals, and operational realities to support product strategy and commercial conversations.
  • Using design to help prospective and existing partners imagine the future of a deeper relationship with Zocdoc, including new ways our platform can support their growth.
  • Shaping visually rich reporting and storytelling experiences that make trends, progress, and next steps easier for partners to understand and act on.
  • Contributing to new partner-facing experiences tied to emerging initiatives, including exploratory concepts, landing-page-adjacent surfaces, and flows that help communicate the value of our evolving platform.
  • Using prototypes, systems thinking, and strong communication to align Product, Engineering, Business Development, and go-to-market partners around a shared direction.
  • Mentoring other designers and helping raise the quality and effectiveness of design across multiple workstreams.

 

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • Meaningful experience leading end-to-end product design for complex or ambiguous problem spaces, ideally across B2B products, platforms, service environments, or consultative client engagements.
  • A strong consultative mindset, with experience working across multiple companies, clients, or partner stakeholders and using design to support strategic conversations.
  • Strong visual, interaction, and systems design craft, with the ability to move between polished execution and exploratory concepting.
  • A track record of using prototypes and artifacts to clarify product vision, influence roadmaps, and help external or internal stakeholders imagine future possibilities.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, connecting dots across related workstreams, and bringing clarity to complex problems with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring peers and raising the quality bar beyond your own direct work.
  • Curiosity about AI-assisted workflows and openness to working in code-enabled design environments when it helps the team learn or move faster.

 

Benefits:

  • Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
  • Commuter Benefits
  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness programs with Headspace and Peloton
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified
Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

$160,000—$210,000 USD

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish. 

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better.  We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. jobs.description_html:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

Healthcare should work for patients - but it doesn't. Instead of easy access, patients face outdated insurance directories, long phone holds, weekslong wait times, and surprise bills. In any other industry, this experience would be unacceptable. But in healthcare, patients lack market power and are expected to tolerate broken systems. Zocdoc's mission is to give power back to the patient. We've built the leading healthcare marketplace, helping people find and book care across 50 states, 200+ specialties, and 12,000+ insurance plans. By giving patients choice and visibility, we enable a system where providers compete for patients - not the other way around.

Zocdoc now brings on entire health systems and practice groups at once, connecting tens of thousands of providers through automated pipelines. At that scale, the hard part is keeping every provider accurate and every booking intact as rosters change, schedules shift and data arrives that no one has seen before. As a Senior Product Manager on the Provider team, you'll own that problem. You'll build the products that make our provider network self-correcting: problems are caught before a patient or practice notices, most are fixed automatically, and every decision makes the next one faster. You'll also make sure Zocdoc reflects how each practice actually wants to work, so practices can trust every booking they get. You'll shape how people and AI agents work together to run the network as it grows many times over, and you'll make sure that when a patient books on Zocdoc, the appointment is real. If you're excited to do that alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, we'd love to meet you.

 

You'll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Personally motivated by improving our healthcare system
  • Drawn to high-leverage problems, where getting it right lets the whole business scale
  • Excited to build products where people and AI agents work side by side, and to earn the trust that requires
  • Someone who thinks in systems and goes after root causes
  • A first-principles thinker who thrives in ambiguity and can always find the crawl/walk/run path
  • Comfortable owning an outcome end to end, from the strategy to the metric that proves it worked

 

Your day to day is…

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for keeping provider data and bookings accurate as Zocdoc scales
  • Set the goals that define success, get them instrumented, and report progress to leadership
  • Own how practices tell Zocdoc the way they want to work, and make sure Zocdoc keeps reflecting it as practices grow and change
  • Make that easy to set up and keep current, whether a practice does it itself, an internal team does it for them, or it comes from the systems a client already uses
  • Balance giving practices control over what gets booked with keeping care accessible to patients
  • Turn cancellations, reschedules and resolved issues into lasting fixes, so the same problem doesn't happen twiceFind the biggest sources of breakage across the provider lifecycle and decide where to invest, using data and time with the people closest to the problem
  • Decide where automation and AI agents take over, where people stay in the loop, and how we know it's working
  • Lead discovery, write clear requirements and ship iteratively with Engineering and Design
  • Work with the teams that own provider data, insurance, visit reasons, availability and EHR integrations so problems get fixed at the source
  • Partner with Operations, Account Management, AI Operations, Data Science and peer PMs, and bring them along on strategy and tradeoffs

 

You'll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in operational tooling, workflow or case management, configuration products, or internal platforms for B2B SaaS
  • A track record of shipping products that remove manual work at scale, with measurable gains in throughput, resolution time or automation rate
  • Experience with automation or AI-powered products, including human-in-the-loop design
  • Experience treating internal teams as customers: you've sat with operators, learned their workflow, and built what they needed
  • Experience building configuration products that customers set up themselves, balancing flexibility with simplicity
  • Comfort with technical depth, from APIs and event-driven systems to data models, and the ability to dive deep with engineers while telling a clear story to business stakeholders
  • A data-driven approach: you define the metrics, get them instrumented, and use SQL or similar tools yourself
  • Familiarity with EHRs, provider data or healthcare operations is a plus, or a strong curiosity to learn them fast

Your Impact on Our Mission

Zocdoc is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to keep our production systems reliable, observable, and recoverable. Patients and providers depend on our platform to find and book care. Reliability here means understanding a request's full path across the edge, cloud infrastructure, services, and integrations, not just whether one service is up.

You'll operate and improve production infrastructure and observability, serve as an incident commander, and automate away recurring operational work instead of absorbing it. You'll go deep in a few of the areas below and stay fluent in the rest, partnering with our developer platform, database reliability, and product engineering teams so production stays safe as teams ship quickly.

You'll enjoy this role if you...

  • Believe teams can't operate what they can't see, and enjoy building the telemetry and alerting that fixes that

  • Creating an Inclusive Experience: Ensuring every candidate has equitable access to opportunities and an exceptional, transparent, and personalized experience at every step.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

At Zocdoc, we're on a mission to give power to the patient — and that starts with enabling every person at Zocdoc to build, ship, and leverage technology safely, confidently, and with leverage.

As a Staff Platform Engineer focused on AI Enablement, you will design, build, and evolve the foundational systems, tooling, guardrails, and paved roads that create leverage across our engineering organization and beyond — accelerating delivery while improving reliability, consistency, and developer experience. Critically, this role has a wider aperture than most platform roles: you will own AI enablement for technical stakeholders, building opinionated platforms and safe onramps that allow every builder at Zocdoc — regardless of their engineering background — to harness AI tools productively and securely.

This role sits within the Infrastructure organization. You will collaborate across the business to turn platform strategy into practical, adoptable solutions — working side by side with a parallel squad focused on the technical engineering audience, and bridging the gap between engineering-grade tools and the non-technical teams (People, Operations, Sales, Finance, and others) who increasingly build and depend on AI-powered workflows.

The role emphasizes hands-on technical leadership (~80%) with meaningful input into platform direction (~20%). Your work will abstract operational complexity, define guardrails for safe AI usage, improve testability and safety, and streamline the builder journey across both software-engineering and non-engineering surfaces.

You'll Enjoy This Role If You...

  • Enjoy building platforms that enable productivity, consistency, and autonomy for diverse audiences
  • Enjoy learning and teaching others about leveraging AI-based technologies to achieve real-world results
  • Are motivated by making other people more effective; not just shipping your own features
  • Like designing cohesive developer and/or non-technical experiences that teams actually want to adopt
  • Care deeply about empathy, usability, and reducing cognitive load
  • Prefer solving real problems through thoughtful design, iteration, and collaboration
  • Are comfortable translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders — and enjoy doing it
  • Find satisfaction in building systems that scale predictably and help others succeed
  • Thrive in environments with ambiguity, frequent change, and evolving prioritization — and bring clarity where there was none
  • Are a natural collaborator

Your Day to Day

  • Design and build platform services and solutions that are secure, scalable, and intentionally easy to use — including CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, shared infrastructure patterns, and AI-powered developer workflows
  • Contribute to the technical direction of Zocdoc's internal developer platform, including paved roads, tooling, and shared workflows for both engineering and non-engineering builders
  • Build and maintain opinionated platforms and guardrails that enable non-technical teams to safely create, share, and operationalize AI tools — without introducing security vulnerabilities, access control failures, or operational bottlenecks
  • Define and evolve the software development lifecycle for non-traditional builders: access controls, credential management, testing patterns, on-call/support paths, and contribution workflows
  • Collaborate across teams to understand real developer pain points and non-technical stakeholder needs; validate platform bets; and drive adoption of platform capabilities across both audiences
  • Own and deliver high-impact platform investments end to end — from problem framing through implementation and rollout
  • Improve measurable outcomes such as build times, deployment safety, AI tool adoption rates, and operational simplicity
  • Champion platform-as-product thinking by treating internal engineers and non-technical builders as first-class users — and continuously refining the experience based on their feedback
  • Advance platform capabilities in AI-assisted development, helping shape how all Zocdoc builders use AI in their daily workflows with the right guardrails for safety, quality, and testability
  • Work with cutting-edge generative AI tools and technology to accelerate platform development and model best practices for the broader organization
  • Mentor engineers and technologists across the business and raise the bar for technical design and code quality
  • Ensure platform patterns align with security, compliance, and reliability expectations without becoming a bottleneck

You'll Be Successful in This Role If You...

  • Have 7+ years of experience building or evolving internal developer platforms, productivity tooling, or CI/CD systems used by multiple teams
  • Have designed and operated distributed systems in AWS or similar cloud environments
  • Bring strong judgment around platform abstractions and APIs — knowing when to standardize and when to stay flexible
  • Can take ambiguous problems, break them into deliverable pieces, and drive them to measurable outcomes
  • Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to technical audience — translating engineering concepts into terms that resonate with stakeholders outside of software development
  • Treat adoption as a first-class engineering problem, not an afterthought — and know that adoption across non-technical teams requires an even higher bar of empathy and communication
  • Have experience (or strong, informed opinions) building guardrails, access controls, and safe onboarding paths for non-engineers using AI tools
  • Are motivated by enabling other engineers and non-technical builders to work reliably, safely, and with confidence
  • Value learning, curiosity, and operational excellence — and model those qualities for the team
  • Are comfortable in fast-moving, high-change environments where priorities evolve and alignment requires active investment
  • Have integrated generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, foster innovation, and maximize productivity
  • Hold a Bachelor's degree in CS, Math, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

  • ~20% Strategy and Influence (contributing to platform direction, participating in cross-team alignment, surfacing trade-offs and priorities)
